tEn: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
tZh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning：面向智能体 AI 的开放高效混合专家 Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型
sEn: Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total/12B active, multimodal) and Lightning (30B/3B active, text) are open Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models that combine distillation, long-context training, native speculative decoding and a full post-training pipeline to deliver strong agentic and software-engineering performance at high inference efficiency.
sZh: Nemotron 3.5 Super（120B 总参数/12B 激活，多模态）与 Lightning（30B/3B 激活，文本）是开放的混合专家 Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型，结合蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生投机解码与完整后训练流程，在高推理效率下实现出色的智能体与软件工程能力。
absEn: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.
absZh: 我们推出 Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning——面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体工作负载设计的开放、高效混合专家 Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型。Super 是 120B 参数、12B 激活的多模态模型，Lightning 则是更小的 30B 参数、3B 激活文本模型；两者均面向高效部署而设计。两个模型都结合了大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练与原生投机解码，Super 还进一步引入 Indic 继续预训练与智能体软件工程中期训练。我们构建了覆盖监督微调与强化学习（RLVR 与 RLHF）的完整后训练流程，Super 还辅以专门的教师模型训练与多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）。这使 Super 从纯文本基座模型转变为能够对文本、图像、视频及交互式工具环境进行推理的多模态智能体。我们进一步通过并行智能体执行与自验证探索测试时扩展。在训练与部署全过程中，我们联合优化能力与效率。Indic 继续预训练使印度语言基准最高提升 9.82 个百分点，智能体中期训练则增强了软件工程能力及跨智能体框架的鲁棒性。后训练后的 Super 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到 51.78%，尽管激活参数约少 4.6 倍，仍超越 Nemotron 3 Ultra。后训练 MTP 增强在概率性草稿采样下将投机解码接受长度最高提升 21.8%，而 NVFP4 量化相对 BF16 实现 99.62% 的中位精度恢复。推理优化使 GB200 上每 GPU 输出吞吐最高达 4,856 tokens/s，同时保持每用户至少 50 tokens/s。

contrib.en: Open MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models: Super 120B-A12B multimodal and Lightning 30B-A3B text, optimized for agentic workloads.
contrib.zh: 开源 MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型：Super 为 120B-A12B 多模态，Lightning 为 30B-A3B 文本模型，面向智能体式工作负载优化。

contrib.en: Recursively shared MTP head with hidden-state mixing enables native speculative decoding, boosting acceptance length up to 21.8%.
contrib.zh: 递归共享 MTP 头结合隐藏状态混合实现原生投机解码，接受长度最高提升 21.8%。

contrib.en: Indic continued pretraining on 2.83T synthetic tokens improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points.
contrib.zh: 基于 2.83 万亿合成 token 的 Indic 继续预训练，使印度语言基准最高提升 9.82 个百分点。

contrib.en: Agentic software-engineering mid-training at 256K context improves harness robustness; DeepSWE pass@1 rises 6.4% to 10.4%.
contrib.zh: 256K 上下文的智能体式软件工程中期训练提升 harness 鲁棒性，DeepSWE pass@1 从 6.4% 升至 10.4%。

contrib.en: Post-trained Super reaches 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra with ~4.6x fewer active parameters.
contrib.zh: 后训练的 Super 在 SWE-bench Pro 达 51.78%，以约 4.6 倍更少激活参数超越 Nemotron 3 Ultra。

contrib.en: NVFP4 quantization recovers 99.62% median accuracy; inference reaches 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU while sustaining 50 tokens/s/user.
contrib.zh: NVFP4 量化恢复 99.62% 中位精度；推理达 4,856 输出 token/s/GPU，同时维持每用户至少 50 token/s。

limits.en: Indic gains measured on limited benchmarks; optimal Indic mixture share not established for Super, only Lightning ablations.
limits.zh: Indic 增益仅在有限基准上测量；Super 的最优 Indic 混合比例未确定，仅有 Lightning 消融实验。

limits.en: Mid-training at 256K degrades RULER-1M from 79.9 to 33.5, requiring a separate 9B-token recovery stage.
limits.zh: 256K 中期训练使 RULER-1M 从 79.9 降至 33.5，需额外 9B token 恢复阶段。

limits.en: MOPD relies on stale asynchronous rollouts and importance masking, introducing bias; some benchmarks peak then decline.
limits.zh: MOPD 依赖过期的异步 rollout 与重要性掩码，引入偏差；部分基准先升后降。

limits.en: BrowseComp lacks standardized harness; scores vary with search provider, tools, and step budget, limiting comparability.
limits.zh: BrowseComp 缺乏标准 harness，分数随搜索提供商、工具与步数预算变化，可比性受限。

limits.en: Synthetic Indic data generated and judged by same model may favor its own translations; quality filtering is self-referential.
limits.zh: 合成 Indic 数据由同一模型生成并评判，可能偏好自身译文；质量过滤存在自我指涉。

full.sec: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
full.secZh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning：面向智能体式 AI 的开放、高效混合专家 Mamba-Transformer 模型

items.en: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both are designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training.
items.zh: 我们提出 Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体式工作负载设计的开放、高效混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）Mamba-Transformer 混合模型。Super 是一个 120B 参数、12B 激活参数的多模态模型，而 Lightning 是更小的 30B 参数、3B 激活参数的文本模型；两者均面向高效部署而设计。两个模型都结合了大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练与原生投机解码，而 Super 进一步引入了 Indic 继续预训练与智能体式软件工程中期训练。

items.en: We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification.
items.zh: 我们构建了一套完整的后训练流水线，涵盖监督微调与强化学习（RLVR 与 RLHF），并在 Super 中辅以专门的教师训练与多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）。这将 Super 从纯文本基座模型转变为能够对文本、图像、视频及交互式工具环境进行推理的多模态智能体。我们进一步通过并行智能体执行与自验证探索测试时扩展（test-time scaling）。

items.en: Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6\(\times\) fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative-decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user. Under the evaluated interactive agentic workload, NVFP4 achieves 2.43\(\times\) the throughput of BF16, while Nemotron 3.5 Super delivers 2.34\(\times\) and 1.90\(\times\) the throughput of Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 Flash-Next, respectively. We release base, BF16 post-trained, and NVFP4-quantized model checkpoints, alongside standalone parallel speculative drafters (LiLiCorr, DFlash, and DSpark), with accompanying model cards, pretraining and post-training datasets, cookbooks, and training recipes.
items.zh: 在训练与部署全过程中，我们联合优化能力与效率。Indic 继续预训练将印度语言基准提升最多 9.82 个百分点，而智能体式中期训练增强了软件工程能力以及跨智能体框架（agent harness）的鲁棒性。后训练后的 Super 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到 51.78%，尽管其激活参数约少 4.6\(\times\)，仍超越了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。后训练 MTP 增强在概率性草稿采样下将投机解码的接受长度最多提升 21.8%，而 NVFP4 量化相对于 BF16 实现了 99.62% 的中位精度恢复。推理优化在 GB200 上实现最高 4,856 输出 tokens/s/GPU，同时保持至少 50 tokens/s/user。在所评估的交互式智能体式工作负载下，NVFP4 达到 BF16 吞吐量的 2.43\(\times\)，而 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的吞吐量分别是 Qwen3.5 与 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 的 2.34\(\times\) 与 1.90\(\times\)。我们发布基座、BF16 后训练及 NVFP4 量化模型检查点，以及独立的并行投机草稿器（LiLiCorr、DFlash 与 DSpark），并附有模型卡、预训练与后训练数据集、cookbook 及训练配方。

items.en: We present Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, multimodal understanding, and long-running agentic workloads. Nemotron 3.5 Super is a 120 billion total and 12 billion active parameter model initialized from Nemotron 3 Super, while Lightning 3.5 is a 30 billion total and 3 billion active parameter model initialized from Nano 3 Base. As LLM applications increasingly move toward long-horizon agents that write code, interact with tools, reason over large contexts, and operate across multimodal environments, both model capability and inference efficiency become increasingly important. Nemotron 3.5 targets this regime through efficient hybrid architectures, native speculative decoding with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), large-scale distillation, specialized continued pretraining and mid-training, agent-focused post-training, and NVFP4 quantization.
items.zh: 我们提出了 Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是高效的混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型，专为推理、多模态理解和长时运行的智能体式工作负载而设计。Nemotron 3.5 Super 是一个总参数 1200 亿、激活参数 120 亿的模型，从 Nemotron 3 Super 初始化而来；而 Lightning 3.5 是一个总参数 300 亿、激活参数 30 亿的模型，从 Nano 3 Base 初始化而来。随着 LLM 应用日益转向能够编写代码、与工具交互、在大型上下文上进行推理并在多模态环境中运行的长时程智能体，模型能力和推理效率都变得越来越重要。Nemotron 3.5 通过高效的混合架构、带有 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）的原生推测解码、大规模蒸馏、专门的持续预训练和中期训练、面向智能体的后训练以及 NVFP4 量化来针对这一场景。

items.en: We begin by adapting the MTP architecture for efficient recursive speculative decoding. Nemotron 3.5 Super consolidates two non-shared MTP heads into a single recursively shared head, while Lightning initializes its MTP head from Nemotron 3 Super Base through architecture-aware projection fusion and pruning. Both models undergo a dedicated 100 billion token MTP warm-up with the backbone frozen. For Super, we additionally introduce hidden-state mixing to mitigate the train–inference conditioning mismatch during recursive drafting. We subsequently distill both models for 1 trillion tokens using the next-larger Nemotron form factor as teacher: Ultra 3 Base for Super and Super 3 Base for Lightning. Following distillation, Lightning undergoes long-context training, while Super proceeds through additional continued-pretraining and agentic mid-training stages.
items.zh: 我们首先调整 MTP 架构以实现高效的递归推测解码。Nemotron 3.5 Super 将两个非共享的 MTP 头整合为一个递归共享头，而 Lightning 通过架构感知的投影融合和剪枝从 Nemotron 3 Super Base 初始化其 MTP 头。两个模型都在主干网络冻结的情况下进行了专门的 1000 亿 token 的 MTP 预热。对于 Super，我们还引入了隐藏状态混合，以缓解递归起草过程中训练与推理条件不匹配的问题。随后，我们使用下一个更大的 Nemotron 模型作为教师，对两个模型进行了 1 万亿 token 的蒸馏：Super 使用 Ultra 3 Base，Lightning 使用 Super 3 Base。蒸馏之后，Lightning 进行长上下文训练，而 Super 则继续进行额外的持续预训练和智能体中期训练阶段。

items.en: We further improve Nemotron 3.5 Super through targeted continued-pretraining and mid-training stages. First, we perform 100 billion tokens of Indic continued pretraining, incorporating 10 billion tokens of synthetic and natural Indic data alongside 90 billion tokens from the preceding training mixture. To support this stage, we use NeMo Data Designer to generate approximately 2.83 trillion synthetic output tokens across 22 Indian languages and 34 language-script configurations. This stage improves all five evaluated Indic benchmarks, with gains of up to 9.82 percentage points. We then extend the model to a 1M-token context length using 35 billion tokens of continued pretraining, followed by 65.4 billion tokens of agentic software-engineering mid-training at 256K context. The mid-training mixture combines whole repositories, issue–pull-request pairs, commit histories, build and CI logs, and agent trajectories. Controlled evaluations using identical experimental SFT show improvements in long-horizon software engineering and robustness across agent harnesses, including DeepSWE pass@1 increasing from 6.4% to 10.4% and SWE-bench Verified under the Codex harness improving from 48.4% to 61.8%. To recover long-context capabilities affected by 256K mid-training, we perform an additional 9 billion token recovery stage, restoring RULER-1M performance from 33.5 to 81.0.
items.zh: 我们通过有针对性的持续预训练和中期训练阶段进一步改进 Nemotron 3.5 Super。首先，我们进行了 1000 亿 token 的印度语系持续预训练，其中包含 100 亿 token 的合成和自然印度语数据，以及来自先前训练混合的 900 亿 token。为了支持这一阶段，我们使用 NeMo Data Designer 在 22 种印度语言和 34 种语言-文字配置上生成了约 2.83 万亿合成输出 token。该阶段改善了所有五个评估的印度语基准，提升高达 9.82 个百分点。然后，我们使用 350 亿 token 的持续预训练将模型扩展到 100 万 token 的上下文长度，随后在 256K 上下文下进行了 654 亿 token 的智能体软件工程中期训练。中期训练混合结合了完整仓库、问题-拉取请求对、提交历史、构建和 CI 日志以及智能体轨迹。使用相同实验性 SFT 的受控评估显示，长时程软件工程和跨智能体框架的鲁棒性有所提高，包括 DeepSWE pass@1 从 6.4% 提高到 10.4%，Codex 框架下的 SWE-bench Verified 从 48.4% 提高到 61.8%。为了恢复受 256K 中期训练影响的长上下文能力，我们进行了额外的 90 亿 token 恢复阶段，将 RULER-1M 性能从 33.5 恢复到 81.0。

items.en: We post-train Nemotron 3.5 Super through a comprehensive pipeline spanning Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), specialized teacher training, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Our two-stage SFT pipeline transforms the text-only base model into a vision-language model while jointly developing reasoning, chat, safety, long-context, and agentic capabilities. RL training spans diverse environments, including Olympiad-level competitive programming and finance-agent tasks requiring SEC filing search, document parsing, evidence retrieval, and tool use. We further train specialized teachers for video reasoning and tracking, vision tool use, and alignment, before consolidating their capabilities through MOPD. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning follows a lighter post-training pipeline consisting of single-stage text-only SFT and RLVR. The resulting Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, exceeding Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6 \(\times\) fewer active parameters. Beyond model training, we explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification, improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 62.7% to 71.9% and DeepSWE from 24.6% to 34.5%.
items.zh: 我们通过一个全面的流程对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 进行后训练，包括监督微调（SFT）、基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、专门的教师训练和多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）。我们的两阶段 SFT 流程将纯文本基础模型转变为视觉语言模型，同时联合开发推理、聊天、安全、长上下文和智能体能力。强化学习训练涵盖多样化的环境，包括奥林匹克级别的竞争性编程和需要 SEC 文件搜索、文档解析、证据检索和工具使用的金融智能体任务。我们进一步训练了用于视频推理和跟踪、视觉工具使用和对齐的专门教师，然后通过 MOPD 整合它们的能力。Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 遵循更轻量的后训练流程，包括单阶段纯文本 SFT 和 RLVR。所得的 Super 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到 51.78%，尽管使用的激活参数约少 4.6 倍，仍超过了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。除了模型训练，我们还通过并行智能体执行和自我验证探索测试时扩展，将 Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 62.7% 提高到 71.9%，DeepSWE 从 24.6% 提高到 34.5%。

items.en: In parallel, we optimize Nemotron 3.5 for efficient inference and deployment. Post-training MTP boosting improves average speculative-decoding acceptance length from 4.287 to 4.718 under greedy decoding and from 3.787 to 4.612 under probabilistic draft sampling on SPEED-Bench. We develop NVFP4 post-training quantization and mixed-precision recipes across weights, caches, and the MTP drafter, complemented by quantization-aware distillation, achieving 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16 across 36 benchmarks for the released quantized Super checkpoint. We additionally optimize hybrid-state caching and GPU kernels for efficient long-context and agentic serving, and develop standalone parallel speculative drafters for low-concurrency, memory-bound inference. On a single GB200 GPU, Nemotron 3.5 Super achieves up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on a 20-turn agentic proxy workload while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user. Under the evaluated interactive serving conditions, NVFP4 delivers 2.43 \(\times\) the throughput of BF16, while Super achieves 2.34 \(\times\) and 1.90 \(\times\) the throughput of Qwen3.5 122B-A10B and Qwen3.8 Flash-Next, respectively. We release base, BF16 post-trained, and NVFP4-quantized model checkpoints, alongside standalone parallel speculative drafters (LiLiCorr for Super, and DFlash and DSpark for Lightning), with accompanying model cards, pretraining and post-training datasets, cookbooks, and training recipes.
items.zh: 同时，我们优化 Nemotron 3.5 以实现高效推理和部署。后训练 MTP 提升在 SPEED-Bench 上，在贪婪解码下将平均推测解码接受长度从 4.287 提高到 4.718，在概率性起草采样下从 3.787 提高到 4.612。我们开发了 NVFP4 后训练量化和混合精度方案，涵盖权重、缓存和 MTP 起草器，并辅以量化感知蒸馏，在发布的量化 Super 检查点上，在 36 个基准上实现了相对于 BF16 的 99.62% 中位精度恢复。我们还优化了混合状态缓存和 GPU 内核，以实现高效的长上下文和智能体服务，并开发了用于低并发、内存受限推理的独立并行推测起草器。在单个 GB200 GPU 上，Nemotron 3.5 Super 在 20 轮智能体代理工作负载上实现了高达 4,856 输出 token/s/GPU 的吞吐量，同时保持至少 50 token/s/用户。在评估的交互式服务条件下，NVFP4 的吞吐量是 BF16 的 2.43 倍，而 Super 的吞吐量分别是 Qwen3.5 122B-A10B 和 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 的 2.34 倍和 1.90 倍。我们发布了基础、BF16 后训练和 NVFP4 量化的模型检查点，以及独立的并行推测起草器（Super 的 LiLiCorr，Lightning 的 DFlash 和 DSpark），并附有模型卡、预训练和后训练数据集、烹饪书和训练配方。

items.en: We organize the remainder of the report into four sections: Pretraining (§2), Post-training (§3), Quantization (§4), and Inference (§5).
items.zh: 本报告其余部分组织为四节：预训练（§2）、后训练（§3）、量化（§4）与推理（§5）。

items.en: In this section, we describe the pretraining and mid-training recipe used to develop Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning 3.5. We first adapt and warm up the Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head for recursive speculative decoding, then distill both models for 1 trillion tokens using the next-larger Nemotron 3 model as teacher. Following distillation, both models undergo long-context training. For Super, we additionally apply Indic continued pretraining, perform agentic software-engineering mid-training at 256K context, and finish with a short 1M-context recovery stage. We also report the resulting base-model capabilities and the effects of these stages on multilingual, long-context, and agentic performance.
items.zh: 本节介绍用于开发 Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning 3.5 的预训练与中期训练方案。我们首先为递归投机解码适配并预热多词预测（Multi-Token Prediction, MTP）头，随后以次一级规模的 Nemotron 3 模型作为教师，对两个模型各蒸馏 1 万亿 token。蒸馏之后，两个模型均进行长上下文训练。对于 Super，我们还额外施加 Indic 继续预训练，在 256K 上下文窗口下进行智能体式软件工程中期训练，并以一个简短的 1M 上下文恢复阶段收尾。我们还报告了所得基座模型的能力，以及这些阶段对多语言、长上下文与智能体式性能的影响。

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning feature native speculative-decoding support via a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head, adopting the recursively shared MTP formulation detailed in . The MTP head functions as an integrated internal drafter that predicts multiple future tokens from the backbone's hidden representations. This enables multi-token candidate verification in a single forward pass over the backbone using rejection sampling or exact token matching.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 通过多 Token 预测（MTP）头原生支持推测解码，采用了 中详述的递归共享 MTP 公式。MTP 头作为一个集成的内部草稿器，从骨干网络的隐藏表示中预测多个未来 Token。这使得在骨干网络的一次前向传播中，通过拒绝采样或精确 Token 匹配进行多 Token 候选验证成为可能。

items.en: To establish the MTP drafting head, we employ model-specific initialization strategies tailored to the architectural origins of the Super and Lightning variants:
items.zh: 为了建立 MTP 草稿头，我们根据 Super 和 Lightning 变体的架构起源，采用了针对特定模型的初始化策略：

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Super: We initialize the MTP weights directly from the Nemotron 3 Super Base checkpoint (prior to long-context extension), which originally contained two distinct MTP heads. To consolidate multi-token drafting into a single, recursively shared head while preserving the underlying representation space, we initialize the MTP parameters exclusively from the first MTP head and discard the second.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super：我们直接从 Nemotron 3 Super Base 检查点（在长上下文扩展之前）初始化 MTP 权重，该检查点最初包含两个不同的 MTP 头。为了将多 Token 草稿整合到一个递归共享的单一头中，同时保留底层表示空间，我们仅从第一个 MTP 头初始化 MTP 参数，并丢弃第二个。

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: We initialize Lightning's MTP head from that of Nemotron 3 Super Base. We first fuse the latent MoE projections into the experts' up- and down-projection matrices, then prune the hidden size from 4096 to 2688, MoE intermediate size from 2688 to 1856, and number of routed experts from 512 to 128 to match Lightning.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：我们从 Nemotron 3 Super Base 的 MTP 头初始化 Lightning 的 MTP 头。我们首先将潜在 MoE 投影融合到专家的上投影和下投影矩阵中，然后将隐藏大小从 4096 修剪到 2688，MoE 中间大小从 2688 修剪到 1856，路由专家数量从 512 修剪到 128，以匹配 Lightning。

items.en: Following initialization, we conduct a dedicated MTP warmup phase for \(100\,\text{B}\) tokens, freezing the backbone parameters and optimizing only the MTP head. For Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, we applied the standard 2-step recursive MTP training. However, this naive training induces a pronounced train–inference conditioning mismatch. During standard training, recursive step \(k\) conditions on the full shifted sequence of ground-truth hidden states generated at step \(k-1\). In contrast, during autoregressive drafting at inference time, the MTP head conditions on an increasingly heterogeneous mixture of backbone hidden states and synthetic states generated by preceding MTP steps. This discrepancy compounds with increasing draft depth, degrading token acceptance rates at later positions.
items.zh: 初始化后，我们进行了专门的 MTP 预热阶段，使用 \(100\,\text{B}\) 个 Token，冻结骨干网络参数，仅优化 MTP 头。对于 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，我们应用了标准的 2 步递归 MTP 训练。然而，这种朴素的训练导致了明显的训练-推理条件不匹配。在标准训练中，递归步骤 \(k\) 以步骤 \(k-1\) 生成的真值隐藏状态的完整移位序列为条件。相比之下，在推理时的自回归草稿中，MTP 头以骨干网络隐藏状态和由先前 MTP 步骤生成的合成状态的日益异质的混合为条件。这种差异随着草稿深度的增加而加剧，降低了后续位置的 Token 接受率。

items.en: To bridge this distribution gap in Nemotron 3.5 Super, we adopt a hidden-state-mixing strategy similar to [citation]. At training step \(k\), input hidden states are sampled from the sequence of states produced by earlier MTP steps \(1, \ldots, k-1\), rather than relying exclusively on step \(k-1\). Exposing the MTP head to heterogeneous hidden-state mixtures during warmup enhances robustness across deeper draft steps, achieving significant acceptance rate gains without the computationally intensive multi-step simulation required by test-time training (TTT).
items.zh: 为弥合 Nemotron 3.5 Super 中的这一分布差距，我们采用了一种类似于 [引用] 的隐藏状态混合策略。在训练步 \(k\) 时，输入隐藏状态从先前 MTP 各步 \(1, \ldots, k-1\) 所产生的状态序列中采样，而非仅依赖第 \(k-1\) 步。在预热阶段让 MTP 头接触异构的隐藏状态混合，可增强其在更深草稿步上的鲁棒性，从而在不需测试时训练（TTT）所要求的高计算量多步模拟的情况下，获得显著的接受率提升。

items.en: We initialized Super 3.5 Base from Super 3 Base and Lightning 3.5 Base from Nano 3 Base, then distilled each model for 1 trillion tokens.
items.zh: 我们以 Super 3 Base 初始化 Super 3.5 Base，以 Nano 3 Base 初始化 Lightning 3.5 Base，然后对每个模型各蒸馏 1 万亿个 token。

items.en: For Lightning 3.5 Base, we used top-128 logits from Super 3 Base on 1 trillion tokens of the Ultra 3 Phase 2 data. We used standard forward KL divergence loss along with an extra sink token to capture the residual probability mass outside top-128. To provide training signal for rare tokens, we combined the KL loss with cross-entropy loss, assigning them weights of 0.9 and 0.1, respectively. To limit early drift from the initialization, we began distillation with the minimum Learning Rate (LR) of Nano 3 Base (\(10^{-5})\) and ramped it up slowly to \(10^{-4})\, 10% of the Nano 3 Base's peak LR, over 200 billion tokens. We then decayed the LR linearly back to \(10^{-5})\ over the remaining 800 billion tokens. All other hyperparameters and settings match Nano 3 Base, except for the added MTP layers. We used an MTP loss scaling factor of 0.1.
items.zh: 对于 Lightning 3.5 Base，我们在 1 万亿个 Ultra 3 Phase 2 数据 token 上使用了 Super 3 Base 的 top-128 logits。我们使用标准的前向 KL 散度损失，并额外加入一个 sink token 以捕获 top-128 之外的剩余概率质量。为了给稀有 token 提供训练信号，我们将 KL 损失与交叉熵损失相结合，权重分别设为 0.9 和 0.1。为限制早期偏离初始化，我们以 Nano 3 Base 的最小学习率（LR）（\(10^{-5})\）开始蒸馏，并在 2000 亿个 token 上缓慢提升至 \(10^{-4})\，即 Nano 3 Base 峰值 LR 的 10%。随后在剩余的 8000 亿个 token 上，我们将 LR 线性衰减回 \(10^{-5})\。除新增的 MTP 层外，所有其他超参数和设置均与 Nano 3 Base 一致。我们使用的 MTP 损失缩放因子为 0.1。

items.en: For Super 3.5 Base, we used the same distillation recipe as Lightning 3.5 Base but with Ultra 3 Base as the teacher and Skew Reverse KL divergence as the distillation loss function with \(\alpha=0.1\)\. Additionally, we used a smaller MoE sequence load balancing loss coefficient of \(10^{-5})\, as compared to \(10^{-4})\ for Lightning 3.5. We chose learning rates the same way as Lightning 3.5 Base, but with Super 3 Base LRs as the anchor, using \(4.5\times 10^{-6})\ as the minimum and \(4.5\times 10^{-5})\ as the maximum.
items.zh: 对于 Super 3.5 Base，我们采用与 Lightning 3.5 Base 相同的蒸馏配方，但以 Ultra 3 Base 作为教师模型，并使用 Skew Reverse KL 散度作为蒸馏损失函数，其中 \(\alpha=0.1\)\。此外，我们使用了更小的 MoE 序列负载均衡损失系数 \(10^{-5})\，而 Lightning 3.5 为 \(10^{-4})\。我们以与 Lightning 3.5 Base 相同的方式选择学习率，但以 Super 3 Base 的学习率为锚点，使用 \(4.5\times 10^{-6})\ 作为最小值，\(4.5\times 10^{-5})\ 作为最大值。

items.en: We augment Nemotron 3.5 Super with an Indic continued-pretraining stage that combines synthetic text generated from English documents with natural Indic corpora to strengthen Indian-language capabilities. Our twelve-language synthetic-data pipeline uses Gemma-4-31B-it for translation. We describe the data and generation pipeline, then present Super's training mixture and results, followed by separate Lightning 3.5 mixture ablations.
items.zh: 我们为 Nemotron 3.5 Super 增加了一个 Indic 继续预训练阶段，该阶段将从英文文档生成的合成文本与自然 Indic 语料库相结合，以增强印度语言能力。我们的十二语言合成数据流水线使用 Gemma-4-31B-it 进行翻译。我们描述了数据和生成流水线，然后展示了 Super 的训练混合和结果，随后是单独的 Lightning 3.5 混合消融实验。

items.en: Natural Indic text is scarce in many languages, and its coverage varies across languages, scripts, and subjects. We address these gaps by translating curated English documents into Indic languages. Nemotron-CC provides most of the English source documents. The sources cover general web content, education, mathematics, STEM, and question-answering. Keeping the source documents lets us check whether the generated text preserves their meaning and structure.
items.zh: 自然 Indic 文本在许多语言中很稀缺，其覆盖范围因语言、文字和主题而异。我们通过将精选的英文文档翻译成 Indic 语言来弥补这些差距。Nemotron-CC 提供了大部分英文源文档。来源涵盖一般网络内容、教育、数学、STEM 和问答。保留源文档使我们能够检查生成的文本是否保持了其意义和结构。

items.en: We generated data across 22 Indian languages: native-script and romanized text for twelve priority languages, and native-script text for ten additional lower-resource languages. The Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1 corpus contains a total of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens of generated Indic text across 34 language-script configurations, counted using a Gemma-4 tokenizer (Table 1). The twelve priority languages contribute approximately 2.50 trillion tokens, including 224.6 billion romanized tokens; the additional ten languages contribute approximately 327 billion native-script tokens. This scale and coverage provide a large, reusable pool of training text across languages and subjects, including languages where natural text is limited. Model builders can draw on this pool to study language mixtures, script choices, and training budgets for their own models.
items.zh: 我们生成了涵盖 22 种印度语言的数据：十二种优先语言的原生文字和罗马化文本，以及十种额外低资源语言的原生文字文本。Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1 语料库包含总共约 2.83 万亿个生成的 Indic 文本 token，涵盖 34 种语言-文字配置，使用 Gemma-4 分词器计数（表 1）。十二种优先语言贡献了约 2.50 万亿 token，包括 2246 亿罗马化 token；额外的十种语言贡献了约 3270 亿原生文字 token。这种规模和覆盖范围为跨语言和主题提供了大型、可重用的训练文本池，包括自然文本有限的语言。模型构建者可以利用这个池来研究他们自己模型的语言混合、文字选择和训练预算。

items.en: We created substantially more data than was used in Super's Indic CPT stage and will release the broader corpus publicly. Other teams can use the data directly, inspect how it was produced, and extend generation to their own needs.
items.zh: 我们创建的数据远多于 Super 的 Indic CPT 阶段所使用的数据，并将公开发布更广泛的语料库。其他团队可以直接使用数据，检查其生成方式，并将生成扩展到自己的需求。

items.en: We implement the four-stage pipeline for the twelve priority languages (Figure 2) using NeMo Data Designer. Gemma-4-31B-it, selected based on translation-model comparisons, performs translation, quality assessment, and rewriting. We select source documents with fewer than 4,096 Gemma-4 tokens and translate each document in full, without splitting, using prompts designed to preserve facts, mathematical expressions, code, and formatting. The model then checks each translation against its source and assigns a quality score from 0 to 100. We keep translations scoring at least 75. Lower-scoring translations are rewritten using the source text and identified errors, then checked again and kept only if they pass.
items.zh: 我们使用 NeMo Data Designer 为十二种优先语言实现了四阶段流水线（图 2）。Gemma-4-31B-it 基于翻译模型比较被选中，执行翻译、质量评估和重写。我们选择少于 4,096 个 Gemma-4 token 的源文档，并使用旨在保留事实、数学表达式、代码和格式的提示，完整翻译每个文档而不拆分。然后模型对照源文档检查每个翻译，并分配 0 到 100 的质量分数。我们保留得分至少为 75 的翻译。得分较低的翻译使用源文本和识别出的错误进行重写，然后再次检查，仅当通过时才保留。

items.en: Retained translations keep their source and quality metadata for traceability. Quality scores guide filtering, although using the same model for translation and judging may favor its own translations.
items.zh: 保留的译文会保留其来源和质量元数据，以便追溯。质量分数用于指导过滤，不过用同一个模型既做翻译又做评判，可能会偏向它自己的译文。

items.en: For the ten additional lower-resource languages, we use Bodhan-MT for translation and Gemma-4-31B-it for quality assessment, with language-specific acceptance thresholds. We use overlapping windows only for longer Santali documents and convert Manipuri translations from Bengali script to Meitei Mayek. The companion Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs report provides details.
items.zh: 对于另外十种资源较少的语言，我们使用 Bodhan-MT 进行翻译，使用 Gemma-4-31B-it 进行质量评估，并采用针对各语言设定的接受阈值。我们仅对较长的 Santali 文档使用重叠窗口，并将 Manipuri 译文从孟加拉文转写为 Meitei Mayek 文。配套报告《Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs》提供了详细信息。

items.en: For the twelve-language pipeline, we improved scheduling so translation and quality checks can run concurrently. Speculative decoding, FP8 weights, and FlashAttention reduced median translation cost from 0.835 to 0.335 GPU-hours per million English input tokens, a reduction of about 60%. This is equivalent to processing 2.49 times as many tokens per GPU-hour. The comparison uses the same twelve-language benchmark, with approximately 46.8M input tokens per language. The gain applies to translation; quality checks and rewriting add further cost.
items.zh: 对于十二种语言的流水线，我们改进了调度，使翻译和质量检查可以并发运行。推测解码、FP8 权重和 FlashAttention 将每百万英文输入 token 的翻译成本中位数从 0.835 GPU 小时降至 0.335 GPU 小时，降幅约 60%。这相当于每 GPU 小时处理的 token 数提升至 2.49 倍。该对比使用相同的十二语言基准，每种语言约 46.8M 输入 token。这一收益适用于翻译；质量检查和改写还会带来额外成本。

items.en: Super's Indic continued-pretraining run has a nominal 100B-token budget, with 10% (10B tokens) allocated to selected synthetic text from our corpus and natural Indic text. The remaining 90% (90B tokens) retains the preceding training mixture's relative source proportions. These are configured sampling allocations, not measured per-source token totals or counts of unique tokens in the corpus.
items.zh: Super 的 Indic 继续预训练运行名义上有 100B token 的预算，其中 10%（10B token）分配给从我们的语料中选出的合成文本和自然 Indic 文本。其余 90%（90B token）保持先前训练混合中相对来源比例不变。这些是配置的采样分配，而非实测的各来源 token 总量或语料中唯一 token 的计数。

items.en: We chose the 10% Indic share as a practical allocation within this budget, informed by the separate 200B-token Lightning mixture ablations (Table 3). The 10% mixture already delivered substantial gains; higher shares improved results further, but with smaller incremental gains.
items.zh: 我们将 10% 的 Indic 占比选为该预算内的一个实用分配，这一选择参考了单独的 200B token Lightning 混合消融实验（表 3）。10% 的混合已经带来了显著收益；更高占比进一步提升了结果，但增量收益更小。

items.en: We evaluate Indian-language knowledge, reasoning, and mathematics using MILU and human-verified Indic translations of MMLU-Pro, ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, and GSM8K.
items.zh: 我们使用 MILU 以及经人工核验的 MMLU-Pro、ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy 和 GSM8K 印度语言译本，评估印度语言知识、推理与数学能力。

items.en: MILU covers ten supported languages; GSM8K excludes Odia because its evaluation exceeded the serving context limit. Translation also improves on twelve-language IGB/FLORES: English-to-Indic chrF++ rises from 35.43 to 47.47, and Indic-to-English from 58.75 to 64.30. The later midtraining checkpoint largely retains the Indic benchmark gains.
items.zh: MILU 覆盖十种受支持语言；GSM8K 排除了 Odia，因为其评估超出了服务上下文窗口限制。翻译在十二种语言的 IGB/FLORES 上也有提升：英语到印度语言的 chrF++ 从 35.43 升至 47.47，印度语言到英语从 58.75 升至 64.30。后续的 midtraining 检查点基本保留了印度语言基准上的增益。

items.en: We also evaluated the Indic-CPT model across a broad set of English benchmarks and observed no regressions in the tested categories.
items.zh: 我们还在大量英语基准上评估了 Indic-CPT 模型，未在测试类别中观察到性能回退。

items.en: To complement this stage-level evaluation, Figure 3 compares the evaluated Nemotron 3 and 3.5 Super models on a broader set of Indic tasks and language-quality measures. Nemotron 3.5 Super scores higher on five of the six task metrics shown and on all four IndiVibe dimensions. These results show the overall performance of the released Nemotron 3.5 Super model, with Indic CPT as part of its broader training pipeline.
items.zh: 为补充这一阶段级评估，图 3 在更广泛的印度语言任务和语言质量指标上比较了所评估的 Nemotron 3 与 3.5 Super 模型。Nemotron 3.5 Super 在所示六项任务指标中的五项以及全部四个 IndiVibe 维度上得分更高。这些结果展示了已发布 Nemotron 3.5 Super 模型的整体性能，其中 Indic CPT 是其更广泛训练流程的一部分。

items.en: To study how the Indic share affects performance, we ran separate Lightning 3.5 research experiments with 10%, 20%, and 30% Indic data under a fixed 200B-token training budget. These experiments are separate from the released Lightning 3.5 model, which did not include this Indic CPT stage. The four-benchmark mean increased with the Indic share, with the 30% mixture scoring highest among the tested settings (Table 3). These experiments inform mixture design but do not establish an optimal share for Super. Detailed language-level results, mixture configurations, and English-retention analysis will appear in the companion Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs report.
items.zh: 为研究印度语言数据占比如何影响性能，我们在固定 200B token 训练预算下，分别以 10%、20% 和 30% 的印度语言数据开展了独立的 Lightning 3.5 研究实验。这些实验与已发布的 Lightning 3.5 模型相互独立，后者未包含此 Indic CPT 阶段。四项基准的平均值随印度语言占比上升而提高，其中 30% 混合比例在测试设置中得分最高（表 3）。这些实验为混合比例设计提供参考，但并未确定 Super 的最优占比。详细的语言级结果、混合配置以及英语保持分析将出现在配套报告《Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs》中。

items.en: Alongside the Nemotron 3.5 technical report, we will release the broader synthetic corpus, open-source the generation pipelines, and publish a companion technical report. That report will provide detailed translation-model comparisons, data-source ablations on Nemotron 3 Nano, and Lightning 3.5 mixture experiments. In collaboration with AI4Bharat, we will also release a human-verified Indic LLM evaluation suite. Together, these resources will help model builders train, evaluate, and adapt models for Indian-language applications.
items.zh: 与 Nemotron 3.5 技术报告一同，我们将发布更广泛的合成语料库、开源生成流水线，并发布一份配套技术报告。该报告将提供详细的翻译模型对比、在 Nemotron 3 Nano 上的数据源消融实验，以及 Lightning 3.5 混合实验。我们还将与 AI4Bharat 合作，发布经人工验证的印度语 LLM 评测套件。这些资源将共同帮助模型构建者训练、评估和适配面向印度语言应用的模型。

items.en: Similar to the Nemotron 3 series, we added a long-context phase (LC-Phase) at the end of pretraining. In the LC-Phase, we performed continued pretraining (CPT) at 1M-token context length to equip the base model with long-context ability. For Lightning 3.5, we used a constant learning rate of \(1*10^{-5}\). We used 8-way context parallelism, 8-way tensor parallelism, 8-way expert parallelism, and 2-way pipeline parallelism to train on GB200 GPUs. For Super 3.5, we used a constant learning rate of \(4.5*10^{-6}\). We used 16-way context parallelism, 8-way tensor parallelism, and 64-way expert parallelism to train on GB300 GPUs.
items.zh: 与 Nemotron 3 系列类似，我们在预训练末尾加入了一个长上下文阶段（LC-Phase）。在 LC-Phase 中，我们以 1M token 的上下文窗口进行持续预训练（CPT），使基础模型具备长上下文能力。对于 Lightning 3.5，我们使用恒定的学习率 \(1*10^{-5}\)。我们在 GB200 GPU 上采用 8 路上下文并行、8 路张量并行、8 路专家并行和 2 路流水线并行进行训练。对于 Super 3.5，我们使用恒定的学习率 \(4.5*10^{-6}\)。我们在 GB300 GPU 上采用 16 路上下文并行、8 路张量并行和 64 路专家并行进行训练。

items.en: We use the same data blend as Nemotron 3 Ultra. The LC-Phase was trained for 21B tokens for Lightning and 35B tokens for Super. Note that for Super 3.5 after mid-training which was performed at a context length of 256K, we observed that the RULER-1M score dropped from 79.9 to 33.5. So we added a short long-context recovery phase after mid-training, for which we trained 9B tokens with the same recipe and successfully recovered the RULER score to 81.0.
items.zh: 我们使用与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 相同的数据混合。LC-Phase 阶段中，Lightning 训练了 21B token，Super 训练了 35B token。需要注意的是，对于 Super 3.5，在以 256K 上下文窗口完成中训练之后，我们观察到 RULER-1M 分数从 79.9 下降到 33.5。因此，我们在中训练之后加入了一个简短的长上下文恢复阶段，使用相同的配方训练了 9B token，并成功将 RULER 分数恢复到 81.0。

items.en: After the long-context phase, we add a mid-training stage for agentic software engineering. Pretraining runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, and the natural data around software engineering, such as whole repositories, pull requests with their issues, commit histories, and build logs, is often too long for it. SFT in turn consists mostly of synthetic data, and very long SFT stages can reduce how much the model later gains from RL. Mid-training sits between the two. It trains the base model at long context on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data with a small share of agent traces, and leaves behavior shaping to post-training. The full recipe, including how each data source is built and filtered and the ablations behind each choice, is described in .
items.zh: 在长上下文阶段之后，我们为智能体式软件工程增加了一个中期训练阶段。预训练在短上下文下运行，几乎看不到智能体交互，而围绕软件工程的自然数据（例如完整代码仓库、带有 issue 的 pull request、提交历史和构建日志）往往对它来说过长。SFT 则主要由合成数据构成，而过长的 SFT 阶段会削弱模型之后从强化学习中获得的收益。中期训练介于两者之间。它在长上下文下用自然软件工程数据与少量智能体轨迹的多样混合来训练基础模型，并把行为塑造留给后训练。完整方案（包括每个数据源如何构建与过滤，以及每个选择背后的消融实验）见。

items.en: We mid-trained the long-context checkpoint for 65.4B tokens at a sequence length of 256K. We reset the learning rate, warmed it up linearly to a maximum of \(1\times 10^{-5}\), about twice the final pretraining learning rate, and then held it constant for the rest of the run. Training at 256K lowered the RULER-1M score, so we followed mid-training with a short long-context recovery stage of about 9B tokens, described in the Long Context section above.
items.zh: 我们以 256K 的序列长度对长上下文检查点进行了 65.4B token 的中期训练。我们重置了学习率，将其线性预热至最大值 \(1\times 10^{-5}\)（约为预训练最终学习率的两倍），然后在剩余训练中保持恒定。在 256K 下训练降低了 RULER-1M 分数，因此我们在中期训练之后接了一个约 9B token 的短长上下文恢复阶段，详见上文的长上下文一节。

items.en: To measure the effect of mid-training, we ran identical SFT on the base checkpoint and on the mid-trained checkpoint and compared the two. This SFT is an experimental agentic blend of about 33B tokens (2K steps), not the one used in Section 3, but we have found it to be a reliable signal of how a checkpoint will do after full post-training. Table 5 shows the results. The clearest gain on the standard benchmarks is on DeepSWE, our hardest long-horizon benchmark, where pass@1 rises from 6.4 to 10.4, and BrowseComp improves slightly. SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro under OpenHands stay within run-to-run variation, which is about one point. The larger effect is on robustness across agent harnesses. Under OpenHands, the harness used for our standard evaluations, the base model already scores well and mid-training changes little. Under five other harnesses, the mid-trained model is better on every one, by 8.6 points on average on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, with the largest gain on Codex, where the base model is weakest.
items.zh: 为衡量中期训练的效果，我们在基础检查点和中期训练后的检查点上运行了相同的 SFT，并对两者进行比较。该 SFT 是一个约 33B token（2K 步）的实验性智能体混合数据，并非第 3 节所用的那个，但我们发现它能可靠地预示检查点在完整后训练之后的表现。表 5 展示了结果。在标准基准上最明显的提升出现在 DeepSWE——我们最难的长时程基准——其 pass@1 从 6.4 升至 10.4，BrowseComp 略有提升。在 OpenHands 下的 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 则处于运行间波动范围内，约为一个点。更大的影响体现在跨智能体 harness 的鲁棒性上。在 OpenHands（我们标准评估所用的 harness）下，基础模型本已得分良好，中期训练改变不大。在另外五个 harness 下，中期训练后的模型在每一个上都更好：SWE-bench Verified 平均提升 8.6 点，Terminal-Bench 2.1 提升 6.8 点，其中在 Codex 上提升最大——基础模型在该 harness 上最弱。

items.en: We evaluate the base models across a broad suite of benchmarks covering general knowledge, mathematical reasoning, code generation, commonsense reasoning, reading comprehension, and multilingual capabilities. Detailed evaluation settings and results are provided below.
items.zh: 我们在涵盖通用知识、数学推理、代码生成、常识推理、阅读理解以及多语言能力的广泛基准测试套件上对基础模型进行了评估。详细的评估设置和结果如下所示。

items.en: All evaluation results reported for Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B-A12B Base and Lightning 3.5 30B-A3B Base were collected via NeMo Evaluator SDK[^1] and NVIDIA's open-source container of LM Evaluation Harness[^2], unless otherwise stated. For reproducibility, additional details on evaluation configurations are available in the NeMo Evaluator SDK examples[^3]. The open-source LM Evaluation Harness container packaged through NVIDIA's NeMo Evaluator SDK is available on NGC[^4].
items.zh: 除非另有说明，Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B-A12B Base 和 Lightning 3.5 30B-A3B Base 的所有评估结果均通过 NeMo Evaluator SDK[^1] 和 NVIDIA 开源的 LM Evaluation Harness 容器[^2] 收集。为确保可复现性，评估配置的更多细节可在 NeMo Evaluator SDK 示例[^3] 中获取。通过 NVIDIA NeMo Evaluator SDK 打包的开源 LM Evaluation Harness 容器可在 NGC[^4] 上获取。

items.en: The evaluations use the following settings:
items.zh: 评估使用以下设置：

items.en: For general knowledge, we evaluate MMLU, MMLU-Pro, AGIEval-En, SuperGPQA, and GPQA Diamond. We report exact-match metrics using benchmark-specific extraction procedures where applicable. GPQA Diamond is evaluated using 5-shot chain-of-thought prompting.
items.zh: 对于通用知识，我们评估了 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、AGIEval-En、SuperGPQA 和 GPQA Diamond。在适用的情况下，我们使用针对基准的特定提取程序报告精确匹配指标。GPQA Diamond 使用 5-shot 思维链提示进行评估。

items.en: For mathematical reasoning, we evaluate GSM8K using 8-shot chain-of-thought exact match and Minerva MATH using exact match. We additionally evaluate MATH-500 using 4-shot sampled generation with 32 generations per prompt and report pass@1.
items.zh: 对于数学推理，我们使用 8-shot 思维链精确匹配评估 GSM8K，并使用精确匹配评估 Minerva MATH。此外，我们使用 4-shot 采样生成（每个提示 32 次生成）评估 MATH-500，并报告 pass@1。

items.en: For code tasks, we evaluate HumanEval and MBPP using EvalPlus-sanitized variants. We report sampled pass@1 estimated from 32 generations per prompt. MBPP-Sanitized uses 3-shot prompting, while HumanEval uses zero-shot prompting. We additionally report results on LiveCodeBench CodeGen and the complete and instruct variants of BigCodeBench.
items.zh: 对于代码任务，我们使用经 EvalPlus 清洗的变体来评估 HumanEval 和 MBPP。我们报告基于每个提示 32 次生成所估计的采样 pass@1。MBPP-Sanitized 使用 3-shot 提示，而 HumanEval 使用零样本提示。我们还额外报告了在 LiveCodeBench CodeGen 以及 BigCodeBench 的 complete 和 instruct 变体上的结果。

items.en: For commonsense reasoning, we evaluate CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, OpenBookQA, PIQA, TruthfulQA MC2, WinoGrande, and SocialIQA using the accuracy or normalized-accuracy metrics shown in Table 6.
items.zh: 对于常识推理，我们使用表 6 中所示的准确率或归一化准确率指标来评估 CommonsenseQA、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、OpenBookQA、PIQA、TruthfulQA MC2、WinoGrande 和 SocialIQA。

items.en: For reading comprehension, we evaluate RACE using zero-shot accuracy.
items.zh: 对于阅读理解，我们使用零样本准确率来评估 RACE。

items.en: For multilingual capability, we evaluate Global MMLU across German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Chinese, and report the average accuracy across these eight languages. We evaluate MGSM using 8-shot native chain-of-thought prompting in Spanish, German, French, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian, and report the average exact-match score across the six languages.
items.zh: 对于多语言能力，我们在德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和中文上评估 Global MMLU，并报告这八种语言的平均准确率。我们使用西班牙语、德语、法语、中文、日语和俄语的 8-shot 母语思维链提示来评估 MGSM，并报告这六种语言的平均精确匹配得分。

items.en: Evaluation results for Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B-A12B Base and Lightning 3.5 30B-A3B Base are summarized in Table 6.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B-A12B Base 和 Lightning 3.5 30B-A3B Base 的评估结果汇总于表 6。

items.en: Our post-training pipeline for Super is similar to that used in Nemotron 3 Ultra, consisting of SFT, RLVR, expert teacher model training, and finally MOPD as shown in Figure 4. We elaborate on each stage of the pipeline in the following sections. Lightning goes through a lighter pipeline, with text-only SFT and RLVR.
items.zh: Super 的后训练流程与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 中所采用的流程类似，由 SFT、RLVR、专家教师模型训练以及最后的 MOPD 组成，如图 4 所示。我们将在后续各节中详细阐述该流程的每个阶段。Lightning 则采用更轻量的流程，仅包含纯文本 SFT 和 RLVR。

items.capEn: Figure 4: Overview of the Super-V3.5-VL post-training pipeline. Teacher models are developed from a shared trunk through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) stages, specializing in different capabilities. These teacher models are subsequently merged into a unified student mo

items.en: We train Nemotron 3.5 Super to be a VLM and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be a text-only model. As the base model for Nemotron Super 3.5 is pre-trained on text-only data, we introduce large quantities of vision data in the SFT stage, along with agentic and reasoning text data. After warming up the vision projector, we use a two-stage SFT process because learning vision and text capabilities simultaneously is challenging. In the first stage, we train on a general mix of vision, reasoning, chat, long-context, safety, and agentic data. We then do a small second stage of SFT, where we change the blend composition to boost some capabilities the first stage did not learn adequately. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is trained with a single SFT stage with the text-only SFT data.
items.zh: 我们将 Nemotron 3.5 Super 训练为 VLM，将 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 训练为纯文本模型。由于 Nemotron Super 3.5 的基础模型是在纯文本数据上预训练的，我们在 SFT 阶段引入了大量视觉数据，以及智能体式与推理文本数据。在对视觉投影器进行预热之后，我们采用两阶段 SFT 流程，因为同时学习视觉与文本能力颇具挑战。在第一阶段，我们在视觉、推理、对话、长上下文、安全与智能体式数据的通用混合上训练。随后我们进行一个小规模的第二阶段 SFT，调整混合数据的组成，以提升第一阶段未能充分学会的某些能力。Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 则使用纯文本 SFT 数据、以单阶段 SFT 训练。

items.en: **Vision Data.** We leveraged vision data from the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni training corpus, which covers general visual perception and VQA across charts, tables, OCR, multi-page documents, visual grounding, GUI understanding, and video understanding. It also covers visual reasoning over mathematics, science, and spatial and temporal relationships, with multilingual coverage concentrated in document and OCR tasks. We augmented this corpus with newly curated data using open-source models such as Qwen3.5 to strengthen chart understanding, grounded perception, multi-hop reasoning, GUI/web navigation, and multimodal coding. The data generation pipeline covers diverse visual structures, domains, question types, and reasoning tasks. We have observed that organizing the reasoning traces into an explicit sequence of concise steps, with each step grounded in relevant visual evidence, helps teach the model systematic planning and encourages iterative verification against the visual input. Additionally, we apply automated quality checks to filter ambiguous or visually unsupported questions, incomplete reasoning traces, hallucinated labels or values, incorrect visual or numerical interpretations, excessive repetition, and unproductive self-correction. Figure 5 summarizes the pipeline. We provide a chart-understanding implementation of this approach as an open-source NeMo Data Designer generation pipeline recipe⁵ and a companion development note⁶.
items.zh: **视觉数据。** 我们利用了来自 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 训练语料的视觉数据，该语料涵盖通用视觉感知，以及跨图表、表格、OCR、多页文档、视觉定位、GUI 理解和视频理解的 VQA。它还涵盖数学、科学以及空间与时间关系上的视觉推理，多语言覆盖则集中于文档与 OCR 任务。我们使用 Qwen3.5 等开源模型新构建的数据扩充了该语料，以增强图表理解、有依据的感知、多跳推理、GUI/网页导航和多模态编程能力。数据生成流水线覆盖多样的视觉结构、领域、问题类型和推理任务。我们观察到，将推理轨迹组织为一系列明确的简洁步骤、且每一步都基于相关视觉证据，有助于教会模型系统化规划，并鼓励其针对视觉输入进行迭代验证。此外，我们应用自动化质量检查，以过滤歧义或缺乏视觉支持的问题、不完整的推理轨迹、幻觉标签或数值、错误的视觉或数值解读、过度重复以及无效的自我纠正。图 5 总结了该流水线。我们以开源 NeMo Data Designer 生成流水线配方⁵及配套开发说明⁶的形式，提供了该方法的一个图表理解实现。

items.en: **Agentic Vision Data.** Visual tool use is a fundamental ability for agents. To teach the model to gain this agentic ability, we generate a comprehensive dataset spanning different areas. We use Kimi K2.6 and K3 to generate agentic datasets with a focus on image tool operations such as crop, rotate, zoom, flip, etc. for high-resolution images. For video understanding, we use Kimi K2.6 to generate executable SpatialClaw demonstrations from existing video question–answer pairs, teaching the student to collect visual evidence, use tools, and interpret observations before answering. The source pools cover attribute perception, temporal understanding, object reasoning, OCR, counting, and video synopsis. Each assistant action contains Purpose, Reasoning, Next Goal, and executable Python Code. Actions run in a persistent kernel that returns execution feedback and visual observations. The agent can inspect frames, query selected frames through a separate visual question-answering call, perform SAM3 segmentation, and reconstruct scene geometry before terminating with ReturnAnswer. We retain normally completed trajectories whose answers match the references and whose required tools execute successfully. Structured answers use canonical matching; other free-form answers require same-teacher, text-only equivalence judging with reported confidence \(\geq 0.90\). Subsequent filtering rejects malformed actions, execution failures, exceeded display budgets, and trajectories lacking a successful grounded action. We package the recorded conversations and images for SFT, removing redundant formatting and messages. The final corpus contains 14,169 trajectories and 81,366 assistant actions. We show the performance with the SpatialClaw harness in Table 7.
items.zh: **智能体式视觉数据。** 视觉工具使用是智能体的一项基本能力。为教会模型获得这一智能体式能力，我们生成了一个覆盖不同领域的综合数据集。我们使用 Kimi K2.6 和 K3 生成智能体式数据集，重点针对高分辨率图像的裁剪、旋转、缩放、翻转等图像工具操作。对于视频理解，我们使用 Kimi K2.6 从现有视频问答对生成可执行的 SpatialClaw 演示，教会学生模型在作答前收集视觉证据、使用工具并解读观察结果。源池涵盖属性感知、时间理解、物体推理、OCR、计数和视频摘要。每个助手动作包含 Purpose、Reasoning、Next Goal 和可执行 Python Code。动作在持久化内核中运行，返回执行反馈和视觉观察。智能体可以检查帧、通过单独的视觉问答调用查询选定帧、执行 SAM3 分割，并在以 ReturnAnswer 终止前重建场景几何。我们保留正常完成、答案与参考匹配且所需工具成功执行的轨迹。结构化答案采用规范化匹配；其他自由形式答案则要求同一教师模型进行纯文本等价性判定，且报告置信度 \(\geq 0.90\)。后续过滤会剔除格式错误的动作、执行失败、超出显示预算以及缺少成功有依据动作的轨迹。我们将录制的对话和图像打包用于 SFT，去除冗余格式和消息。最终语料包含 14,169 条轨迹和 81,366 个助手动作。我们在表 7 中展示了使用 SpatialClaw 测试框架的性能。

items.en: Baseline uses no agentic vision training. \(\Delta\) denotes Ours minus Baseline.
items.zh: 基线不使用任何智能体式视觉训练。\(\Delta\) 表示 Ours 减去 Baseline。

items.en: For reasoning supervised fine-tuning, we used the same underlying reasoning problem sets as Nemotron Ultra. These problem sets span mathematics, STEM, coding, and mathematical proof. For the mathematics and STEM problem sets, we replaced the previous teacher with Kimi K3 and regenerated both chain-of-thought (CoT) and tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) response trajectories. Mathematical-proof trajectories were generated using DeepSeek V4 Pro, while competitive-programming trajectories were generated using GLM-5.2.
items.zh: 对于推理监督微调，我们使用了与 Nemotron Ultra 相同的底层推理问题集。这些问题集涵盖数学、STEM、编程和数学证明。对于数学和 STEM 问题集，我们将先前的教师模型替换为 Kimi K3，并重新生成了思维链（CoT）和工具集成推理（TIR）响应轨迹。数学证明轨迹使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 生成，而竞赛编程轨迹使用 GLM-5.2 生成。

items.en: As part of data filtering, we removed reasoning responses shorter than 5,000 tokens to focus the training mixture on examples containing sufficiently developed, multi-step reasoning. We also observed a difference in learning dynamics between data generated by the two primary reasoning teachers. For Nemotron Ultra, DeepSeek V4 Pro served as the primary reasoning teacher, and downstream reasoning performance largely plateaued after a single pass over the resulting training trajectories. After switching the primary reasoning teacher to Kimi K3 for Nemotron 3.5 Super, performance continued to improve over multiple passes through the regenerated trajectories. We hypothesize that the more concise and information-dense reasoning produced by Kimi K3 requires additional exposure for a smaller student model to internalize.
items.zh: 作为数据过滤的一部分，我们移除了短于 5,000 个 token 的推理回复，以使训练混合数据聚焦于包含充分展开的多步推理的样本。我们还观察到，由两个主要推理教师模型生成的数据在学习动态上存在差异。对于 Nemotron Ultra，DeepSeek V4 Pro 担任主要推理教师，在对所得训练轨迹完成单次遍历后，下游推理性能基本趋于平稳。在将 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的主要推理教师切换为 Kimi K3 后，性能在多次遍历重新生成的轨迹过程中持续提升。我们假设，Kimi K3 生成的推理更简洁、信息密度更高，因此较小的学生模型需要更多次接触才能将其内化。

items.en: **Chat and Safety Data.** We largely follow the same recipe as Nemotron 3 Ultra; however, we refresh our chat dataset with more recent Qwen, Kimi, and Gemma model responses. For safety data, we largely use the same blend as Nemotron 3 Ultra, plus some additional data focused on dual-risk CBRNE content and demographic biases.
items.zh: **对话与安全数据。** 我们大体沿用 Nemotron 3 Ultra 的相同配方；不过，我们用更新的 Qwen、Kimi 和 Gemma 模型回复刷新了对话数据集。对于安全数据，我们大体使用与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 相同的混合数据，并额外加入一些聚焦于双重风险 CBRNE 内容和人口统计偏差的数据。

items.en: **Long-Context Data.** We used the 512K long-context data from Nemotron 3 Ultra. In addition, we synthetically generated graph-structured data to teach the model to trace nodes and edges through reasoning, rather than relying solely on copying and scanning. We also found that agent trajectories from long-horizon search and coding tasks can improve long-context generalization. Finally, for Nemotron 3.5 Super, we synthetically generate long-context translation data from both the PG19 and FinePDFs-Edu datasets, where each instance is one long document translated in chunks from the source language to a target language using DeepSeek V4 Flash. For detailed source and target languages as well as token counts, please see Tables 29–30. To evaluate long-translation performance, we use the SEGALE evaluation pipeline. We found that long-translation performance was improved by also including synthetic transduction tasks that reinforce position tracking, retrieval, mutation, and output. Long translation results can be seen in Figure 12. We also include long-context vision data generated with NeMo Data Designer for multi-page and whole-document understanding over documents spanning up to hundreds of pages. These examples require locating and combining evidence from text, tables, charts, and diagrams across pages.^7
items.zh: **长上下文数据。** 我们使用了 Nemotron 3 Ultra 的 512K 长上下文数据。此外，我们合成了图结构数据，以教会模型通过推理追踪节点和边，而不是仅依赖复制和扫描。我们还发现，来自长时程搜索和编码任务的智能体轨迹可以提升长上下文泛化能力。最后，对于 Nemotron 3.5 Super，我们从 PG19 和 FinePDFs-Edu 两个数据集合成生成长上下文翻译数据，其中每个实例是一篇长文档，使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 将源语言分块翻译为目标语言。有关详细的源语言和目标语言以及 token 数量，请参见表 29–30。为评估长翻译性能，我们使用 SEGALE 评估流水线。我们发现，同时加入强化位置追踪、检索、变异和输出的合成转导任务可以提升长翻译性能。长翻译结果见图 12。我们还加入了使用 NeMo Data Designer 生成的长上下文视觉数据，用于对跨度达数百页的文档进行多页和整文档理解。这些样本需要跨页定位并组合来自文本、表格、图表和示意图的证据。^7

items.en: **Training Config.** For the SFT stage, we jointly fine-tune the language and vision components. Training uses packed sequences of up to 524,288 tokens with a global batch size of 32. The learning rate warms up over 100 packed-sample-equivalents—approximately 9,100 original records—to \(1\times 10^{-5}\), then remains constant. We use Adam with \(\beta_{1}=0.9\), \(\beta_{2}=0.95\), weight decay 0.1, and gradient clipping at 1.0, while retaining two shared-weight MTP layers with an auxiliary-loss scaling factor of 0.3.
items.zh: **训练配置。** 在 SFT 阶段，我们联合微调语言和视觉组件。训练使用最多 524,288 个 token 的打包序列，全局批大小为 32。学习率在 100 个打包样本等价物（约 9,100 条原始记录）上预热至 \(1\times 10^{-5}\)，随后保持不变。我们使用 Adam 优化器，\(\beta_{1}=0.9\)、\(\beta_{2}=0.95\)，权重衰减为 0.1，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，同时保留两个共享权重的 MTP 层，辅助损失缩放因子为 0.3。

items.en: Reinforcement learning improves the general capabilities of the SFT model and provides a strong foundation for developing specialized teacher models. At this stage, we jointly apply RLVR and RLHF, routing samples from each environment to the corresponding verifier or reward model for scoring. Compared with Nemotron 3 Ultra, we refresh the RL training data with more recent collections and perform reward profiling before training. We use the same training algorithm as [it], augmented with two optimizations designed to mitigate train–inference mismatch: router replay and using FP32 for the LM head. Together, these optimizations reduce the KL error between the training and inference engines by more than an order of magnitude.
items.zh: 强化学习提升了 SFT 模型的通用能力，并为开发专门的教师模型提供了坚实基础。在此阶段，我们联合应用 RLVR 与 RLHF，将来自各环境的样本路由至相应的验证器或奖励模型进行打分。与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 相比，我们使用更新的数据集合刷新了 RL 训练数据，并在训练前进行奖励画像（reward profiling）。我们采用与 [其] 相同的训练算法，并辅以两项旨在缓解训练–推理不一致的优化：router replay 以及对 LM head 使用 FP32。这些优化共同将训练引擎与推理引擎之间的 KL 误差降低了一个数量级以上。

items.en: We also incorporate new data such as the competitive-programming RL environment of [reference], comprising 2,847 training problems and 372 validation problems from past Olympiad-level competitions, each paired with a validated executable evaluator. Generated C++ solutions are compiled and executed against problem-specific tests, receiving a binary reward of 1 for full credit and 0 otherwise.
items.zh: 我们还引入了新的数据，例如 [某工作] 的竞赛编程 RL 环境，包含来自历届奥赛级别竞赛的 2,847 道训练题和 372 道验证题，每题均配有经过验证的可执行评测器。生成的 C++ 解答会被编译并针对题目专属测试执行，获得满分时给予二值奖励 1，否则为 0。

items.en: To improve tool use and cross-document reasoning on financial tasks, we built a finance-agent environment on top of NeMo Gym targeting the capabilities measured by the Vals.ai Finance Agent benchmark. The environment provides the same tools—SEC filing search, document parsing, evidence retrieval, and final source-supported submission—during trajectory generation, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and evaluation, avoiding format and tool mismatch across stages. We use two synthetic data generation (SDG) tracks. The document-grounded track samples windowed contexts from SEC 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings of S&P 500 companies, generates analyst-style questions with a teacher model, and verifies answerability and answer quality using multi-seed voting and GenSelect. The agentic track targets gaps found in a coverage audit against the Vals.ai category taxonomy by making the relationship among source documents—reporting period, form type, and company—an explicit sampling variable. Validated questions are re-solved by teacher models in the same environment to produce verified tool-use trajectories, and are routed to the SFT or RL pool according to their measured difficulty.
items.zh: 为提升金融任务中的工具使用与跨文档推理能力，我们在 NeMo Gym 之上构建了一个金融智能体环境，针对 Vals.ai Finance Agent 基准所衡量的能力。该环境在轨迹生成、监督微调（SFT）、强化学习（RL）和评估过程中提供相同的工具——SEC 文件检索、文档解析、证据检索以及最终有来源支撑的提交——从而避免各阶段之间的格式与工具不匹配。我们采用两条合成数据生成（SDG）路线。文档锚定路线从标普 500 公司的 SEC 10-K、10-Q 和 8-K 文件中采样窗口化上下文，用教师模型生成分析师风格的问题，并通过多种子投票与 GenSelect 验证可回答性和答案质量。智能体路线针对对照 Vals.ai 类别分类法进行覆盖审计时发现的缺口，将源文档之间的关系——报告期、表单类型和公司——设为显式的采样变量。经过验证的问题由教师模型在同一环境中重新求解，以生成经过验证的工具使用轨迹，并根据测得的难度将其路由至 SFT 或 RL 数据池。

items.en: To support training across a broad and diverse set of environments, we use a global batch size of 8,192, with 16 rollouts generated per sample. The maximum generation length is initially set to 80K tokens and later increased to 128K.
items.zh: 为支持在广泛而多样的环境集合上进行训练，我们使用 8,192 的全局批大小，每个样本生成 16 条 rollout。最大生成长度最初设为 80K token，随后提升至 128K。

items.en: We initialize the Agentic Teacher from the step-120 text-RLVR checkpoint and continue training with full end-to-end GRPO on agentic tasks. We do not use any single-step environments during the training of the agentic teacher; rather, we opt to train the end-to-end agentic teacher on sandbox, fully executable agentic Terminal, SWE, and Search tasks.
items.zh: 我们从第 120 步的 text-RLVR 检查点初始化智能体式教师（Agentic Teacher），并在智能体任务上以完整的端到端 GRPO 继续训练。在智能体式教师的训练过程中，我们不使用任何单步环境，而是选择在沙箱、完全可执行的智能体式 Terminal、SWE 和 Search 任务上训练端到端的智能体式教师。

items.en: We use 64 prompts and 16 generations per prompt, giving a total batch size of 1024. We keep a max trajectory age of one for the training of the agentic teacher. Each task was given a maximum timeout of 2 hours per rollout. Tasks were profiled for difficulty for the step-120 text-RLVR checkpoint.
items.zh: 我们使用 64 个提示，每个提示生成 16 次，总批大小为 1024。在智能体式教师的训练中，我们将最大轨迹年龄保持为 1。每次 rollout 中，每个任务的最大超时时间设为 2 小时。我们针对第 120 步的 text-RLVR 检查点对任务进行了难度分析。

items.en: We initialize the reasoning teacher from the step-120 text-RLVR checkpoint and continue training with the same asynchronous GRPO framework. The main differences are the training mixture and the generation budget. We replace the broad RLVR mixture with a reasoning-focused curriculum of 25,600 examples, with each 256-prompt batch containing 90% science, 5% mathematics, and 5% competitive-coding problems. The maximum generation length is set to 131,072 throughout training.
items.zh: 我们从第 120 步的 text-RLVR 检查点初始化推理教师，并使用相同的异步 GRPO 框架继续训练。主要区别在于训练数据混合与生成预算。我们将宽泛的 RLVR 混合数据替换为聚焦推理的课程，共 25,600 个样本，每个包含 256 条提示的批次中，90% 为科学问题、5% 为数学问题、5% 为竞赛编程问题。整个训练过程中，最大生成长度设为 131,072。

items.en: We use 256 prompts per update and 16 responses per prompt, giving a total batch size of 4,096. We increase the maximum trajectory age from one to two updates compared to the initial RLVR setup. The learning rate remains \(4 \times 10^{-6}\). Mathematics and STEM rewards use answer verification with DeepSeek-V4-Flash^{10} as the LLM judge, while coding rewards use execution-based tests. We select the checkpoint after 80 updates as the reasoning teacher for the MOPD stage.
items.zh: 每次更新使用 256 条提示，每条提示生成 16 个回复，总批次大小为 4,096。与初始 RLVR 设置相比，我们将最大轨迹年龄从一次更新增加到两次更新。学习率保持为 \(4 \times 10^{-6}\)。数学与 STEM 奖励采用答案验证，并以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash^{10} 作为 LLM 评判器，而编程奖励采用基于执行的测试。我们选择经过 80 次更新后的检查点作为 MOPD 阶段的推理教师。

items.en: We train a video teacher on a mixture of video-QA reasoning data, which is carefully curated from the video training subset of Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, and SA-V object-tracking data. Video-QA examples contain multiple-choice questions over 64 ordered frames, which are processed as a single video. SA-V examples contain box, point, and referring-object tracking tasks whose frames are processed as ordered multi-image inputs. This mixture targets complementary high-level video-reasoning (e.g., temporal, attribute, action, and object) and fine-grained spatiotemporal-tracking capabilities.
items.zh: 我们在视频问答推理数据和 SA-V 目标跟踪数据的混合数据上训练一个视频教师模型，其中视频问答推理数据是从 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 的视频训练子集中精心筛选得到的。视频问答示例包含针对 64 个有序帧的多选题，这些帧被作为单个视频处理。SA-V 示例包含框、点和指代目标跟踪任务，其帧被作为有序多图像输入处理。这种混合旨在同时提升互补的高层视频推理能力（例如时间、属性、动作和对象）和细粒度的时空跟踪能力。

items.en: Both sources use deterministic, verifiable task rewards rather than an LLM judge. Video-QA uses a binary reward based on multiple-choice answer correctness. For SA-V, the model generates structured tracks over the requested frames, and the verifier assigns a continuous reward based on localization quality, object-visibility accuracy, and the validity and completeness of the predicted track. Missing, invalid, or extraneous track entries are penalized.
items.zh: 两个数据源都使用确定性的、可验证的任务奖励，而不是 LLM 评判器。视频问答使用基于多选题答案正确性的二元奖励。对于 SA-V，模型在请求的帧上生成结构化轨迹，验证器根据定位质量、对象可见性准确度以及预测轨迹的有效性和完整性分配连续奖励。缺失、无效或多余的轨迹条目会受到惩罚。

items.en: We additionally apply two auxiliary shaping signals. First, a response without exactly one properly matched <think>...</think> block is considered malformed: its task reward is set to zero and its training advantage is overridden to \(-5\). This prevents an otherwise correct answer with malformed reasoning structure from being reinforced. Second, we apply a soft length preference only to correct responses. Reasoning up to 1,024 tokens retains the full task reward; between 1,024 and 4,096 tokens, the reward multiplier decreases linearly from \(1.0\) to \(0.95\); and beyond 4,096 tokens it remains at \(0.95\). This profile band does not truncate generation and introduces at most a 5% preference for concise, correct reasoning.
items.zh: 我们额外应用两个辅助塑形信号。首先，如果响应没有恰好一个正确匹配的 <think>...</think> 块，则被视为格式错误：其任务奖励设为零，训练优势被覆盖为 \(-5\)。这防止了推理结构格式错误但答案正确的响应被强化。其次，我们仅对正确响应应用软长度偏好。推理长度不超过 1,024 个 token 时保留完整任务奖励；在 1,024 到 4,096 个 token 之间，奖励乘数从 \(1.0\) 线性下降到 \(0.95\)；超过 4,096 个 token 时保持在 \(0.95\)。该偏好区间不会截断生成，并且对简洁、正确的推理最多引入 5% 的偏好。

items.en: We initialize from the step-120 text-RLVR checkpoint and train using asynchronous GRPO in NeMo-RL. Each update uses 128 prompts and 16 responses per prompt, giving a global batch of 2,048 trajectories. We replay the MoE expert-routing decisions recorded during rollout generation when evaluating the policy, reducing train–generation log-probability discrepancies. The MoE router and vision modules remain frozen. Training uses a constant learning rate of \(3\times 10^{-6}\) on 128 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs.
items.zh: 我们从 step-120 文本-RLVR 检查点初始化，并在 NeMo-RL 中使用异步 GRPO 进行训练。每次更新使用 128 个提示，每个提示 16 个响应，形成全局批次大小为 2,048 条轨迹。在评估策略时，我们重放 rollout 生成期间记录的 MoE 专家路由决策，以减少训练与生成之间的对数概率差异。MoE 路由器和视觉模块保持冻结。训练在 128 块 NVIDIA GB200 GPU 上使用恒定学习率 \(3\times 10^{-6}\)。

items.en: We select step 60 as the final teacher. It achieves 74.90 on Video-MME under the 256-frame reasoning protocol, 19.10 on Video-MME-v2 under the corresponding 256-frame reasoning protocol, 52.59 on GOT-10k, and 60.00 on Molmo2-VideoTrack. This checkpoint is subsequently used as the video-specialized teacher during MOPD.
items.zh: 我们选择 step 60 作为最终教师模型。在 256 帧推理协议下，它在 Video-MME 上达到 74.90，在相应的 256 帧推理协议下，在 Video-MME-v2 上达到 19.10，在 GOT-10k 上达到 52.59，在 Molmo2-VideoTrack 上达到 60.00。该检查点随后在 MOPD 期间用作视频专用教师模型。

items.en: To promote effective tool use in complex vision tasks, we train a vision tool-calling teacher on a curated mixture of internal data. The target tools include image cropping, zooming, rotation, flipping, difference detection, side-by-side comparison of images, overlays, object counting, and color analysis, with all tool calls represented as structured XML. The training set consists of synthetically generated multiple-choice and numerical questions that require one or more of the target tools to solve. We further filter the data by difficulty, retaining samples that are nearly impossible to solve correctly without using the available tools. We use outcome correctness as the primary reward, as well as an auxiliary tool-use reward to penalize duplicate and malformed tool calls. We initialize from the text-RLVR checkpoint and train using asynchronous GRPO in NeMo-RL. The teacher checkpoint selection is guided by the target vision tool use benchmark accuracy on V*, HRBench8K, and BabyVision.
items.zh: 为促进复杂视觉任务中有效的工具使用，我们在精心筛选的内部数据混合集上训练了一个视觉工具调用教师模型。目标工具包括图像裁剪、缩放、旋转、翻转、差异检测、图像并排比较、叠加、目标计数和颜色分析，所有工具调用均以结构化 XML 表示。训练集由合成生成的多项选择题和数值题组成，这些题目需要借助一个或多个目标工具才能求解。我们进一步按难度过滤数据，保留那些在不使用可用工具时几乎无法正确求解的样本。我们以结果正确性作为主要奖励，并辅以工具使用奖励，以惩罚重复和格式错误的工具调用。我们从 text-RLVR 检查点初始化，并在 NeMo-RL 中使用异步 GRPO 进行训练。教师检查点的选择以 V*、HRBench8K 和 BabyVision 上的目标视觉工具使用基准准确率为指导。

items.en: To improve reasoning over visual inputs, we train on a curated mixture of chart understanding, document and table reasoning, OCR, geometry, and visual reasoning tasks. The first stage draws from 16,090 profiled examples. The second stage uses a mixture of 13,848 examples, comprising 8,366 chart-reasoning questions from Chart datasets, together with 5,482 examples emphasizing document, table, and OCR understanding. We audit reference-answer formats and compatibility with the reward functions, and remove exact question–answer duplicates from the second-stage mixture. We use outcome correctness as the training reward, evaluated using task-appropriate mathematical, multiple-choice, and string-matching verifiers.
items.zh: 为提升对视觉输入的推理能力，我们在一个经过精心筛选的混合任务集上训练，涵盖图表理解、文档与表格推理、OCR、几何以及视觉推理任务。第一阶段使用 16,090 个经过画像的样本。第二阶段使用由 13,848 个样本组成的混合数据，其中包括来自 Chart 数据集的 8,366 个图表推理问题，以及 5,482 个侧重文档、表格和 OCR 理解的样本。我们审查了参考答案格式及其与奖励函数的兼容性，并从第二阶段混合数据中移除了完全重复的问题–答案对。我们以结果正确性作为训练奖励，并使用与任务相适应的数学、多项选择和字符串匹配验证器进行评估。

items.en: We initialize from an existing multimodal RLVR checkpoint and train using asynchronous GRPO in NeMo-RL, with 256 prompts per update and 16 sampled responses per prompt. The second stage initializes from the first-stage checkpoint at step 114 with a fresh optimizer. We use the checkpoint obtained after 20 additional updates on the second-stage mixture. Both stages use 128 GPUs distributed across 32 compute nodes.
items.zh: 我们从已有的多模态 RLVR 检查点初始化，并在 NeMo-RL 中使用异步 GRPO 进行训练，每次更新使用 256 个提示，每个提示采样 16 个回复。第二阶段从第一阶段第 114 步的检查点出发，并使用全新的优化器进行初始化。我们采用在第二阶段混合数据上额外进行 20 次更新后得到的检查点。两个阶段均使用分布在 32 个计算节点上的 128 块 GPU。

items.en: We train an alignment teacher that has superior chat capabilities and is well calibrated with human preferences. We train this teacher primarily using RLHF. First, we train a new variant of the Nemotron 3 Ultra GenRM that is trained with a reasoning length penalty to be more token efficient. Combined with MTP inference, it enables substantially faster training. We then conduct policy training in a similar manner to Nemotron 3 Ultra. However, rather than doing self-comparison in a cyclical format, we instead compare all policy responses to a fixed response from a strong open-source model, Gemma 4 31B-it. We also use the mean of per-rubric scores to evaluate responses instead of an overall score. Our training blend is similar to Nemotron 3 Ultra but includes newly collected preference data, updated model identity and capabilities data, and has more emphasis on addressing language mixing. We mix this RLHF training with the abstention training strategy from Nemotron 3 Ultra and use a small amount of reasoning length penalty. We evaluate downstream policy improvements on our internal chat benchmark.
items.zh: 我们训练了一个对齐教师（alignment teacher），它具备更优的对话能力，并且与人类偏好良好校准。我们主要使用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）来训练该教师。首先，我们训练了 Nemotron 3 Ultra GenRM 的一个新变体，该变体在训练中加入了推理长度惩罚，以提升 token 效率。结合 MTP 推理，它能够显著加快训练速度。随后，我们以与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 类似的方式进行策略训练。然而，我们不再以循环形式进行自我比较，而是将所有策略回复与一个强开源模型 Gemma 4 31B-it 的固定回复进行比较。我们还使用各评分项（rubric）得分的均值来评估回复，而非使用总体得分。我们的训练数据混合方式与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 类似，但加入了新收集的偏好数据、更新后的模型身份与能力数据，并更加侧重于解决语言混用问题。我们将该 RLHF 训练与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 中的弃答（abstention）训练策略相结合，并使用少量推理长度惩罚。我们在内部对话基准上评估下游策略的改进。

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Super included a multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) stage after RL which distills the capabilities of the specialized teachers of the preceding subsections into a single student model similar to the development of Nemotron 3 Ultra; the final MTP boosting phase (Section 3.7) then runs on the MOPD output. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, however, did not have an MOPD stage. In this section we detail the MOPD process for Nemotron 3.5 Super. The student is the RL checkpoint of Section 3.2 after 120 steps, the same checkpoint the teachers were branched from. Given a prompt from some domain, the student generates a response; for each token \(x\) with context \(c\) (the prompt and preceding tokens), the teacher that owns the domain is consulted for its probability \(p_{T}(x\mid c)\), and the student is updated to raise the probability of tokens the teacher rates higher than it does and to lower it for tokens the teacher rates lower. Concretely, let \(\pi_{S}\) be the student with parameters \(\theta\), \(\pi_{T}\) the domain teacher, and \(c_{t}\) the context of token \(y_{t}\) in the student’s response \(y\). The student minimizes the reverse KL \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{S}(\cdot|c_{t})\,\|\,\pi_{T}(\cdot|c_{t}))\) at every position of its own responses, using the token-local update and treating the sampled contexts as fixed during each update,
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 在强化学习（RL）之后包含一个多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）阶段，该阶段将前几小节中专门教师的能力蒸馏到一个单一的学生模型中，类似于 Nemotron 3 Ultra 的开发；最后的 MTP 提升阶段（第 3.7 节）则在 MOPD 的输出上运行。然而，Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 没有 MOPD 阶段。在本节中，我们详细介绍了 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的 MOPD 过程。学生模型是第 3.2 节中经过 120 步后的 RL 检查点，也是教师模型分支出来的同一检查点。给定来自某个领域的提示，学生生成一个响应；对于每个标记 \(x\) 及其上下文 \(c\)（提示和前面的标记），咨询拥有该领域的教师以获得其概率 \(p_{T}(x\mid c)\)，并更新学生以提高教师评价高于学生的标记的概率，降低教师评价低于学生的标记的概率。具体来说，设 \(\pi_{S}\) 为参数为 \(\theta\) 的学生，\(\pi_{T}\) 为领域教师，\(c_{t}\) 为学生响应 \(y\) 中标记 \(y_{t}\) 的上下文。学生在其自身响应的每个位置最小化反向 KL 散度 \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{S}(\cdot|c_{t})\,\|\,\pi_{T}(\cdot|c_{t}))\)，使用标记局部更新，并在每次更新时将采样的上下文视为固定，

items.en: where \(\bar{\pi}_{S}\) is the frozen snapshot of the student taken before the update (parameters \(\bar{\theta}\)), \(\mathrm{sg}[\cdot]\) denotes stop-gradient, and the expectation is over fresh responses sampled from \(\bar{\pi}_{S}\) with the update evaluated at \(\theta=\bar{\theta}\). Every generated token receives a dense advantage from a single teacher forward pass, with no verifier and no sampling from the teacher; the direct contribution is zero where student and teacher agree, so the signal concentrates where the student departs from the specialist. In practice training is asynchronous and responses may come from the previous snapshot \(\bar{\pi}_{S-1}\), i.e. one step stale; following the Ultra recipe, tokens are then importance-weighted by \(\bar{\pi}_{S}/\bar{\pi}_{S-1}\) and those with weights outside \([0.2,5]\) are masked. These token-level weights correct action probabilities at the sampled contexts; context-distribution mismatch and masking introduce bias. Only student-generated tokens enter the loss.
items.zh: 其中 \(\bar{\pi}_{S}\) 是更新前学生的冻结快照（参数 \(\bar{\theta}\)），\(\mathrm{sg}[\cdot]\) 表示停止梯度，期望是在从 \(\bar{\pi}_{S}\) 采样的新响应上，更新在 \(\theta=\bar{\theta}\) 处评估。每个生成的标记从单次教师前向传播中获得密集优势，无需验证器，也无需从教师采样；在学生和教师一致的地方直接贡献为零，因此信号集中在学生偏离专家教师的地方。在实践中，训练是异步的，响应可能来自前一个快照 \(\bar{\pi}_{S-1}\)，即滞后一步；遵循 Ultra 配方，标记随后通过 \(\bar{\pi}_{S}/\bar{\pi}_{S-1}\) 进行重要性加权，权重在 \([0.2,5]\) 之外的标记被掩码。这些标记级权重校正了采样上下文中的动作概率；上下文分布不匹配和掩码会引入偏差。只有学生生成的标记进入损失。

items.en: MOPD for Nemotron 3.5 Super is run in two stages on 128 GB200 nodes. We found that benchmarks improve at different rates under distillation, and that some peak within a few steps and then decline with further training. To mitigate this, stage 1 is weighted toward the domains that improve quickly and tend to regress later, and stage 2 toward the domains that improve more slowly. Prompts come from the environments used to train each teacher and are routed to that teacher; environments no specialist owns are routed to a self-anchor, a frozen copy of the student’s starting checkpoint, which provides no signal while the student still matches it and regularizes departures from it.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 的 MOPD 在 128 个 GB200 节点上分两个阶段运行。我们发现，在蒸馏下基准测试以不同速率提升，有些在几步内达到峰值然后随着进一步训练而下降。为了缓解这一点，阶段 1 偏向于提升快且后期容易退化的领域，阶段 2 偏向于提升较慢的领域。提示来自用于训练每个教师的环境，并路由到该教师；没有专家拥有的环境被路由到一个自锚点，即学生起始检查点的冻结副本，当学生仍与其匹配时不提供信号，并正则化偏离它的行为。

items.en: The student is the RL checkpoint. It is distilled from the agentic, reasoning, alignment (RLHF) and vision tool-use teachers with prompt shares of 35%, 25%, 20% and 15%, plus 5% routed to the RL checkpoint as self-anchor. Batches contain 512 prompts with one rollout each, generation is capped at 48K tokens in a 128K context, and the learning rate is \(2\times 10^{-6}\). We take the checkpoint after 30 steps as the stage-1 model.
items.zh: 学生是 RL 检查点。它从智能体式、推理、对齐（RLHF）和视觉工具使用教师中蒸馏，提示份额分别为 35%、25%、20% 和 15%，加上 5% 路由到 RL 检查点作为自锚点。批次包含 512 个提示，每个提示一个 rollout，生成在 128K 上下文中上限为 48K 标记，学习率为 \(2\times 10^{-6}\)。我们取 30 步后的检查点作为阶段 1 模型。

items.en: Stage 2 targets chat quality (e.g. LMArena-style evaluations) and the vision domains, which improved more slowly in stage 1 than the agentic and reasoning benchmarks. The stage-1 model is the student and self-anchor. The agentic and reasoning teachers are retired and their environments folded into the self-anchor stream, so the student is regularized toward the stage-1 model on them rather than distilled again. Four specialists are distilled: the alignment teacher, the vision tool-use teacher, a vision-reasoning teacher, and the video reasoning and tracking teacher of Section 3.4.1, with shares of 30%, 20%, 20% and 20%, plus 10% self-anchor. Batches grow to 1,024 prompts, generation may use the full 128K context, the learning rate is \(3\times 10^{-6}\), and the stage runs for 40 steps, one pass over its prompts.
items.zh: 阶段 2 针对聊天质量（例如 LMArena 风格的评估）和视觉领域，这些在阶段 1 中比智能体式和推理基准提升更慢。阶段 1 模型是学生和自锚点。智能体式和推理教师被退役，其环境并入自锚点流，因此学生在这两个领域上被正则化向阶段 1 模型，而不是再次蒸馏。四个专家被蒸馏：对齐教师、视觉工具使用教师、视觉推理教师，以及第 3.4.1 节的视频推理和跟踪教师，份额分别为 30%、20%、20% 和 20%，加上 10% 自锚点。批次增加到 1,024 个提示，生成可以使用完整的 128K 上下文，学习率为 \(3\times 10^{-6}\)，阶段运行 40 步，对其提示进行一次遍历。

items.en: In stage 2 the distillation target is smoothed with the proximal-teacher construction of trust-region policy distillation (see also ): the teacher in Equation 2 is replaced by the frozen mixture \(\alpha\,\pi_{T}+(1-\alpha)\,\bar{\pi}_{S}\) with \(\alpha=0.2\). This bounds the advantage below by \(\log(1-\alpha)\approx-0.22\), so tokens the teacher considers very unlikely receive a bounded negative signal rather than an unbounded one, which stabilizes training once the student has already absorbed one round of teachers. Stage 1 uses \(\alpha=1\).
items.zh: 在第二阶段，蒸馏目标通过信任域策略蒸馏的近端教师构造进行平滑（另见）：公式 2 中的教师被替换为冻结的混合分布 \(\alpha\,\pi_{T}+(1-\alpha)\,\bar{\pi}_{S}\)，其中 \(\alpha=0.2\)。这将优势下界限制为 \(\log(1-\alpha)\approx-0.22\)，因此教师认为极不可能的 token 会收到有界的负信号而非无界信号，一旦学生已经吸收了一轮教师的知识，这就能稳定训练。第一阶段使用 \(\alpha=1\)。

items.en: Teachers run as independent, non-colocated inference fleets (tensor parallel 8, expert parallel 8) sized to each domain’s share and sequence length, and score trajectories as they arrive, so rollout generation, teacher scoring and student optimization form a pipeline in NeMo-RL. The MTP heads are trained jointly with the language model throughout (Section 3.7).
items.zh: 教师作为独立、非并置的推理集群运行（张量并行 8，专家并行 8），其规模根据每个领域的份额和序列长度进行调整，并在轨迹到达时进行评分，因此 rollout 生成、教师评分和学生优化在 NeMo-RL 中形成一个流水线。MTP 头在整个过程中与语言模型联合训练（第 3.7 节）。

items.en: We apply a dedicated MTP-only training recipe at two points: first as a short warm start from the Nemotron 3.5 Super SFT checkpoint, and again after all backbone post-training stages are complete. We refer to the latter phase as MTP boosting. For Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, we skip the warm start and apply only MTP boosting. In both runs, the backbone remains frozen and only the MTP head parameters are updated.
items.zh: 我们在两个时间点应用一套专门的、仅针对 MTP 的训练配方：首先从 Nemotron 3.5 Super SFT 检查点进行短暂的 warm start，然后在所有主干后训练阶段完成后再次应用。我们将后一阶段称为 MTP boosting。对于 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，我们跳过 warm start，仅应用 MTP boosting。在两次运行中，主干保持冻结，仅更新 MTP 头参数。

items.en: The recipe has two complementary components. First, we continue applying the hidden-state-mixing strategy described in Section 2.1. This further exposes the MTP head to inference-like conditions, reducing the train–inference mismatch and improving acceptance at longer draft lengths. Second, whereas the preceding MTP training stages use cross-entropy loss, these runs use a knowledge-distillation loss with the frozen backbone as the teacher. This teacher-distribution supervision improves alignment between the MTP head and the backbone and is particularly beneficial under non-greedy sampling.
items.zh: 该配方包含两个互补组件。第一，我们继续应用第 2.1 节所述的隐藏状态混合策略。这进一步使 MTP 头暴露于类推理条件，减少训练–推理不匹配，并提高较长草稿长度下的接受率。第二，此前的 MTP 训练阶段使用交叉熵损失，而这些运行使用以冻结主干为教师的知识蒸馏损失。这种教师分布监督改善了 MTP 头与主干之间的对齐，在非贪婪采样下尤其有益。

items.en: In order to measure MTP draft quality we report evaluation results on the SPEED-Bench qualitative split using per-sample acceptance length (AL).
items.zh: 为了衡量 MTP 草稿质量，我们报告在 SPEED-Bench 定性划分上使用每样本接受长度（AL）的评估结果。

items.en: We generate on-policy rollouts using the corresponding backbone checkpoint. Seed prompts are drawn from Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2[11] and Nemotron-RL-Super-Training-Blends[12] to cover general-purpose and agentic inputs, respectively. We sample rollouts at \(temp=1\), cap sequences at 8K tokens, and accumulate the loss only over assistant-response tokens.
items.zh: 我们使用相应的主干检查点生成 on-policy rollout。种子提示分别来自 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2[11] 和 Nemotron-RL-Super-Training-Blends[12]，以覆盖通用和智能体式输入。我们以 \(temp=1\) 采样 rollout，将序列上限设为 8K tokens，并仅在助手响应 token 上累积损失。

items.en: We first train the MTP head for \(4k\) steps from the Nemotron 3.5 Super SFT checkpoint. This intermediate run plateaus after substantially fewer training iterations than the final-checkpoint run. When transferred to the final post-trained checkpoint, the resulting MTP head retains significant part of its acceptance-length improvement, as shown in Table 8.
