We therefore use the SFT-trained MTP head to initialize the final MTP boosting phase and train it for an additional \(25k\) steps against the final Nemotron 3.5 Super backbone. For Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, we ran MTP boosting for \(48k\) steps against the final backbone. Whereas Nemotron 3 Ultra uses a temperature-scaled forward-KL objective, we now use the LK loss.
items.zh: 我们首先从 Nemotron 3.5 Super SFT 检查点训练 MTP 头 \(4k\) 步。与最终检查点运行相比，这一中间运行在明显更少的训练迭代后即进入平台期。当迁移到最终后训练检查点时，所得的 MTP 头保留了其接受长度改进的显著部分，如表 8 所示。因此，我们使用 SFT 训练的 MTP 头来初始化最终的 MTP boosting 阶段，并针对最终的 Nemotron 3.5 Super 主干再训练 \(25k\) 步。对于 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，我们针对最终主干运行了 \(48k\) 步的 MTP boosting。Nemotron 3 Ultra 使用温度缩放的前向 KL 目标，而我们现在使用 LK 损失。

items.en: The Boosted-MTP head improves over the original MTP at every draft position (Figure 6), with the largest gains at deeper positions, where the train–inference mismatch is most severe: at inference, these positions condition on the head's own hidden states rather than on the backbone's. These per-position gains translate into higher AL in every SPEED-Bench category (Table 9), raising the average AL at \(T=1\) from 3.78 to 4.61 accepted tokens.
items.zh: Boosted-MTP 头在每个草稿位置上均优于原始 MTP（图 6），且在更深的层位置上增益最大，因为这些位置的训练–推理不匹配最为严重：在推理时，这些位置以该头自身的隐藏状态为条件，而非以主干网络的隐藏状态为条件。这些逐位置增益转化为 SPEED-Bench 每个类别中更高的 AL（表 9），将 \(T=1\) 时的平均 AL 从 3.78 个被接受词元提升至 4.61 个被接受词元。

items.en: We evaluate Nemotron 3.5 Super on a comprehensive suite of benchmarks spanning agentic capabilities, reasoning and knowledge, multimodal, conversational ability and instruction following, long-context understanding, and multilingual performance. All evaluation results for Nemotron 3.5 Super and baselines were collected via Nemo Gym^13 (https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym). For reproducibility purposes, more details on the evaluation settings can be found in the Nemo Gym recipes folder and the corresponding reproducibility tutorial^14 (https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/main/nemotron_recipes/super-3.5/reproducibility.md).
items.zh: 我们在涵盖智能体式能力、推理与知识、多模态、对话能力与指令遵循、长上下文理解以及多语言性能的综合基准套件上评估 Nemotron 3.5 Super。Nemotron 3.5 Super 与基线的所有评估结果均通过 Nemo Gym^13（https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym）收集。为保证可复现性，关于评估设置的更多细节可在 Nemo Gym 的 recipes 文件夹及相应的可复现性教程^14（https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/main/nemotron_recipes/super-3.5/reproducibility.md）中找到。

items.en: The following benchmarks are not yet onboarded in our open-source tools, and for these we used either their official open-source implementation or otherwise an internal scaffolding that we plan to open source in the future: BabyVision, CharXiv-RQ, MathVision, MMLongBench-Doc, OCR-Reasoning, OCRBench-v2, V*, Video-MME-v2. NV Chat Benchmark is an internal chat benchmark developed at NVIDIA.
items.zh: 以下基准尚未接入我们的开源工具，对于这些基准，我们使用了其官方开源实现，或使用我们计划未来开源的内部脚手架：BabyVision、CharXiv-RQ、MathVision、MMLongBench-Doc、OCR-Reasoning、OCRBench-v2、V*、Video-MME-v2。NV Chat Benchmark 是 NVIDIA 内部开发的对话基准。

items.en: All models were evaluated under the same evaluation settings, including agentic resources (CPU compute and timeouts, tools, search APIs), input data, prompt templates, number of repeats, and extraction/metric implementation. Inference parameters such as temperature and top_p, and the maximum number of tokens, were directly extracted from the recommendations of the corresponding model cards.
items.zh: 所有模型均在相同的评估设置下进行评估，包括智能体式资源（CPU 算力与超时、工具、搜索 API）、输入数据、提示模板、重复次数以及抽取/指标实现。温度、top_p 等推理参数以及最大 token 数直接取自相应模型卡的推荐值。

items.en: We evaluate agentic capabilities using SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro for software engineering; Terminal-Bench 2.1 for terminal-based task execution; the Retail, Airline, and Telecom domains of \(\tau^{2}\)-Bench and the Banking domain of \(\tau^{3}\)-Bench for conversational tool use; GDPVal for economically valuable real-world workplace tasks; and BrowseComp for web browsing and information seeking. All SWE-bench variants run in the OpenCode harness^15 (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) inside a sandbox with web search and web fetch disabled, and we report the resolve rate averaged over three runs. Terminal-Bench 2.1 uses the Terminus 2 harness and is averaged over eight runs. All \(\tau\)-Bench domains are averaged over eight trials. The \(\tau^{2}\)-Bench domains use Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 as the user simulator; in the Banking domain the agent retrieves from the bank's knowledge base with BM25 and grep tools, and GPT-5.4-mini acts as the user simulator.
items.zh: 我们使用 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual 和 SWE-bench Pro 评估软件工程方面的智能体式能力；使用 Terminal-Bench 2.1 评估基于终端的任务执行；使用 \(\tau^{2}\)-Bench 的 Retail、Airline 和 Telecom 领域以及 \(\tau^{3}\)-Bench 的 Banking 领域评估对话式工具使用；使用 GDPVal 评估具有经济价值的真实职场任务；使用 BrowseComp 评估网页浏览与信息检索。所有 SWE-bench 变体均在 OpenCode 测试框架^15（https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode）中运行，处于禁用网页搜索与网页抓取的沙箱内，我们报告三次运行的平均解决率。Terminal-Bench 2.1 使用 Terminus 2 测试框架，取八次运行的平均值。所有 \(\tau\)-Bench 领域均取八次试验的平均值。\(\tau^{2}\)-Bench 各领域使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 作为用户模拟器；在 Banking 领域中，智能体使用 BM25 和 grep 工具从银行知识库中检索，并由 GPT-5.4-mini 充当用户模拟器。

items.en: Our open-source implementation of GDPVal loosely follows the AA v2.1 methodology, using the same sandboxing environment with respect to Python and system packages, and a Stirrup agent. The reference committee includes a subset of the models from the AA leaderboard for which the reference files were collected independently (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Inkling Small, GLM-5.1, Kimi K2.6, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, GPT-OSS-120b, Gemma 4 26B-A4B, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507). The judge committee is the same as the one described in the AA methodology (GPT-5.6 Sol, medium reasoning; Gemini 3.8 Flash, high reasoning; and Claude Opus 5, high effort).
items.zh: 我们的 GDPVal 开源实现大致遵循 AA v2.1 方法，使用与 Python 及系统软件包方面相同的沙箱环境，以及 Stirrup 智能体。参考委员会包含 AA 排行榜中部分模型的子集，其参考文件系独立收集（DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Inkling Small、GLM-5.1、Kimi K2.6、Nemotron 3 Ultra、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、GPT-OSS-120b、Gemma 4 26B-A4B、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507）。评审委员会与 AA 方法中所述相同（GPT-5.6 Sol，中等推理；Gemini 3.8 Flash，高推理；以及 Claude Opus 5，高投入）。

items.en: BrowseComp lacks a standardized harness, and scores vary substantially with search provider, browsing tools, context management, and step budget. We therefore evaluate all models on a single open-source harness released in NeMo Gym. The harness provides search and browse tools backed by Exa (deep mode) and stores retrieved pages in a per-sample workspace accessible through a read-only shell tool. Context is managed with a discard-all policy: when the conversation exceeds a token threshold, prior turns are dropped and the model maintains progress across resets via a memory tool. We additionally report BrowseComp on an OpenCode-based harness (with minor tool-configuration changes) under identical serving settings for all models, and observe that Nemotron 3.5 Super’s performance transfers to this second harness as well.
items.zh: BrowseComp 缺乏标准化的测试框架，其得分会因搜索提供商、浏览工具、上下文管理和步数预算的不同而显著变化。因此，我们在 NeMo Gym 中发布的一个单一开源测试框架上评估所有模型。该框架提供由 Exa（深度模式）支持的搜索和浏览工具，并将检索到的页面存储在每个样本的工作区中，可通过只读 shell 工具访问。上下文采用丢弃所有策略进行管理：当对话超过 token 阈值时，先前的轮次被丢弃，模型通过记忆工具在重置之间保持进度。我们还在基于 OpenCode 的测试框架（对工具配置做了细微更改）上报告 BrowseComp 结果，所有模型在相同的服务设置下运行，并观察到 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的性能也能迁移到第二个测试框架上。

items.en: We evaluate code generation using LiveCodeBench v6 for competitive programming and SciCode for scientific research coding. For LiveCodeBench, we use the 454 problems released between August 2024 and May 2025, prompt the model to solve them without tools, and report pass@1 averaged over three samples. SciCode contains 65 research problems written by scientists and decomposed into 288 subproblems; we include the scientist-provided background in the prompt and average over eight repeats. We report both subtask accuracy, the fraction of subproblems whose generated code passes its tests, and problem accuracy, the fraction of problems for which all subproblems pass.
items.zh: 我们使用 LiveCodeBench v6 评估竞赛编程中的代码生成，并使用 SciCode 评估科学研究编码。对于 LiveCodeBench，我们使用 2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 5 月间发布的 454 个问题，提示模型在不使用工具的情况下解决它们，并报告三次样本平均的 pass@1。SciCode 包含 65 个由科学家撰写的研究问题，并分解为 288 个子问题；我们在提示中包含科学家提供的背景信息，并对八次重复取平均。我们报告子任务准确率（生成的代码通过其测试的子问题比例）和问题准确率（所有子问题都通过的问题比例）。

items.en: We evaluate mathematical and scientific reasoning using GPQA-Diamond for graduate-level science questions; Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) for expert-level questions at the frontier of human knowledge; MathArena Apex-Shortlist for competition mathematics; CritPt for research-level physics reasoning; and AA-Omniscience for factual knowledge and hallucination resistance. GPQA-Diamond is averaged over eight repeats and Apex-Shortlist over 16. Apex-Shortlist answers are checked by symbolic equivalence, and the model has no tool access. For HLE we report the 2,158 text-only questions here, both without tools and with tools. Without tools, answers are graded by GPT-5.6 Luna using the official HLE judge prompt. In the with-tools setting, Nemotron 3.5 Super can run Python code and search the web; this result comes from a separate internal harness. CritPt is scored with the official Artificial Analysis grading API, using five samples for each of its 70 problems. For AA-Omniscience, we use the 600-question public set, average over ten repeats, and grade with GPT-5.6 Luna. We report accuracy and the non-hallucination rate.
items.zh: 我们使用 GPQA-Diamond 评估研究生级别的科学问题；使用 Humanity’s Last Exam（HLE）评估人类知识前沿的专家级问题；使用 MathArena Apex-Shortlist 评估竞赛数学；使用 CritPt 评估研究级物理推理；使用 AA-Omniscience 评估事实知识和抗幻觉能力。GPQA-Diamond 取八次重复的平均值，Apex-Shortlist 取 16 次重复的平均值。Apex-Shortlist 的答案通过符号等价性检查，且模型无法使用工具。对于 HLE，我们在此报告 2,158 个纯文本问题，包括无工具和有工具两种设置。在无工具设置下，答案由 GPT-5.6 Luna 使用官方 HLE 评判提示进行评分。在有工具设置下，Nemotron 3.5 Super 可以运行 Python 代码并搜索网络；此结果来自一个单独的内部测试框架。CritPt 使用官方 Artificial Analysis 评分 API 进行评分，对其 70 个问题中的每个问题使用五个样本。对于 AA-Omniscience，我们使用 600 个问题的公开集，取十次重复的平均值，并使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 评分。我们报告准确率和非幻觉率。

items.en: We evaluate multimodal understanding across visual reasoning, charts, documents and OCR, video, and computer use. We use BabyVision for basic visual reasoning; CharXiv reasoning questions for scientific chart understanding; MathVision for mathematical reasoning in visual contexts; OCR-Reasoning and OCRBench v2, the latter with separate English and Chinese scores, for text-rich image understanding; V* for fine-grained visual search in high-resolution images; Video-MME-v2 for video understanding; MMLongBench-Doc for long multi-page document understanding; the full HLE set, including image-based questions; and OSWorld-Verified for computer-use agents. Unless noted otherwise, results are averaged over three repeats. Free-form answers are extracted or graded by an LLM judge: GPT-4o-mini for BabyVision, MathVision, and OCR-Reasoning, Claude Opus 4.7 for CharXiv, GPT-4o for MMLongBench-Doc, and GPT-3.5-Turbo for answer extraction on V*. OCRBench v2 and Video-MME-v2 use rule-based scoring. V* is evaluated as static multiple choice without a visual search tool. Video-MME-v2 is evaluated without subtitles. MMLongBench-Doc provides up to 100 rendered pages per document, one image per page. HLE (full) covers all 2,500 questions with a single sample, graded by GPT-5.6 Luna. For OSWorld-Verified, we run the 361 tasks that do not require Google Drive access on cloud-hosted desktop virtual machines. The agent observes screenshots only, acts through pyautogui commands, and has up to 100 steps per task. We report the average task score, which includes partial credit, over three runs.
items.zh: 我们评估多模态理解，涵盖视觉推理、图表、文档和 OCR、视频以及计算机使用。我们使用 BabyVision 进行基础视觉推理；使用 CharXiv 推理问题进行科学图表理解；使用 MathVision 进行视觉情境下的数学推理；使用 OCR-Reasoning 和 OCRBench v2（后者分别报告英文和中文分数）进行文本丰富图像理解；使用 V* 进行高分辨率图像中的细粒度视觉搜索；使用 Video-MME-v2 进行视频理解；使用 MMLongBench-Doc 进行长多页文档理解；使用完整的 HLE 集（包括基于图像的问题）；以及使用 OSWorld-Verified 评估计算机使用智能体。除非另有说明，结果取三次重复的平均值。自由形式的答案由 LLM 评判器提取或评分：BabyVision、MathVision 和 OCR-Reasoning 使用 GPT-4o-mini，CharXiv 使用 Claude Opus 4.7，MMLongBench-Doc 使用 GPT-4o，V* 的答案提取使用 GPT-3.5-Turbo。OCRBench v2 和 Video-MME-v2 使用基于规则的评分。V* 在没有视觉搜索工具的情况下作为静态多项选择题进行评估。Video-MME-v2 在没有字幕的情况下进行评估。MMLongBench-Doc 每个文档最多提供 100 个渲染页面，每页一张图像。HLE（完整）涵盖所有 2,500 个问题，使用单一样本，由 GPT-5.6 Luna 评分。对于 OSWorld-Verified，我们在云托管的桌面虚拟机上运行 361 个不需要 Google Drive 访问的任务。智能体仅观察截图，通过 pyautogui 命令行动，每个任务最多 100 步。我们报告三次运行的平均任务分数，其中包括部分分数。

items.en: We evaluate long-context understanding with AA-LCR and GraphWalks. AA-LCR (v1.1) contains 100 questions that require reasoning across sets of real-world documents totaling about 100K tokens. We average over 16 repeats and grade answers with GPT-5.6 Luna following the official protocol. GraphWalks gives the model a graph as an edge list in the prompt and asks for the result of a breadth-first search or for the parents of a node. We include both task types across all context-length buckets and keep the 950 of 1,150 prompts that fit within 1M tokens; all models are scored on the same 950 prompts. The score is the F1 between the predicted and reference node sets, from a single sample.
items.zh: 我们使用 AA-LCR 和 GraphWalks 评估长上下文理解。AA-LCR（v1.1）包含 100 个问题，需要对总计约 100K token 的真实文档集进行推理。我们取 16 次重复的平均值，并按照官方协议使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 对答案进行评分。GraphWalks 在提示中以边列表的形式向模型提供图，并要求给出广度优先搜索的结果或节点的父节点。我们包括所有上下文长度桶中的两种任务类型，并保留 1,150 个提示中适合 1M token 的 950 个；所有模型在相同的 950 个提示上评分。分数是预测节点集和参考节点集之间的 F1，来自单一样本。

items.en: We assess instruction following with IFBench, which measures how well models generalize to 58 new, out-of-domain verifiable output constraints. We report the fraction of constraints satisfied per prompt under strict verification, averaged over prompts and eight samples. NV Chat Benchmark measures chat preference as a win rate in pairwise comparisons. It covers 3,713 prompts, and each prompt has an opponent response drawn from human-preference battles. Gemini 3.1 Pro judges each pair in both presentation orders, with style control based on response length. In addition, Table 11 reports Text Arena Elo ratings derived from human pairwise preference votes, for all prompts and for English prompts only, with and without style control.
items.zh: 我们使用 IFBench 评估指令遵循能力，该基准衡量模型对 58 个新的、域外可验证输出约束的泛化程度。我们报告在严格验证下每个提示所满足约束的比例，并在提示和八个样本上取平均。NV Chat Benchmark 以成对比较中的胜率来衡量聊天偏好。它涵盖 3,713 个提示，每个提示都有一个来自人类偏好对战的对手回复。Gemini 3.1 Pro 以两种呈现顺序对每一对进行评判，并基于回复长度进行风格控制。此外，表 11 报告了源自人类成对偏好投票的 Text Arena Elo 评分，涵盖所有提示和仅英文提示，并分别给出有风格控制和无风格控制的结果。

items.en: We evaluate multilingual capabilities using MMLU-ProX for multilingual knowledge and reasoning and WMT24++ for machine translation. For MMLU-ProX, we report accuracy averaged over ten languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, Portuguese, and Korean. For WMT24++, we translate from English into the nine non-English languages of this set and report reference-based XCOMET-XXL scores, macro-averaged over language pairs.
items.zh: 我们使用 MMLU-ProX 评估多语言知识与推理能力，并使用 WMT24++ 评估机器翻译能力。对于 MMLU-ProX，我们报告在十种语言上取平均的准确率：英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、日语、中文、印地语、葡萄牙语和韩语。对于 WMT24++，我们将英语翻译为该集合中的九种非英语语言，并报告基于参考的 XCOMET-XXL 分数，在语言对上取宏平均。

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Super is trained for three reasoning modes: reasoning-off, regular and medium-effort. The regular and medium-effort reasoning modes have the option to be used in conjunction with inference-time budget control. These combinations of controls provide flexibilities that cover the entire spectrum of accuracy-efficiency trade-off to meet customers' needs in various application scenarios.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 针对三种推理模式进行训练：关闭推理、常规推理与中等投入推理。常规推理模式与中等投入推理模式可选择与推理时预算控制结合使用。这些控制方式的组合提供了灵活性，覆盖了精度—效率权衡的完整谱系，以满足客户在各种应用场景中的需求。

items.en: The medium-effort reasoning mode is introduced during the SFT stage, with data generated by Kimi K3's low-effort mode, and later optimized during the RL stage. Following the same recipe as Nemotron 3 Ultra, the reasoning traces of a small fraction of SFT data are truncated to random reasoning budgets while the responses remain the same and with </think> tokens masked from training loss, to prepare the model for inference-time budget control. Approximately 4% of the RL training prompts are in the medium-effort mode and they cover math, STEM and coding, and length-based adjustments are applied on the RL rewards for them. This is the same recipe that has trained Nemotron 3 Ultra and Super and the effects of effort-level optimization generalize to a variety of tasks beyond math, STEM and coding. Nemotron 3.5 Super's medium-effort mode uses around 2.2X less tokens than the regular mode, averaged over the benchmarks in Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, at the cost of approximately 9% drop in accuracy.
items.zh: 中等投入推理模式在 SFT 阶段引入，其数据由 Kimi K3 的低投入模式生成，随后在 RL 阶段进行优化。沿用与 Nemotron 3 Ultra 相同的配方，对一小部分 SFT 数据的推理轨迹按随机推理预算进行截断，同时保持响应不变，并在训练损失中屏蔽 </think> token，以使模型为推理时预算控制做好准备。约 4% 的 RL 训练提示处于中等投入模式，覆盖数学、STEM 与编程，并对其 RL 奖励施加基于长度的调整。这与训练 Nemotron 3 Ultra 和 Super 所用的配方相同，且投入级别优化的效果可泛化到数学、STEM 与编程之外的多种任务。在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 的各基准上平均而言，Nemotron 3.5 Super 的中等投入模式所用 token 比常规模式少约 2.2 倍，代价是精度下降约 9%。

items.capEn: Figure 7: Accuracy–compute trade-off on SWE-bench Pro. We evaluate each model, record the resulting agent trajectories, and use the captured traces to benchmark task throughput (tasks per hour). The vertical axis reports Pass@1 accuracy averaged over three evaluation runs. The horizontal axis report

full.secZh: 3.10 跨智能体框架的智能体式编码

items.en: It is important for the model to not "overfit" into one single harness. We evaluate Nemotron 3.5 Super across six agent harnesses on SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.1. Figure 8 compares the observed scores under each harness's standard configuration. Claude Code achieves the highest observed score on SWE-bench Pro (49.45%), while Codex achieves the highest observed score on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (61.80%). The ordering of harnesses differs between benchmarks, highlighting the importance of reporting the harness and its configuration alongside model results.
items.zh: 模型不应“过拟合”到单一智能体框架上，这一点很重要。我们在 SWE-bench Pro 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，跨六个智能体框架对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 进行了评估。图 8 比较了各框架标准配置下的观测得分。Claude Code 在 SWE-bench Pro 上取得最高观测得分(49.45%)，而 Codex 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上取得最高观测得分(61.80%)。各框架的排序在两个基准之间并不一致，这凸显了在报告模型结果的同时报告所用框架及其配置的重要性。

items.capEn: Figure 8: Nemotron 3.5 Super performance across six agent harnesses on SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.1, using unmodified harness system prompts and standard configurations. For SWE-bench Pro, Git history is removed and a user instruction prohibits cheating or seeking online resources.

full.sec: 3.11 Test-Time Scaling through Parallel Agents and Self-Verification
full.secZh: 3.11 通过并行智能体与自我验证的测试时扩展

items.en: We further improve the final model's agentic performance through parallel agents followed by self-verification. For each task, \(N\) independent instances of the same post-trained agent attempt the task, producing a pool of candidate trajectories. These agents can execute in parallel without inter-agent communication. The same checkpoint then serves as a verifier, selecting one candidate using LLM-as-a-Verifier (LAV). This requires neither additional parameter updates nor a separately trained verifier.
items.zh: 我们通过并行智能体及随后的自我验证，进一步提升了最终模型的智能体式性能。对于每个任务，同一后训练智能体的 \(N\) 个独立实例尝试该任务，产生一个候选轨迹池。这些智能体可以并行执行，无需智能体间通信。然后，同一个检查点作为验证器，使用 LLM-as-a-Verifier（LAV）选择一个候选。这既不需要额外的参数更新，也不需要单独训练的验证器。

items.en: To illustrate the selection process, consider Terminal-Bench 2.1, where each task has five candidate trajectories. The verifier receives the task description and a pair of trajectories, and evaluates them against three criteria: specification adherence, output match, and error signal detection. These criteria assess whether the agent meets the task's explicit requirements, whether its observed terminal output supports successful completion, and whether unresolved errors remain. Each evaluation focuses on one criterion and assigns a separate grade distribution to each trajectory. Following LAV, we use a 20-level grading scale represented by single-token labels A–T, ordered from best to worst. We compute each trajectory's score as the probability-weighted average over these grades, normalized to \([0,1]\), rather than selecting a single discrete grade.
items.zh: 为了说明选择过程，以 Terminal-Bench 2.1 为例，每个任务有五个候选轨迹。验证器接收任务描述和一对轨迹，并根据三个标准评估它们：规范遵循性、输出匹配和错误信号检测。这些标准评估智能体是否满足任务的明确要求、其观察到的终端输出是否支持成功完成，以及是否仍有未解决的错误。每次评估聚焦于一个标准，并为每个轨迹分配单独的等级分布。遵循 LAV，我们使用由单个 token 标签 A–T 表示的 20 级评分量表，从最好到最差排序。我们将每个轨迹的分数计算为这些等级的概率加权平均值，并归一化到 \([0,1]\)，而不是选择单个离散等级。

items.en: For each compared pair and criterion, we evaluate both presentation orders (once with trajectory \(i\) first and \(j\) second, and once with their positions reversed; \(K=2\)). We align the resulting scores with the original candidate identities and average across both orders and all three criteria to mitigate presentation-order bias and evaluation noise. Each compared pair therefore receives six evaluations of the same two trajectories, without generating additional agent rollouts. The resulting pair-specific scores \(R_{i}\) and \(R_{j}\) are converted into a preference probability using the Bradley–Terry model \(p_{ij}=1/(1+\exp(-(R_{i}-R_{j})))\).
items.zh: 对于每个比较对和标准，我们评估两种呈现顺序（一次轨迹 \(i\) 在前、\(j\) 在后，另一次位置互换；\(K=2\)）。我们将得到的分数与原始候选身份对齐，并对两种顺序和所有三个标准取平均，以减轻呈现顺序偏差和评估噪声。因此，每个比较对获得对相同两个轨迹的六次评估，而无需生成额外的智能体 rollout。得到的对特定分数 \(R_{i}\) 和 \(R_{j}\) 使用 Bradley–Terry 模型 \(p_{ij}=1/(1+\exp(-(R_{i}-R_{j})))\) 转换为偏好概率。

items.en: These pairwise evaluations are organized using LAV's Probabilistic Pivot Tournament (PPT). For the five Terminal-Bench candidates, the tournament first compares neighboring candidates in a random ring, for example \((1,2)\), \((2,3)\), \((3,4)\), \((4,5)\), and \((5,1)\). The two candidates with the highest mean preference across their ring comparisons become pivots. Each of the remaining three candidates is then compared against both pivots, and the two pivots are compared with each other; cached evaluations are reused for identical directed comparisons. Finally, the preferences from both stages are aggregated, and the candidate with the highest mean preference across its comparisons is selected. Normalizing by the number of comparisons accounts for the pivots participating in more comparisons, and any of the five candidates can ultimately win.
items.zh: 这些成对评估使用 LAV 的概率枢轴锦标赛（PPT）组织。对于五个 Terminal-Bench 候选，锦标赛首先在随机环中比较相邻候选，例如 \((1,2)\)、\((2,3)\)、\((3,4)\)、\((4,5)\) 和 \((5,1)\)。在其环比较中平均偏好最高的两个候选成为枢轴。然后，其余三个候选中的每一个与两个枢轴比较，并且两个枢轴相互比较；对于相同的定向比较，重用缓存的评估。最后，聚合两个阶段的偏好，并选择在其比较中平均偏好最高的候选。通过比较次数归一化考虑了枢轴参与更多比较的情况，并且五个候选中的任何一个最终都可能获胜。

items.en: We apply the same procedure across all six benchmarks, using five candidate trajectories for Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE, and three for SWE-bench Verified, Pro, Multilingual, and BrowseComp. All benchmarks use three criteria and \(K=2\). Terminal-Bench and the three SWE-bench variants use two pivots, while DeepSWE and BrowseComp use one pivot. For BrowseComp, all reported metrics use the 400-problem subset used for our internal evaluation tracking, given the cost of evaluating the full benchmark.
items.zh: 我们在所有六个基准上应用相同的过程，对于 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 DeepSWE 使用五个候选轨迹，对于 SWE-bench Verified、Pro、Multilingual 和 BrowseComp 使用三个。所有基准使用三个标准和 \(K=2\)。Terminal-Bench 和三个 SWE-bench 变体使用两个枢轴，而 DeepSWE 和 BrowseComp 使用一个枢轴。对于 BrowseComp，鉴于评估完整基准的成本，所有报告的指标使用用于我们内部评估跟踪的 400 问题子集。

items.en: As shown in Fig. 9, selection improves observed accuracy across all six benchmarks. Terminal-Bench accuracy increases from 62.7% to 71.9%, DeepSWE from 24.6% to 34.5%, and BrowseComp from 71.5% to 79.8%—absolute gains of 9.2, 9.9, and 8.3 percentage points, respectively. SWE-bench Verified, Pro, and Multilingual improve by 1.1, 2.4, and 1.9 percentage points. On the BrowseComp subset, selection recovers approximately 70% of the gap between pass@1 and oracle best-of-three performance. These results demonstrate an inference-time path to higher task accuracy that complements post-training without changing model parameters.
items.zh: 如图 9 所示，选择机制在全部六个基准上均提升了观测准确率。Terminal-Bench 的准确率从 62.7% 提升至 71.9%，DeepSWE 从 24.6% 提升至 34.5%，BrowseComp 从 71.5% 提升至 79.8%——绝对增益分别为 9.2、9.9 和 8.3 个百分点。SWE-bench Verified、Pro 和 Multilingual 分别提升 1.1、2.4 和 1.9 个百分点。在 BrowseComp 子集上，选择机制弥补了 pass@1 与 oracle best-of-three 性能之间约 70% 的差距。这些结果表明，存在一条在推理阶段提升任务准确率的路径，它无需改变模型参数即可对后训练形成补充。

items.capEn: Figure 9: Test-time scaling with the final post-trained checkpoint. Blue bars show empirical pass@1, averaged over the candidate rollouts; green segments show the improvement from LAV selection, with total bar height indicating selected accuracy. Candidate-pool sizes are shown below each benchmark.

items.en: Post-training data drawn from many synthetic and curated sources can absorb benchmark content, not only as verbatim copies but also as paraphrases, translations, augmentations, and other derived samples that string matching misses. Such contamination inflates benchmark scores and, because the same benchmarks guide training monitoring and checkpoint selection, it can also result in a worse final model. We therefore performed checks of post-training data against 30 benchmarks (see the complete list in Appendix C.2) and removed samples related to benchmark questions. This data-side detection complements model-side detection with CoDeC, which probes a trained model for traces of a benchmark. The pipeline will be released as part of NeMo Curator.
items.zh: 来自许多合成和整理来源的后训练数据可能会吸收基准内容，不仅包括逐字复制，还包括字符串匹配无法捕捉的改写、翻译、增强和其他衍生样本。这种污染会夸大基准分数，并且由于相同的基准指导训练监控和检查点选择，它也可能导致最终模型更差。因此，我们对后训练数据进行了针对 30 个基准的检查（完整列表见附录 C.2），并删除了与基准问题相关的样本。这种数据侧检测补充了使用 CoDeC 的模型侧检测，后者探测训练模型以寻找基准的痕迹。该流程将作为 NeMo Curator 的一部分发布。

items.en: The pipeline combines two simple similarity signals, which select candidate matches with high recall, with an LLM judge, which verifies each candidate precisely. Every training sample passes through four stages:
items.zh: 该流程结合了两个简单的相似性信号（以高召回率选择候选匹配）和一个 LLM 评判器（精确验证每个候选）。每个训练样本经过四个阶段：

items.en: Normalization. The sample is reduced to its problem statement, the part into which a benchmark question could leak. Text templates that recur across its dataset are stripped to avoid spurious matches.
items.zh: 归一化。样本被简化为其问题陈述，即基准问题可能泄漏的部分。在其数据集中重复出现的文本模板被剥离，以避免虚假匹配。

items.en: Candidate retrieval. The sample is compared with every benchmark question using two signals. Verbatim overlap measures how many \(n\)-grams of the question’s text appear in the sample. It detects verbatim copies, even inside longer texts, but misses any rephrasing. Semantic overlap measures the embedding similarity between parts of the two texts. It effectively captures paraphrases, but can be biased by style similarity. Both signals are used to shortlist the most likely contamination candidates.
items.zh: 候选检索。使用两个信号将样本与每个基准问题进行比较。逐字重叠度量问题文本的\(n\)-gram 在样本中出现的数量。它检测逐字复制，即使在较长的文本中，但会遗漏任何改写。语义重叠度量两个文本部分之间的嵌入相似度。它有效捕捉改写，但可能因风格相似而产生偏差。两个信号都用于筛选最可能的污染候选。

items.en: Verification. Each shortlisted pair of a sample and a benchmark question is verified by an LLM judge. The judge classifies the relationship either as contamination (direct copy, paraphrase, answer leakage, or method leakage) or as benign (style overlap or no contamination), and decides its severity. Because the shortlist is small, even a strong judge can be used in this step.
items.zh: 验证。每个入围的样本和基准问题对由 LLM 评判器验证。评判器将关系分类为污染（直接复制、改写、答案泄漏或方法泄漏）或良性（风格重叠或无污染），并决定其严重性。由于入围名单很小，即使强大的评判器也可以在此步骤中使用。

items.en: **Removal.** A sample is removed if the judge finds it severely contaminated with respect to any benchmark question.
items.zh: **移除。** 若判定器发现某样本相对于任一基准问题存在严重污染，则该样本会被移除。

items.en: We evaluated the quality of the pipeline on synthetic contamination. For this purpose, we generated over 10,000 variants of Terminal-Bench 2.1 and GPQA Diamond questions, produced by 13 augmentations of varying strength. Those augmentations ranged from character noise and cropping to LLM-generated paraphrases, translations, and abstractions. The generated variants were mixed with a similar number of same-domain distractors. The judge correctly identified 87.5% and 79.1% of the contaminated samples, respectively, while flagging only a single distractor as contaminated. More details on the evaluation setup can be found in Appendix C.4.
items.zh: 我们在合成污染数据上评估了该流水线的质量。为此，我们生成了 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 GPQA Diamond 问题的 10,000 多个变体，这些变体由 13 种强度不同的增强方式产生。这些增强方式涵盖字符噪声、裁剪，以及由 LLM 生成的改写、翻译和抽象化。生成的变体与数量相近的同领域干扰样本混合。判定器分别正确识别出 87.5% 和 79.1% 的受污染样本，同时仅将单个干扰样本误标为受污染。关于评估设置的更多细节见附录 C.4。

items.en: From the post-training data, the pipeline removed 20,671 samples (around 0.09%; 14,793 SFT and 5,878 RL samples), matching 1,808 benchmark questions (6.0%) in 22 of the 30 benchmarks. Of the candidate pairs the judge worked on, around 3% were flagged as severe contamination. See Appendix C.5 for examples.
items.zh: 在后训练数据中，该流水线移除了 20,671 个样本（约 0.09%；其中 14,793 个 SFT 样本、5,878 个 RL 样本），涉及 30 个基准中 22 个基准的 1,808 个基准问题（6.0%）。在判定器处理的候选配对中，约 3% 被标记为严重污染。示例见附录 C.5。

items.en: We apply post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware distillation (QAD) with ModelOpt17 on Lightning 3.5 and Super 3.5 VL to create a new efficiency-accuracy frontier relative to the unquantized, post-trained BF16 checkpoint.
items.zh: 我们使用 ModelOpt17 对 Lightning 3.5 和 Super 3.5 VL 应用训练后量化（PTQ）和量化感知蒸馏（QAD），以相对于未量化的、训练后的 BF16 检查点，创造新的效率-精度前沿。

items.en: Recipe development starts by defining bookends: conservative and aggressive. Some models might also define a very aggressive variant. These bookends are used to project runtime efficiency gains at various SLAs in the throughput-interactivity Pareto. Unless otherwise noted, we assume 51200, 2048, and 1024 as the pre-cached ISL, new ISL, and OSL, respectively. We measure speedups between a quantized candidate and BF16 using two SLAs:
items.zh: 配方开发始于定义边界：保守和激进。一些模型还可能定义非常激进的变体。这些边界用于在吞吐量-交互性帕累托曲线上，预测不同 SLA 下的运行时效率增益。除非另有说明，我们假设预缓存 ISL、新 ISL 和 OSL 分别为 51200、2048 和 1024。我们使用两个 SLA 来衡量量化候选与 BF16 之间的加速比：

items.en: Throughput (tok/s/gpu) at an SLA of 50 tok/s/usr
items.zh: 在 50 tok/s/usr 的 SLA 下的吞吐量（tok/s/gpu）

items.en: Max throughput (e.g., usually highest concurrency)
items.zh: 最大吞吐量（例如，通常为最高并发数）

items.en: The deployment use case also influences recipe selection. For example, Lightning 3.5 is designed to excel in local, agentic use cases as well as datacenter deployments. We therefore quantize Lightning 3.5 to minimize weight fetch and raise activation precision to maintain accuracy. Lightning 3.5 deploys to W4A16 regardless of GPU SKU, while Super 3.5 VL’s NVFP4 checkpoint deploys W4A4 on Blackwell, and W4A16 on non-Blackwell platforms.
items.zh: 部署用例也会影响配方选择。例如，Lightning 3.5 旨在在本地智能体式用例以及数据中心部署中表现出色。因此，我们对 Lightning 3.5 进行量化，以最小化权重获取并提高激活精度以保持准确性。无论 GPU SKU 如何，Lightning 3.5 都部署为 W4A16，而 Super 3.5 VL 的 NVFP4 检查点在 Blackwell 上部署为 W4A4，在非 Blackwell 平台上部署为 W4A16。

items.en: Quantizing the KV and Mamba SSM caches reduces HBM footprint and improves decode throughput by minimizing data transfer. The KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, whereas the Mamba SSM state is constant in size. New to Super 3.5 VL are ablations on quantized NVFP4 KV cache. We show in §4.5 that quantization of the KV cache to NVFP4 in combination with a quantized SSM meets the acceptance criteria.
items.zh: 对 KV 缓存与 Mamba SSM 缓存进行量化，可减少 HBM 占用，并通过最小化数据传输提升解码吞吐量。KV 缓存随序列长度线性增长，而 Mamba SSM 状态的大小恒定。Super 3.5 VL 新增了对量化 NVFP4 KV 缓存的消融实验。我们在 §4.5 中表明，将 KV 缓存量化为 NVFP4 并与量化 SSM 结合，可满足验收标准。

items.en: Finally, we aim for the highest efficiency and lowest HBM footprint while satisfying the following accuracy criteria:
items.zh: 最后，我们的目标是在满足以下精度标准的同时，实现最高效率与最低 HBM 占用：

items.en: Median accuracy recovery of 99% or higher, defined as the median of the ratios of NVFP4 to BF16 eval scores across several repeats.
items.zh: 中位精度恢复率达到 99% 或更高，其定义为多次重复实验中 NVFP4 与 BF16 评测分数之比的中位数。

items.en: Verbosity increase of no more than 5% relative to BF16.
items.zh: 相对于 BF16，冗长度增加不超过 5%。

items.en: Evaluation results for quantized Lightning 3.5 and Super 3.5 VL are shown in §4.9 and §4.10, respectively.
items.zh: 量化后的 Lightning 3.5 与 Super 3.5 VL 的评测结果分别见 §4.9 和 §4.10。

items.en: We explored three predefined precision recipes (Table 12). The released checkpoint uses the aggressive recipe, with NVFP4 MoE and shared-expert GEMMs and FP8 attention projections and Mamba linear layers. AutoQuant was explored as an alternative sensitivity-driven mixed-precision approach.
items.zh: 我们探索了三种预定义的精度配方（表 12）。发布的检查点采用激进配方，MoE 与共享专家 GEMM 使用 NVFP4，注意力机制投影与 Mamba 线性层使用 FP8。我们还探索了 AutoQuant，作为另一种由敏感度驱动的混合精度方案。

items.en: a FP8 considered for the shared expert during exploration; the Conservative BPE estimate assumes NVFP4 for all shared experts. b FP32 denotes router computation, not checkpoint storage; BPE uses BF16-stored router weights in every column. c Estimated by applying each column's weight policy to corresponding backbone and MTP modules; MTP-specific fusion projection and normalization parameters remain BF16. The released MTP also retains BF16 attention weights; its storage is counted directly in the measured BPE. The released runtime uses an FP32 convolution cache and FP16+SR SSM cache.
items.zh: a 探索阶段曾考虑对共享专家使用 FP8；保守 BPE 估计假设所有共享专家均使用 NVFP4。b FP32 指路由器计算，而非检查点存储；BPE 在每一列中均使用以 BF16 存储的路由器权重。c 通过将每一列的权重策略应用于对应的主干与 MTP 模块进行估计；MTP 专用的融合投影与归一化参数保持 BF16。发布的 MTP 还保留 BF16 注意力机制权重；其存储量直接计入实测 BPE。发布的运行时使用 FP32 卷积缓存与 FP16+SR SSM 缓存。

items.en: We compute whole-model BPE as \(8S/N\), where \(S\) is stored tensor payload in bytes, including quantization scales, and \(N\) is the original parameter count, including vision, MTP, and unquantized modules. For the released checkpoint, \(S=74.987\) GB and \(N=124.453\) billion, giving 4.82 BPE; runtime caches and activations are excluded.
items.zh: 我们将全模型 BPE 计算为 \(8S/N\)，其中 \(S\) 为存储的张量负载（以字节计，包含量化缩放因子），\(N\) 为原始参数量（包含视觉、MTP 及未量化模块）。对于发布的检查点，\(S=74.987\) GB，\(N=124.453\) 十亿，得到 4.82 BPE；运行时缓存与激活值不计入其中。

items.en: PTQ establishes the initial accuracy of candidate recipes, and QAD is used to further recover the quantization gap. The released checkpoint uses the predefined aggressive PTQ recipe followed by SFT-based QAD at 200 iterations. Its median accuracy recovery is 99.62% across 36 benchmarks relative to the BF16-weight reference (also served with FP8 KV cache). For each benchmark, we first average completed runs separately for the released checkpoint and BF16, compute their score ratio, and then take the median across benchmarks. Across 36 benchmarks with token measurements, mean per-benchmark verbosity (Ratio of totals) increases by 0.44%.
items.zh: PTQ 确定候选配方的初始精度，QAD 用于进一步弥补量化差距。发布的检查点先采用预定义的激进 PTQ 配方，随后进行 200 次迭代的基于 SFT 的 QAD。相对于 BF16 权重参考（同样以 FP8 KV 缓存提供服务），其在 36 个基准上的精度恢复中位数为 99.62%。对于每个基准，我们分别对发布的检查点与 BF16 的已完成运行取平均，计算其得分比值，再在基准间取中位数。在 36 个带 token 测量的基准上，每个基准的平均冗长度（总量比值）增加了 0.44%。

items.en: The released checkpoint was evaluated with an FP8 KV cache. Our KV cache ablations showed comparable accuracy with FP8 and NVFP4. It also includes the quantized, boosted MTP. As discussed, the checkpoint uses the predefined aggressive recipe with QAD recovery.
items.zh: 发布的检查点使用 FP8 KV 缓存进行评估。我们的 KV 缓存消融实验显示，FP8 与 NVFP4 的精度相当。该检查点还包含量化并增强的 MTP。如前所述，该检查点采用预定义的激进配方并进行 QAD 恢复。

items.en: We apply post-training quantization (PTQ) using NVIDIA Model Optimizer to quantize Nemotron 3.5 Super to NVFP4 for efficient inference on NVIDIA GPUs. The model is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active mixture-of-experts vision-language model comprising a C-RADIO vision encoder, a hybrid Mamba/attention language backbone with 512 routed experts per MoE layer, and a multi-token prediction (MTP) head.
items.zh: 我们使用 NVIDIA Model Optimizer 应用后训练量化（PTQ），将 Nemotron 3.5 Super 量化为 NVFP4，以便在 NVIDIA GPU 上实现高效推理。该模型是一个 120B 参数、12B 激活的混合专家视觉语言模型，包含 C-RADIO 视觉编码器、每个 MoE 层具有 512 个路由专家的混合 Mamba/注意力机制语言主干，以及一个多词预测（MTP）头。

items.en: Activation scales are learned from a calibration set of image–text pairs, rather than text alone. Images are passed through the vision encoder so that the language model observes the true input distribution, including the projected visual tokens. We use the SFT data employed during post-training as the calibration corpus and calibrate the model using 1,024 samples.
items.zh: 激活缩放因子从图像–文本对的校准集中学习，而非仅使用文本。图像经过视觉编码器，使语言模型能够观察到真实的输入分布，包括投影后的视觉 token。我们使用后训练阶段所用的 SFT 数据作为校准语料，并使用 1,024 个样本对模型进行校准。

items.en: We explored several parallelism strategies for efficient calibration: pipeline parallelism, Data Parallel (DP) × Expert Parallel (EP), and FSDP2. Pipeline parallelism left only one GPU active at a time, so we chose DP × EP. Each of the four ranks processes 256 different samples, covering all 1,024 calibration samples. The 512 routed experts are split evenly across the ranks, and the MTP experts are split the same way. We keep the vision encoder and projector, dense attention layers, and Mamba layers replicated, since the experts make up most of the model's parameters.
items.zh: 我们探索了多种并行策略以实现高效校准：流水线并行、数据并行（DP）× 专家并行（EP）以及 FSDP2。流水线并行一次仅有一个 GPU 处于活跃状态，因此我们选择 DP × EP。四个 rank 各处理 256 个不同样本，覆盖全部 1,024 个校准样本。512 个路由专家在各 rank 间均匀划分，MTP 专家也以相同方式划分。我们保持视觉编码器与投影器、稠密注意力机制层以及 Mamba 层为复制状态，因为专家构成了模型参数的大部分。

items.en: We compared three weight-scale selection schemes at a fixed NVFP4 quantization tier:
items.zh: 我们在固定的 NVFP4 量化层级下比较了三种权重缩放因子选择方案：

items.en: Max: The scale is determined from the observed absolute maximum.
items.zh: Max：缩放因子由观测到的绝对最大值确定。

items.en: MSE: Each block scale is selected to minimize quantization error by sweeping over FP8 scale values.
items.zh: MSE：通过遍历 FP8 缩放值来选择每个块的缩放因子，以最小化量化误差。

items.en: MSE 4-over-6: MSE-based scale selection restricted to a narrower search space.
items.zh: MSE 4-over-6：基于 MSE 的缩放因子选择，但限制在更窄的搜索空间内。

items.en: From the evaluation results (Table 13) we observe that the MSE algorithm is superior in terms of accuracy recovery compared to the Max and MSE 4-over-6. Hence we use the MSE calibration for the PTQ and AutoQuant recipes.
items.zh: 从评估结果（表 13）中我们观察到，与 Max 和 MSE 4-over-6 相比，MSE 算法在精度恢复方面更优。因此，我们在 PTQ 和 AutoQuant 方案中采用 MSE 校准。

full.secZh: 4.3 敏感度驱动的混合精度

items.en: We use ModelOpt AutoQuantize (AutoQuant) to replace hand-authored layer rules with a sensitivity-constrained mixed-precision search. For each quantizable module \(i\) and candidate format \(q \in \{\mathrm{NVFP4}, \mathrm{FP8}, \mathrm{BF16}\}\), AutoQuant estimates a sensitivity \(S_{i}(q)\) from the quantization-induced output error weighted by the squared task-loss gradient. It then solves
items.zh: 我们使用 ModelOpt AutoQuantize（AutoQuant）以敏感度约束的混合精度搜索取代手工编写的层规则。对于每个可量化模块 \(i\) 和候选格式 \(q \in \{\mathrm{NVFP4}, \mathrm{FP8}, \mathrm{BF16}\}\)，AutoQuant 根据由任务损失梯度的平方加权的量化诱导输出误差，估计敏感度 \(S_{i}(q)\)。随后求解

items.en: where \(n_{i}\) is the number of weights, \(b(q_{i})\) includes the modeled storage overhead of format \(q_{i}\), and \(\bar{b}\) is the target effective bitwidth. Operators that must share a deployment format—such as Q/K/V projections and the routed experts within an MoE layer—form a single search decision. The vision encoder, cache quantizers, and fixed MTP recipe are held outside this search.
items.zh: 其中 \(n_{i}\) 是权重数量，\(b(q_{i})\) 包含格式 \(q_{i}\) 的建模存储开销，\(\bar{b}\) 是目标有效位宽。必须共享同一部署格式的算子——例如 Q/K/V 投影以及 MoE 层内被路由的专家——构成单个搜索决策。视觉编码器、缓存量化器和固定的 MTP 配方被置于该搜索之外。

items.en: The sensitivity profile is highly nonuniform: the lm_head accounts for nearly half of the NVFP4 sensitivity, attention and Mamba projections are the next most sensitive families, and MoE experts are comparatively robust. The candidate assignments follow this hierarchy: they concentrate NVFP4 on the parameter-dominant expert weights, reserve FP8 or BF16 for sensitive attention and Mamba projections, and retain higher precision for the lm_head.
items.zh: 敏感度分布高度不均匀：lm_head 占 NVFP4 敏感度的近一半，注意力机制和 Mamba 投影是次敏感的类别，而 MoE 专家相对稳健。候选分配遵循这一层级：将 NVFP4 集中在参数占主导的专家权重上，为敏感的注意力机制和 Mamba 投影保留 FP8 或 BF16，并为 lm_head 保留更高精度。

items.en: We initialize each QAD student from a post-training quantized (PTQ) checkpoint. We derive the quantization configuration from an existing quantization-reference checkpoint, which comes from ModelOpt AutoQuant or fixed-recipe PTQ (Sections 4.2 and 4.3). The only intentional change is KV cache format; quantization-reference checkpoints use FP8 KV cache, whereas our PTQ student uses NVFP4 KV quantization. As such, all results in this subsection refer to deployment with NVFP4 KV cache. Calibration uses 512 packed multimodal samples, with variable-length records packed up to 524,288 tokens and the packing buffer contains 5,000 source samples. The PTQ workflow for QAD student initialization used eight nodes with four NVIDIA GB200 GPUs per node (i.e., 32 GPUs total). The complete workflow took approximately 50 minutes per candidate (i.e., about 27 GB200 GPU-hours per PTQ candidate).
items.zh: 我们从训练后量化（PTQ）检查点初始化每个 QAD 学生模型。量化配置源自现有的量化参考检查点，该检查点来自 ModelOpt AutoQuant 或固定配方的 PTQ（第 4.2 和 4.3 节）。唯一有意的更改是 KV 缓存格式；量化参考检查点使用 FP8 KV 缓存，而我们的 PTQ 学生模型使用 NVFP4 KV 量化。因此，本小节中的所有结果均指使用 NVFP4 KV 缓存的部署。校准使用 512 个打包的多模态样本，变长记录打包至最多 524,288 个 token，打包缓冲区包含 5,000 个源样本。用于 QAD 学生模型初始化的 PTQ 工作流使用八个节点，每个节点配备四个 NVIDIA GB200 GPU（即总共 32 个 GPU）。完整工作流每个候选大约需要 50 分钟（即每个 PTQ 候选约 27 GB200 GPU 小时）。

items.en: We study two data blend settings: the SFT data blend employed during post-training (100% SFT), and a mixture of 75% SFT data with 25% teacher-generated RL rollouts. For the RL rollouts we sample 16 trajectories per source record with vLLM. Generation executes the original RL task workflows and retains environment and tool interactions. We mask out prompt, conversation-history, tool-output, and prefilled response-prefix tokens. The rollout mixture provided only modest benefits in our ablations.
items.zh: 我们研究了两种数据混合设置：后训练期间使用的 SFT 数据混合（100% SFT），以及 75% SFT 数据与 25% 教师生成的 RL 轨迹的混合。对于 RL 轨迹，我们使用 vLLM 为每个源记录采样 16 条轨迹。生成过程执行原始 RL 任务工作流，并保留环境和工具交互。我们屏蔽提示、对话历史、工具输出和预填充响应前缀 token。在我们的消融实验中，轨迹混合仅提供了适度的收益。

items.en: Each QAD experiment starts from its calibrated PTQ student checkpoint with a fresh optimizer. We optimize only the weights of language-model GEMMs with enabled quantizers. All other parameters remain frozen, including token embeddings, unquantized language-model parameters, normalization parameters, the vision encoder and projector, and the MTP module. Router-bias updates are explicitly disabled. The quantization configuration and calibrated quantizer statistics are restored from the PTQ checkpoint rather than recalibrated during QAD. We use KL divergence as our objective. We disable the main hard-target cross-entropy loss, MTP cross-entropy loss, and MoE load-balancing auxiliary loss and don’t use intermediate-feature distillation loss. Optimization uses distributed AdamW with \(\beta_{1}=0.9\), \(\beta_{2}=0.95\), \(\epsilon=10^{-8}\), weight decay \(0.1\), and gradient clipping at a global norm of \(1.0\). The learning rate increases linearly from zero to \(5\times 10^{-6}\) over 9,100 original source records and remains constant thereafter. We run QAD on 128 nodes with four NVIDIA GB200 GPUs per node (512 GPUs total). QAD for 100 iterations took about 2 hours (i.e., 1024 GB200 GPU-hours) for each of our quantization candidates.
items.zh: 每个 QAD 实验都从其校准的 PTQ 学生检查点开始，并使用全新的优化器。我们仅优化启用量化器的语言模型 GEMM 的权重。所有其他参数保持冻结，包括 token 嵌入、未量化的语言模型参数、归一化参数、视觉编码器和投影器以及 MTP 模块。路由器偏置更新被显式禁用。量化配置和校准的量化器统计量从 PTQ 检查点恢复，而不是在 QAD 期间重新校准。我们使用 KL 散度作为目标。我们禁用主硬目标交叉熵损失、MTP 交叉熵损失和 MoE 负载均衡辅助损失，并且不使用中间特征蒸馏损失。优化使用分布式 AdamW，参数为 \(\beta_{1}=0.9\)、\(\beta_{2}=0.95\)、\(\epsilon=10^{-8}\)、权重衰减 \(0.1\)，以及全局范数 \(1.0\) 的梯度裁剪。学习率在 9,100 个原始源记录上从零线性增加到 \(5\times 10^{-6}\)，此后保持不变。我们在 128 个节点上运行 QAD，每个节点配备四个 NVIDIA GB200 GPU（总共 512 个 GPU）。对于每个量化候选，100 次迭代的 QAD 大约需要 2 小时（即 1024 GB200 GPU 小时）。

items.en: We evaluated three quantization recipes (for which we generated PTQ and QAD checkpoints as described above): a) a 4.8 BPE NVFP4 recipe (based on the quantization configuration selected by the corresponding AutoQuant run), b) a 4.9 BPE NVFP4 recipe (similarly, based on a 4.8 BPE target AutoQuant), c) a fixed 4.82 BPE NVFP4 recipe.
items.zh: 我们评估了三种量化配方（我们按照上述描述为其生成了 PTQ 和 QAD 检查点）：a) 4.8 BPE NVFP4 配方（基于相应 AutoQuant 运行选择的量化配置），b) 4.9 BPE NVFP4 配方（类似地，基于 4.8 BPE 目标 AutoQuant），c) 固定的 4.82 BPE NVFP4 配方。

items.en: Below, we show the results (accuracy and verbosity) for the 4.8 BPE recipe; specifically, the PTQ checkpoint and the QAD checkpoints for 200, 400, 600 iterations, for both the 100% SFT blend and the 75/25% SFT/RL blend cases. This initial evaluation sweep was based on an earlier (i.e., before final) version of the BF16 counterpart. Tables 14 and 15 compare the quantized models against that BF16 baseline. PTQ preserves a median 97.68% of the BF16 accuracy while producing 0.22% fewer completion tokens on average. QAD consistently closes much of the remaining accuracy gap, with the evaluated configurations achieving between 98.36% and 99.18% median score recovery. We obtain the best overall accuracy–verbosity tradeoff after 200 QAD iterations using 100% SFT data (99.18% median accuracy recovery - 1.50 percentage points above PTQ - with only a 1.11% increase in aggregate completion-token count relative to BF16). Additional QAD iterations were not uniformly beneficial. For the 100% SFT experiments, the 100 iterations checkpoint provides the strongest overall accuracy–verbosity tradeoff. The 75/25% SFT/RL experiments perform best at the intermediate iterations checkpoint. Overall, our results favor shorter QAD training with 100% SFT data and show that optimal training duration depends on the selected data mixture.
items.zh: 下面，我们展示 4.8 BPE 配方的结果（准确性和冗长度）；具体来说，包括 PTQ 检查点以及 200、400、600 次迭代的 QAD 检查点，涵盖 100% SFT 混合和 75/25% SFT/RL 混合两种情况。此初始评估扫描基于 BF16 对应版本的早期（即最终之前）版本。表 14 和表 15 将量化模型与该 BF16 基线进行比较。PTQ 保持了 BF16 准确率的中位数 97.68%，同时平均生成的完成 token 数减少了 0.22%。QAD 持续缩小了大部分剩余准确率差距，评估配置达到了 98.36% 至 99.18% 的中位数分数恢复。在使用 100% SFT 数据进行 200 次 QAD 迭代后，我们获得了最佳的整体准确性-冗长度权衡（中位数准确率恢复 99.18%——比 PTQ 高 1.50 个百分点——而总完成 token 数相对于 BF16 仅增加 1.11%）。额外的 QAD 迭代并非一致有益。对于 100% SFT 实验，100 次迭代的检查点提供了最强的整体准确性-冗长度权衡。75/25% SFT/RL 实验在中间迭代检查点表现最佳。总体而言，我们的结果倾向于使用 100% SFT 数据进行较短的 QAD 训练，并表明最佳训练时长取决于所选的数据混合。

items.en: We adjusted the QAD experiments based on the above observations for the final post-trained BF16 checkpoint. In particular, we reduced checkpointing interval to 100 iterations, used the 100% SFT blend only, and evaluated QAD checkpoints at 200, 300, and 400 iterations. We repeated this process for each of the three recipes considered previously: 4.8, 4.82, and 4.9 BPE. Tables 16 and 17 report the accuracy and verbosity results used for final candidate downselection (wherein selected candidate checkpoints undergo a more thorough evaluation with a broader set of benchmarks). The effect of additional QAD iterations is recipe-dependent. For the 4.8-BPE recipe, moving from 200 to 300 iterations improves both accuracy recovery and verbosity, reducing the aggregate token increase from 2.30% to 0.75%. Similarly, for the 4.9-BPE recipe, moving from 200 to 300 iterations provides substantially better recovery and reduces verbosity change from 1.79% to parity with BF16. The 4.82-BPE recipe behaves differently: its 200-iteration checkpoint provides the strongest accuracy recovery (almost matches median BF16 accuracy and verbosity), whereas the 300-iteration one is less accurate and slightly less verbose. Overall, the 4.82-BPE recipe at 200 iterations provides the strongest accuracy–verbosity tradeoff and constitutes the strongest candidate. We also selected the best candidate from each of the other two recipes for a final stage full benchmark evaluation sweep.
items.zh: 我们根据上述观察结果，针对最终后训练的 BF16 检查点调整了 QAD 实验。具体而言，我们将检查点间隔减少到 100 次迭代，仅使用 100% SFT 混合，并在 200、300 和 400 次迭代时评估 QAD 检查点。我们对之前考虑的三个配方（4.8、4.82 和 4.9 BPE）中的每一个重复了此过程。表 16 和表 17 报告了用于最终候选筛选的准确性和冗长性结果（其中选定的候选检查点将接受更全面的评估，使用更广泛的基准测试）。额外 QAD 迭代的效果取决于配方。对于 4.8-BPE 配方，从 200 次迭代增加到 300 次迭代，既提高了准确性恢复，又改善了冗长性，将总 token 增加从 2.30% 降低到 0.75%。类似地，对于 4.9-BPE 配方，从 200 次迭代增加到 300 次迭代，提供了显著更好的恢复，并将冗长性变化从 1.79% 降低到与 BF16 持平。4.82-BPE 配方的表现不同：其 200 次迭代的检查点提供了最强的准确性恢复（几乎匹配 BF16 的中位准确性和冗长性），而 300 次迭代的检查点准确性较低，冗长性略低。总体而言，4.82-BPE 配方在 200 次迭代时提供了最强的准确性-冗长性权衡，并构成了最强的候选。我们还从其他两个配方中分别选择了最佳候选，用于最终阶段的全基准评估扫描。

items.en: Note that although the 400-iteration QAD checkpoints were also evaluated, they are omitted from Tables 16 and 17, and do not alter the candidate downselection. Our results in fact indicate that the principal QAD benefits largely saturate by 300 iterations.
items.zh: 注意，尽管也评估了 400 次迭代的 QAD 检查点，但它们未列入表 16 和表 17，并且不影响候选筛选。我们的结果表明，主要的 QAD 收益在很大程度上到 300 次迭代时就饱和了。

items.en: As part of our studies, we evaluate both FP8 and NVFP4 quantization cases; in each case both the key and value caches across attention layers are quantized in FP8 or NVFP4, respectively. NVFP4 stores 4-bit E2M1 values with one FP8 E4M3 scale per 16-element block, for an effective storage cost of 4.5 bits per cached element, excluding tensor-level scale overhead. Relative to FP8's 8 bits per element, this reduces the ideal KV cache payload by \(1-4.5/8=43.75\\%). This is a storage calculation, not a measured reduction in runtime memory traffic or latency; KV cache BPE is separate from the whole-model checkpoint BPE in Section 4.1.
items.zh: 作为研究的一部分，我们评估了 FP8 和 NVFP4 两种量化方案；在每种方案中，注意力机制层中的键缓存和值缓存分别被量化为 FP8 或 NVFP4。NVFP4 以 4 位 E2M1 值存储，每 16 个元素块使用一个 FP8 E4M3 缩放因子，因此每个缓存元素的有效存储成本为 4.5 位（不包括张量级缩放开销）。相对于 FP8 的每元素 8 位，这将理想 KV 缓存负载减少了 \（1-4.5/8=43.75\\%）。这是一个存储计算，而非运行时内存流量或延迟的实测减少；KV 缓存 BPE 与第 4.1 节中的全模型检查点 BPE 是分开的。

items.en: Our reference uses BF16 weights with an FP8 KV cache. The two configurations in Table 18 use our aggressive NVFP4 recipe with QAD at 200 iterations, evaluated with either (uniform) NVFP4 or FP8 KV cache. For each benchmark, we average completed runs within each configuration and the reference, then take the median of the 35 configuration-to-reference score ratios. Median accuracy recovery is 99.36% for the NVFP4 KV cache configuration and 99.52% for the released FP8 KV cache configuration (on the same 35 benchmarks).
items.zh: 我们的参考模型使用 BF16 权重和 FP8 KV 缓存。表 18 中的两种配置使用我们激进的 NVFP4 方案，在 200 次迭代下进行 QAD，并分别使用（均匀）NVFP4 或 FP8 KV 缓存进行评估。对于每个基准测试，我们对每种配置和参考模型的已完成运行取平均值，然后取 35 个配置与参考分数比率的中位数。NVFP4 KV 缓存配置的中位准确率恢复为 99.36%，发布的 FP8 KV 缓存配置为 99.52%（在相同的 35 个基准测试上）。

items.en: The NVFP4 KV cache experiments use the original QAD checkpoint, i.e., with fixed backbone KV scale values targeting NVFP4 KV cache deployment (1/6); the FP8 KV cache experiments use the released quantized checkpoint that contains no KV scales and targets FP8 KV cache deployment (vLLM defaults to KV scales of 1.0 for FP8 KV cache type). Both use an FP32 Mamba convolution cache and FP16 SSM cache with stochastic rounding. The reported median accuracy recovery against the BF16-weight reference reflects the full weight-and-cache configuration, not KV quantization alone. The results show broadly comparable aggregate accuracy in the specific quantization recipe used. The released quantized NVFP4 checkpoint defaults to FP8 KV cache for runtime-efficiency and software-readiness considerations despite NVFP4 KV's storage advantage. Per-layer mixed FP8-key/NVFP4-value (or vice-versa) configurations are not evaluated in this comparison.
items.zh: NVFP4 KV 缓存实验使用原始 QAD 检查点，即具有固定的骨干 KV 缩放值，针对 NVFP4 KV 缓存部署（1/6）；FP8 KV 缓存实验使用发布的量化检查点，该检查点不包含 KV 缩放，并针对 FP8 KV 缓存部署（vLLM 对 FP8 KV 缓存类型默认 KV 缩放为 1.0）。两者均使用 FP32 Mamba 卷积缓存和 FP16 SSM 缓存，并采用随机舍入。报告的相对于 BF16 权重参考的中位准确率恢复反映了完整的权重和缓存配置，而不仅仅是 KV 量化。结果表明，在所使用的特定量化方案中，总体准确率大致相当。尽管 NVFP4 KV 具有存储优势，但发布的量化 NVFP4 检查点出于运行时效率和软件就绪性的考虑，默认使用 FP8 KV 缓存。本比较未评估逐层混合 FP8 键/NVFP4 值（或反之）的配置。

full.secZh: 4.6 注意力机制与投影精度

items.en: To understand the impact of quantization on model behavior, we ablated three components: global attention's projection, mamba's projection, and the unembedding. We presumed W4A4 routed/shared experts and FP8 KV cache as the default configuration to test each projection's sensitivity to quantization. This reveals a few interesting findings:
items.zh: 为理解量化对模型行为的影响，我们对三个组件进行了消融：全局注意力机制的投影、mamba 的投影以及 unembedding。我们将 W4A4 路由/共享专家与 FP8 KV cache 设为默认配置，以测试各投影对量化的敏感性。这揭示了一些有趣的发现：

items.en: The MoE expert weights carry a primary impact on accuracy, causing a drift of token distribution in FP4-quantized latent space. This becomes critical for runaway loop generation in reasoning failures, if a decision boundary of abstention is fragile enough to be affected by quantization. No attention projection precision recovers the verbosity inflation. Empirically, promoting MoE expert precision and fine-tuning on RL rollouts can mitigate this effect (Appendix B.2).
items.zh: MoE 专家权重对精度有主要影响，会在 FP4 量化的潜空间中引起 token 分布漂移。若弃答（abstention）的决策边界脆弱到足以被量化影响，这一点在推理失败时的失控循环生成中变得至关重要。任何注意力机制投影精度都无法恢复冗长膨胀（verbosity inflation）。经验上，提升 MoE 专家精度并在 RL rollout 上微调可缓解这一效应（附录 B.2）。

items.en: Because long-context retrieval is dominated by KV cache precision, attention projection has minimal impact on accuracy in most cases. However, Table 19 shows that attention score dilution, sharing a single representable level of the quantized attention score among many keys, is more pronounced with disambiguation (e.g., MRCR-128k) in 32k+ context length. q/k/v projections do not require BF16, but per-tensor FP8's dynamic range constrains attention logit granularity. MXFP8's per-block scaling helps mitigate the quality degradation. Attention's output projection is structurally exposed but tolerant to FP8 quantization (Appendix B.3).
items.zh: 由于长上下文检索主要由 KV cache 精度主导，注意力机制投影在多数情况下对精度影响极小。然而，表 19 显示，注意力分数稀释——即在众多 key 之间共享单一可表示的量化注意力分数水平——在 32k+ 上下文长度下进行消歧（如 MRCR-128k）时更为显著。q/k/v 投影不需要 BF16，但 per-tensor FP8 的动态范围限制了注意力 logit 的粒度。MXFP8 的 per-block scaling 有助于缓解质量退化。注意力机制的输出投影在结构上是暴露的，但对 FP8 量化具有容忍性（附录 B.3）。

items.en: Mamba output projection also has a minimal impact on accuracy, but quantizing its weights to FP4 inflates generation length. Its input activations are separately exposed: the SSM gate emits near-zero yet never exactly zero values, which flush to zero under FP4 activation quantization. Rotation or higher precision can mitigate this effect in activation, but does not address the verbosity inflation without weight realignment (Appendix B.4).
items.zh: Mamba 输出投影对精度的影响也极小，但将其权重量化到 FP4 会膨胀生成长度。其输入激活则单独暴露：SSM 门发出接近零但从不精确为零的值，这些值在 FP4 激活量化下会被冲刷为零。旋转或更高精度可缓解激活中的这一效应，但若不进行权重重对齐，则无法解决冗长膨胀（附录 B.4）。

items.en: The lm_head weights of unembedding do not change accuracy even with FP4 quantization. However, FP4 amplifies the perturbation of the stop-versus-continue margin. To maintain token generation verbosity, the lm_head should stay at FP8 weights or above (Appendix B.5).
items.zh: 即使采用 FP4 量化，unembedding 的 lm_head 权重也不会改变精度。然而，FP4 会放大停止与继续（stop-versus-continue）边界的扰动。为维持 token 生成的冗长度，lm_head 应保持 FP8 权重或更高精度（附录 B.5）。

items.en: To reduce drafting latency, we quantize the MTP module of the Nemotron 3.5 Super NVFP4 checkpoint. This applies only to Nemotron 3.5 Super; the MTP module of Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is not quantized. The MTP module contains an attention layer and an MoE layer. It does not carry its own output projection: the released checkpoint stores a single lm_head, shared between target verification and MTP drafting. Profiling shows that the MoE experts and the lm_head account for most of the drafting latency. We therefore quantize the MTP experts using NVFP4 W4A4. The MTP attention weights remain BF16, with only the K/V BMM quantizers at FP8.
items.zh: 为降低起草延迟，我们对 Nemotron 3.5 Super NVFP4 检查点的 MTP 模块进行了量化。这仅适用于 Nemotron 3.5 Super；Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 的 MTP 模块未量化。MTP 模块包含一个注意力机制层和一个 MoE 层。它没有自己的输出投影：发布的检查点存储单个 lm_head，在目标验证和 MTP 起草之间共享。性能分析表明，MoE 专家和 lm_head 占据了大部分起草延迟。因此，我们使用 NVFP4 W4A4 量化 MTP 专家。MTP 注意力机制权重保持 BF16，仅 K/V BMM 量化器使用 FP8。

items.en: Isolating the effect of MTP quantization requires holding the backbone fixed. Against the NVFP4 backbone with a BF16 MTP (\(AL=4.612\) at draft length 7), quantizing the MTP experts reduces AL to \(AL=4.592\) (Table 20).
items.zh: 隔离 MTP 量化的效果需要保持主干固定。在 NVFP4 主干与 BF16 MTP（起草长度 7 时 \(AL=4.612\)）的对比中，量化 MTP 专家将 AL 降低至 \(AL=4.592\)（表 20）。

items.en: To assess the possible speedup from MTP and lm_head quantization, we simulated drafting and verification latencies at draft length \(5\), on a single GB200 GPU, with a quantized backbone. Our simulated latency projections show that when the MTP and lm_head are both unquantized, drafting accounts for \(23.5\%) of the total latency, and the drafting latency splits to \(49.6\%) MTP latency and \(51.4\%) lm_head latency. Therefore, using quantization to reduce the latency of both components is beneficial to reduce the total drafting time, if the drop in acceptance length is not too big.
items.zh: 为了评估 MTP 和 lm_head 量化可能带来的加速，我们在单个 GB200 GPU 上，使用量化主干，模拟了起草长度为 \(5\) 时的起草和验证延迟。我们的模拟延迟预测显示，当 MTP 和 lm_head 均未量化时，起草占总延迟的 \(23.5\)%，起草延迟分为 \(49.6\)% 的 MTP 延迟和 \(51.4\)% 的 lm_head 延迟。因此，如果接受长度的下降不太大，使用量化来降低两个组件的延迟有利于减少总起草时间。

items.en: According to our projections, quantizing the MTP layer is expected to reduce \(47\%) of its latency, and quantizing the lm_head to FP8 and W4A16 precisions is expected to reduce its latency by \(49\%) and \(71\%), respectively. Quantizing the target model’s lm_head was initially considered higher risk because it directly affects the target logits and, consequently, model quality. As a fallback, we experimented with various combinations using separate target and MTP lm_head precisions, and implemented support in vLLM 0.30.0 for serving the model in this mixed configuration. This allows the target lm_head to remain in BF16 while using a lower-precision lm_head for drafting. The AL results and expected speedups over the using MTP and lm_head are described in Table 20.
items.zh: 根据我们的预测，量化 MTP 层预计可减少其 \(47\)% 的延迟，而将 lm_head 量化为 FP8 和 W4A16 精度预计分别减少其延迟 \(49\)% 和 \(71\)%。量化目标模型的 lm_head 最初被认为风险较高，因为它直接影响目标 logits，进而影响模型质量。作为后备方案，我们尝试了使用单独的目标和 MTP lm_head 精度的各种组合，并在 vLLM 0.30.0 中实现了支持，以这种混合配置服务模型。这允许目标 lm_head 保持 BF16，同时使用较低精度的 lm_head 进行起草。AL 结果和相对于使用 MTP 和 lm_head 的预期加速在表 20 中描述。

items.en: FP8 quantization of the target lm_head was ultimately selected, thus a single FP8 lm_head serves both target verification and MTP drafting, and no separate output head is required. The separate-precision support remains available for models where quantizing the target lm_head degrades quality.
items.zh: 最终选择了对目标 lm_head 进行 FP8 量化，因此单个 FP8 lm_head 同时服务于目标验证和 MTP 起草，无需单独的输出头。对于量化目标 lm_head 会降低质量的模型，单独精度支持仍然可用。

items.en: The MTP cannot use a different KV-cache precision from the backbone. MTP KV precision therefore follows the backbone. We empirically validated that this does not degrade ALs, making the coupling a structural constraint rather than a quality trade-off.
items.zh: MTP 无法使用与主干不同的 KV-cache 精度。因此，MTP 的 KV 精度跟随主干。我们通过实验验证，这不会降低 ALs，从而使该耦合成为一种结构性约束，而非质量上的权衡。

items.en: The released checkpoints were produced by quantizing the boosted MTP (Section 3.7) separately and splicing it into the selected quantized backbone, rather than co-quantizing both in a single pass. The splice transfers the MTP weights and their scales while leaving the surrounding configuration unchanged, so source and destination must agree exactly on the MTP tensor set — names, shapes and dtypes. Co-quantizing the MTP together with the backbone removes this coupling and is the preferred direction for future releases.
items.zh: 已发布的检查点是通过单独量化增强后的 MTP（第 3.7 节），再将其拼接进选定的量化主干而生成的，而非在单次流程中对两者联合量化。拼接过程会迁移 MTP 权重及其 scale，同时保持周边配置不变，因此源端与目标端必须在 MTP 张量集合上完全一致——包括名称、形状和 dtype。将 MTP 与主干联合量化可消除这一耦合，是未来发布的首选方向。

items.en: Following a similar procedure to MTP quantization, we applied weight-only PTQ to improve the drafting efficiency of a DSpark module for Nemotron Lightning 3.5 and a LiLiCorr module for Nemotron 3.5 Super (see Section 5.7). Our experiments showed that in memory-bound scenarios, e.g., on edge devices with low concurrency, parallel drafters benefit greatly from weight quantization, as this reduces the memory overhead from loading drafter parameters. For Nemotron 3.5 Super, we observed that quantizing LiLiCorr's linear layers to NVFP4 while keeping the activations at BF16 resulted in an 11% throughput improvement on DGX Spark without meaningfully sacrificing acceptance lengths, as shown in Table 28. Further quantizing the LM head improved throughput by another 5%. We identified model-specific quantization settings that performed well both in terms of drafter accuracy and overall throughput on DGX Spark. Additional details are in Table 21.
items.zh: 参照与 MTP 量化类似的流程，我们采用仅权重量化（weight-only PTQ）来提升 Nemotron Lightning 3.5 的 DSpark 模块与 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的 LiLiCorr 模块的草稿效率（见第 5.7 节）。实验表明，在内存受限场景下（例如并发度较低的边缘设备），并行草稿模型可从权重量化中显著受益，因为量化降低了加载草稿模型参数的内存开销。对于 Nemotron 3.5 Super，我们观察到将 LiLiCorr 的线性层量化为 NVFP4、同时将激活值保持为 BF16，可在 DGX Spark 上带来 11% 的吞吐提升，且不会明显牺牲接受长度，如表 28 所示。进一步量化 LM head 又带来了 5% 的吞吐提升。我们找到了在 DGX Spark 上于草稿模型准确率与整体吞吐两方面均表现良好的模型专属量化设置。更多细节见表 21。

items.en: We evaluate Nemotron 3.5 Lightning using the NeMo Gym evaluation framework described for Super 3.5. Lightning-specific settings are available in the recipes folder and reproducibility tutorial1818 18 https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/main/nemotron_recipes/lightning-3.5/reproducibility.md. For evaluation, we serve both the BF16 and NVFP4 checkpoints with FP8 KV cache and FP32 Mamba SSM cache. SSM cache is kept in FP32 as it was not a limiter on DGX Spark for low batch (< 4) use cases. In the W4A16 NVFP4 checkpoint, the routed experts, shared experts, and language-model output head use 4-bit NVFP4 weights with 16-bit activations. The Mamba input and output projections use FP8 weights and activations, while attention projections remain in BF16. We select the W4A16 NVFP4 configuration using the same PTQ/QAD procedure, and compare it with BF16 under matched evaluation and serving settings. Table 22 compares the benchmark scores1919 19 Evaluation results are subject to run-to-run variation due to stochastic sampling and, where applicable, judge variability. Scores may therefore differ from those reported on the model cards. between BF16 and W4A16 NVFP4, reporting a Median Accuracy Recovery of 99.24% and a Ratio of Totals Verbosity change of \(-3.63\%) across benchmarks.
items.zh: 我们使用为 Super 3.5 描述的 NeMo Gym 评估框架来评估 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning。Lightning 特定的设置可在 recipes 文件夹和可复现性教程 1818 18 https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/main/nemotron_recipes/lightning-3.5/reproducibility.md 中找到。为了评估，我们使用 FP8 KV 缓存和 FP32 Mamba SSM 缓存来服务 BF16 和 NVFP4 检查点。SSM 缓存保持为 FP32，因为在 DGX Spark 上对于低批量（< 4）用例，它并不是限制因素。在 W4A16 NVFP4 检查点中，路由专家、共享专家和语言模型输出头使用 4 位 NVFP4 权重和 16 位激活。Mamba 输入和输出投影使用 FP8 权重和激活，而注意力机制投影保持为 BF16。我们使用相同的 PTQ/QAD 流程选择 W4A16 NVFP4 配置，并在匹配的评估和服务设置下与 BF16 进行比较。表 22 比较了 BF16 和 W4A16 NVFP4 之间的基准分数 1919 19 评估结果可能因随机采样和（在适用情况下）评判器可变性而存在运行间差异。因此，分数可能与模型卡上报告的分数不同。，报告了中位准确率恢复率为 99.24%，以及跨基准的总计冗长变化比率为 \(-3.63\)%。

items.en: Scores, deltas, and recoveries are rounded to two decimal places for display. Calculations use unrounded scores. CritPt recovery is undefined because its BF16 score is zero and is excluded from the median.
items.zh: 分数、增量和恢复率显示时四舍五入到两位小数。计算使用未四舍五入的分数。CritPt 恢复率未定义，因为其 BF16 分数为零，并被排除在中位数之外。

items.en: We evaluate Nemotron 3.5 Super on a comprehensive suite of benchmarks spanning agentic capabilities, reasoning and knowledge, multimodal, conversational ability and instruction following, long-context understanding, and multilingual performance. All evaluation results for Nemotron 3.5 Super and baselines were collected via Nemo Gym [20]. For reproducibility purposes, more details on the evaluation settings can be found in the Nemo Gym recipes folder and the corresponding reproducibility tutorial [21].
items.zh: 我们在涵盖智能体能力、推理与知识、多模态、对话能力与指令遵循、长上下文理解以及多语言性能的综合基准套件上评估了 Nemotron 3.5 Super。Nemotron 3.5 Super 和基线的所有评估结果均通过 Nemo Gym [20] 收集。为了可复现性，有关评估设置的更多细节可在 Nemo Gym 配方文件夹和相应的可复现性教程 [21] 中找到。

items.en: We evaluate the candidate NVFP4 checkpoints generated from PTQ and QAD to select the most accuracy-preserving and verbosity-maintaining candidate compared to the baseline BF16. The evaluation and serving parameters are common between the BF16 and NVFP4 for fair comparison.
items.zh: 我们评估了由 PTQ 和 QAD 生成的候选 NVFP4 检查点，以选择与基线 BF16 相比最能保持准确性和冗长度的候选。为了公平比较，BF16 和 NVFP4 的评估和服务参数是相同的。

items.en: We measure model intelligence with two metrics: Median Accuracy Recovery and Ratio of Totals Verbosity. The former is computed by averaging accuracy over completed runs for the NVFP4 and BF16 checkpoints, dividing the NVFP4 average by the BF16 average, and reporting the median of these ratios across benchmarks. The latter is computed by averaging output tokens per trajectory over all trajectories and runs. We then sum these averages across benchmarks for each checkpoint and report the percent change of the NVFP4 total relative to the BF16 total.
items.zh: 我们使用两个指标来衡量模型智能：中位准确率恢复率和总冗长比率。前者通过平均 NVFP4 和 BF16 检查点在已完成运行上的准确率来计算，将 NVFP4 的平均值除以 BF16 的平均值，并报告这些比率在基准上的中位数。后者通过平均所有轨迹和运行中每条轨迹的输出令牌数来计算。然后，我们对每个检查点在基准上的这些平均值求和，并报告 NVFP4 总量相对于 BF16 总量的百分比变化。

items.en: Terminal-Bench shows a +0.2% change in mean output tokens per trajectory over agent-completed rollouts and +0.8% in the median over all rollouts, but +15.7% in the mean over all rollouts, because roughly 4.5% of non-completing runaway trajectories (about 700k tokens each) dominate the mean. To avoid skewing the verbosity metrics, we exclude the non-completed rollouts for Terminal-Bench; if included the Verbosity Change (Ratio of Totals) increases to \(2.99\%).
items.zh: Terminal-Bench 显示，在智能体完成的 rollout 中，每条轨迹的平均输出令牌数变化为 +0.2%，在所有 rollout 的中位数上变化为 +0.8%，但在所有 rollout 的平均值上变化为 +15.7%，因为大约 4.5% 的未完成失控轨迹（每条约 70 万令牌）主导了平均值。为了避免扭曲冗长指标，我们排除了 Terminal-Bench 的未完成 rollout；如果包括在内，冗长变化（总比率）将增加到 \(2.99\)%。

items.en: We run each benchmark twice and average their scores to account for run-to-run variability, in addition to the number of repeats specified by the benchmark.
items.zh: 我们将每个基准运行两次并平均其分数，以考虑运行间的变异性，此外还有基准指定的重复次数。

items.en: Nemotron 3.5 Super was designed for interactive, long-context agentic workloads, where requests commonly share system instructions, tool definitions, or retrieved context and then extend that context over multiple turns. Effective serving performance therefore depends not only on peak throughput or single-request latency, but also on preserving prefix reuse while sustaining an interactive per-user generation rate.
items.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 面向交互式、长上下文智能体式工作负载而设计，此类请求通常共享系统指令、工具定义或检索到的上下文，并在多轮交互中不断扩展该上下文。因此，有效的服务性能不仅取决于峰值吞吐量或单请求延迟，还取决于在保持前缀复用的同时维持交互式的每用户生成速率。

items.en: For system tuning, we use a 20-turn proxy workload with 2,048 input tokens and 1,024 output tokens per turn; the shared prompt and prior conversation are eligible for prefix reuse on subsequent turns. We call a serving point usable when its reported per-user generation rate is at least 50 tokens/s. Among these points, we seek the highest aggregate output throughput. The selected operating point depends on the platform and serving configuration.
items.zh: 为进行系统调优，我们采用一个 20 轮的代理工作负载，每轮包含 2,048 个输入 token 和 1,024 个输出 token；共享提示词与先前对话在后续轮次中可进行前缀复用。当某服务配置点报告的每用户生成速率至少为 50 tokens/s 时，我们称其可用。在这些可用配置点中，我们寻求最高的聚合输出吞吐量。所选定的工作点取决于平台与服务配置。

items.en: This regime places particular emphasis on three parts of the serving stack. First, prefix reuse must remain effective for a hybrid Mamba-Attention model when speculative decoding changes the position from which execution resumes. Second, kernel selection must be controllable at finer granularity than a single global policy because the best kernels at a balanced operating point need not be those that win at either endpoint of the latency-throughput curve. Third, the same model must map efficiently to accelerators with different memory capacities, bandwidths, and quantization support. We address these requirements in vLLM and characterize their effect below.
items.zh: 这一场景特别强调服务栈的三个部分。第一，当推测解码改变执行恢复的位置时，前缀复用必须对混合 Mamba-Attention 模型仍然有效。第二，内核选择必须能以比单一全局策略更细的粒度进行控制，因为在平衡工作点上的最佳内核未必是延迟-吞吐量曲线两端各自胜出的内核。第三，同一模型必须能高效映射到具有不同内存容量、带宽和量化支持的加速器上。我们在 vLLM 中解决了这些需求，并在下文刻画其效果。

items.en: We validated Nemotron 3.5 Super across NVIDIA datacenter and local systems, including A100, H100, B200, GB200 and GB300 platforms, DGX Spark and DGX Station, and RTX-class GPUs. These platforms span multiple architecture generations and deployment scales. Rather than impose one serving configuration everywhere, we tune quantization and speculative decoding for each platform. The objective remains the same: maximize aggregate throughput over the 20-turn proxy workload while sustaining at least 50 output tokens/s/user.
items.zh: 我们在 NVIDIA 数据中心与本地系统上验证了 Nemotron 3.5 Super，涵盖 A100、H100、B200、GB200 和 GB300 平台、DGX Spark 与 DGX Station，以及 RTX 级 GPU。这些平台跨越多个架构代际与部署规模。我们并非在所有平台上强加同一套服务配置，而是针对每个平台调优量化与投机解码。目标始终一致：在 20 轮代理工作负载上最大化总吞吐量，同时保持每用户至少 50 个输出 token/s。

items.en: Our internal performance model attributes the advantage in Figure 11 to how Nemotron 3.5 Super handles per-request state, how many tokens each decoding step yields, and how much data its experts exchange. In each decode step the weights are read once and shared by the whole batch, while every request reads and updates its own KV cache and recurrent state, which must also stay in GPU memory. Throughput therefore depends on how cheaply each request produces a token and on how many requests share the cost of reading the weights.
items.zh: 我们的内部性能模型将图 11 中的优势归因于 Nemotron 3.5 Super 对逐请求状态的处理方式、每个解码步产出的 token 数量，以及其专家之间交换的数据量。在每个解码步中，权重只读取一次并由整个批次共享，而每个请求都要读取并更新自己的 KV cache 与循环状态，这些状态还必须常驻 GPU 内存。因此，吞吐量取决于每个请求产生一个 token 的代价有多低，以及有多少请求分摊读取权重的成本。

items.en: Like the Qwen models, Nemotron 3.5 Super is a hybrid, but it has fewer attention layers, with narrower key-value heads, and leaves the rest of sequence mixing to Mamba-2 layers whose state does not grow with context, so its per-request memory grows much more slowly as agentic sessions accumulate history. At these lengths each Qwen3.8 request needs more GPU memory, so fewer requests fit on a GPU, which limits how many share each weight read; its sparse attention reduces how much KV cache is read per step, but not how much must be stored. Qwen3.5 stores about as much KV cache as Qwen3.8 and reads all of it on every step, so each of its requests costs more in both memory and bandwidth than a Nemotron 3.5 Super request.
items.zh: 与 Qwen 模型类似，Nemotron 3.5 Super 也是混合架构，但它的注意力机制层更少、key-value 头更窄，并将其余的序列混合交给状态不随上下文增长的 Mamba-2 层，因此随着智能体式会话不断累积历史，其逐请求内存增长要慢得多。在这些长度下，每个 Qwen3.8 请求需要更多 GPU 内存，因此单张 GPU 上能容纳的请求更少，这限制了分摊每次权重读取的请求数量；其稀疏注意力机制减少了每步读取的 KV cache 量，但并未减少必须存储的量。Qwen3.5 存储的 KV cache 与 Qwen3.8 大致相当，且每一步都读取全部 KV cache，因此其每个请求在内存和带宽上的开销都高于 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的请求。

items.en: The MTP head reaches a higher average acceptance length than both Qwen models under probabilistic draft sampling (Table 9), so each step yields more tokens per request, and LatentMoE exchanges latent vectors that are smaller than the Qwen models' hidden states, which reduces the expert-parallel communication per token. A large per-request cost in Nemotron 3.5 Super's decoding is updating the Mamba state, which speculative decoding writes out for every token verified in a step because the number of accepted tokens is not known in advance; ReplaySSM (Section 5.4) reduces this traffic and the memory it requires.
items.zh: 在概率式草稿采样下，MTP 头达到的平均接受长度高于两个 Qwen 模型（表 9），因此每一步每个请求产出更多 token；而 LatentMoE 交换的隐向量小于 Qwen 模型的隐藏状态，从而降低了每个 token 的专家并行通信量。Nemotron 3.5 Super 解码中一项较大的逐请求开销是更新 Mamba 状态，由于接受的 token 数量无法预先得知，投机解码会为一步中验证的每个 token 写出该状态；ReplaySSM（第 5.4 节）减少了这一流量及其所需的内存。

items.en: For a pure Attention model, prefix reuse is represented by per-token KV state stored in relatively small cache pages. A hybrid model must additionally recover the recurrent Mamba state at the position where computation resumes. This state contains the complete sequence summary for a layer and is much larger per cached position than an Attention KV entry. vLLM therefore matches the cache-page sizes of the Attention and Mamba cache groups by byte size. On our target Mamba-2 model, one Mamba cache page occupies at least as many bytes as approximately 4K tokens of Attention KV cache. Consequently, Mamba states are normally retained on a much coarser token grid than Attention KV state.
items.zh: 对于纯 Attention 模型，前缀复用体现为按 token 存储的 KV 状态，这些状态存放在相对较小的缓存页中。混合模型还必须额外恢复计算恢复位置处的循环 Mamba 状态。该状态包含某一层的完整序列摘要，且每个缓存位置所占空间远大于一个 Attention KV 条目。因此，vLLM 按字节大小对齐 Attention 缓存组与 Mamba 缓存组的缓存页大小。在我们的目标 Mamba-2 模型上，一个 Mamba 缓存页所占的字节数至少相当于约 4K 个 token 的 Attention KV 缓存。因此，Mamba 状态通常以比 Attention KV 状态粗得多的 token 粒度保留。

items.en: This granularity matters when prefix caching is combined with speculative decoding. Suppose the target model obtains a prefix-cache hit through token \(T\). To draft token \(T+1\), the drafter needs the target model's intermediate hidden state for token \(T\). The prefix cache contains the Attention KV state and a checkpointed Mamba state, but not that intermediate hidden state. vLLM reconstructs it by resuming the target model from the most recent stored Mamba checkpoint. If the Mamba block spans \(L_{\mathrm{page}}\) tokens, the nearest resumable state may be at \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\), forcing the target model to replay tokens \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\) through \(T\) solely to recover the hidden state at token \(T\).
items.zh: 当前缀缓存与推测解码结合时，这种粒度差异就变得重要。假设目标模型通过 token \(T\) 获得前缀缓存命中。为了草拟 token \(T+1\)，草拟器需要目标模型在 token \(T\) 处的中间隐藏状态。前缀缓存包含 Attention KV 状态和一个检查点化的 Mamba 状态，但不包含该中间隐藏状态。vLLM 通过从最近存储的 Mamba 检查点恢复目标模型来重建该状态。如果 Mamba 块跨越 \(L_{\mathrm{page}}\) 个 token，最近的可恢复状态可能位于 \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\)，从而迫使目标模型重放 token \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\) 到 \(T\)，仅仅为了恢复 token \(T\) 处的隐藏状态。

items.en: We improved this path by optionally retaining an additional Mamba cache page near the speculative-decoding replay boundary. For example, if a workload uses a 16-token fine-grained prefix-match unit, the additional checkpoint can be placed near \(T-16\) rather than \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\). A subsequent request then replays only the final 16 target-model tokens instead of an entire Mamba block. The scheduler and cache manager jointly select and publish a valid checkpoint at the shared prefix boundary, avoiding stale recurrent state while trading one additional Mamba page for substantially less target-model recomputation.
items.zh: 我们改进了这一路径：可选地在推测解码重放边界附近额外保留一个 Mamba 缓存页。例如，若某工作负载使用 16 token 的细粒度前缀匹配单元，则可将额外检查点放在 \(T-16\) 附近，而非 \(T-L_{\mathrm{page}}\)。这样，后续请求只需重放最后 16 个目标模型 token，而无需重放整个 Mamba 块。调度器与缓存管理器在共享前缀边界处联合选择并发布一个有效检查点，从而避免使用过期的循环状态，并以额外一个 Mamba 页为代价换取目标模型重计算量的大幅减少。

items.en: The issue is less pronounced for non-SSM models because their cache pages span far fewer tokens, so replaying from the preceding page boundary is inexpensive. It is also more important for Nemotron 3.5 Super than for hybrid SSM models with smaller recurrent states: Mamba-2's larger cache-page footprint makes \(L_{\mathrm{page}}\) larger and amplifies the work avoided by the finer checkpoint. The resulting mechanism makes prefix caching and speculative decoding composable: prefix caching removes repeated prefill work, while speculative decoding reduces the number of target-model decode steps after prefill.
items.zh: 该问题在非 SSM 模型中不那么突出，因为其缓存页跨越的 token 数少得多，从前一页边界重放的代价很低。该问题对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 也比对循环状态更小的混合 SSM 模型更为重要：Mamba-2 更大的缓存页占用使 \(L_{\mathrm{page}}\) 更大，从而放大了更细粒度检查点所避免的工作量。由此形成的机制使前缀缓存与推测解码可组合：前缀缓存消除重复的预填充工作，而推测解码减少预填充之后目标模型的解码步数。

full.sec: 5.4 Kernel control at the target operating point
full.secZh: 5.4 目标操作点下的内核控制

items.en: The kernel that maximizes throughput at saturation is not necessarily the kernel that gives the best end-to-end result at an intermediate batch size. Our target lies in precisely this intermediate regime: we need enough batching to obtain high aggregate throughput while preserving at least 50 output tokens/s/user. Furthermore, a mixed-precision checkpoint may contain linear layers with different quantization schemes, whose GEMM shapes and best backends differ. A single process-wide backend selection therefore couples decisions that should be tuned independently.
items.zh: 在饱和状态下最大化吞吐量的内核，不一定是在中等批处理大小下能给出最佳端到端结果的内核。我们的目标恰恰位于这个中等区间：我们需要足够的批处理来获得高聚合吞吐量，同时保持至少 50 输出 tokens/s/用户。此外，混合精度检查点可能包含具有不同量化方案的线性层，其 GEMM 形状和最佳后端各不相同。因此，单一的进程级后端选择会将本应独立调优的决策耦合在一起。

items.en: The global linear backend remains the default, while a kernel configuration can override it for a specific quantization scheme - for example, selecting a specialized backend for NVFP4 W4A16 layers while leaving other linear layers on the platform default. This finer control lets a deployment choose the best-supported GEMM implementation for each quantization scheme and accelerator without maintaining separate model artifacts or forcing every quantized layer through the same path. It also makes the serving configuration portable: Hopper, Blackwell, and compact systems can use different backend maps while preserving the same model and workload-level objective. 2323 23 https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51204
items.zh: 全局线性后端保持为默认值，而内核配置可以针对特定的量化方案覆盖它——例如，为 NVFP4 W4A16 层选择专用后端，同时将其他线性层保留在平台默认值上。这种更细粒度的控制让部署可以为每种量化方案和加速器选择最佳支持的 GEMM 实现，而无需维护单独的模型工件或强制每个量化层走相同的路径。它还使服务配置具有可移植性：Hopper、Blackwell 和紧凑型系统可以使用不同的后端映射，同时保持相同的模型和工作负载级目标。2323 23 https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51204

items.en: One inference performance improvement grows out of a suggestion in the Nemotron v3 Ultra Technical report. During a decoding step of the Mamba-2 layer, for non-speculative decoding we have the recurrent state \(S\) and per-token inputs key vector \(k\), value vector \(v\), decay scalar \(\alpha\), and query vector \(q\). The new recurrent state is then \(S_{new} = \alpha S_{old} + k^{\top} v\), and the output \(o = q S_{new}\). For speculative decoding we do this for the \(T\) incoming tokens’ worth of input, writing out each possible new state as we do not know how many tokens will be accepted. This results in decoding being extremely memory bound, and it also limits batch_size * draft_length for speculative decoding due to limited memory capacity.
items.zh: 一项推理性能改进源自 Nemotron v3 Ultra 技术报告中的建议。在 Mamba-2 层的解码步骤中，对于非推测解码，我们有循环状态 \(S\) 以及每个 token 的输入键向量 \(k\)、值向量 \(v\)、衰减标量 \(\alpha\) 和查询向量 \(q\)。新的循环状态则为 \(S_{new} = \alpha S_{old} + k^{\top} v\)，输出为 \(o = q S_{new}\)。对于推测解码，我们对 \(T\) 个输入 token 执行此操作，并写出每个可能的新状态，因为我们不知道将接受多少个 token。这导致解码极度受内存限制，并且由于内存容量有限，它还限制了推测解码的 batch_size * draft_length。

items.en: We have since implemented a "checkpointing replay" method. We store a checkpointed state \(S_{ckpt}\) and store the \(k_{i}, v_{i}, \alpha_{i}\) seen since the checkpoint in a small buffer. As \(S = (\prod \alpha_{i}) S_{ckpt} + \sum_{i} (\prod_{j>i+1} \alpha_{j}) k_{i}^{\top} v_{i}\) we can reconstruct the state on-demand, and with no quantization error beyond what’s in \(S_{ckpt}\). Rejected tokens are handled by simply decrementing a counter, and new inputs are appended to the buffer. To generate output tokens, we can either reconstruct the state or we can generate output tokens more cheaply directly, by noting that (ignoring the \(\alpha\) terms for exposition) \(q S = q S_{ckpt} + \sum_{i} (q k_{i}^{\top}) v_{i}\). When our buffer fills up, we ’flush’ or ’fold’ it by reconstructing the state and writing it out. For speculative decoding we only include the accepted tokens from our history, with that step’s tokens seeding the start of the new history buffer.
items.zh: 我们此后实现了一种“检查点重放”方法。我们存储检查点状态 \(S_{ckpt}\)，并将自检查点以来看到的 \(k_{i}, v_{i}, \alpha_{i}\) 存储在一个小缓冲区中。由于 \(S = (\prod \alpha_{i}) S_{ckpt} + \sum_{i} (\prod_{j>i+1} \alpha_{j}) k_{i}^{\top} v_{i}\)，我们可以按需重建状态，并且除了 \(S_{ckpt}\) 中的量化误差外没有额外的量化误差。被拒绝的 token 通过简单地递减计数器来处理，新输入被追加到缓冲区。为了生成输出 token，我们可以重建状态，或者更便宜地直接生成输出 token，注意到（为说明忽略 \(\alpha\) 项）\(q S = q S_{ckpt} + \sum_{i} (q k_{i}^{\top}) v_{i}\)。当缓冲区填满时，我们通过重建状态并将其写出，来“刷新”或“折叠”它。对于推测解码，我们只包括历史中被接受的 token，该步骤的 token 作为新历史缓冲区的种子。
