items.en: This amortizes the state write over our buffer length, reducing our per-step state-related memory traffic from \(T+1\) to roughly \(1+1/L\). It also lets us amortize any computational overhead associated with writing the state, such as randomness generation, stochastic rounding, or scaling calculations. Especially for speculative decoding, the resulting formulae look a lot like chunked prefill, with the parts moved around. Like chunked prefill, the FLOP cost goes up but we get to move CUDA core work, namely matvecs and outer products, over to Tensor Cores, so actual compute time goes down. In summary, this method:
items.zh: 这将状态写入分摊到缓冲区长度上，将每步状态相关的内存流量从 \(T+1\) 减少到大约 \(1+1/L\)。它还让我们能够分摊与写入状态相关的任何计算开销，例如随机数生成、随机舍入或缩放计算。特别是对于推测解码，得到的公式看起来很像分块预填充，只是部分被移动了。与分块预填充一样，FLOP 成本上升，但我们可以将 CUDA 核心工作（即矩阵向量乘和外积）转移到 Tensor Cores，因此实际计算时间下降。总之，该方法：

items.en: Reduces memory traffic on an IO-bound operation.
items.zh: 减少 IO 密集型操作的内存流量。

items.en: Reduces compute time by shifting work to Tensor Cores.
items.zh: 通过将工作转移到 Tensor Cores 来减少计算时间。

items.en: Reduces quantization error by quantizing less often.
items.zh: 通过降低量化频率来减少量化误差。

items.en: Enables larger batch sizes and speculation lengths.
items.zh: 支持更大的批大小和推测长度。

items.en: For more details, see https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/14203. We note this technique was discovered concurrently and independently in the Dao lab, where it is called ReplaySSM, as described in their blog post (https://dao-lab.ai/blog/2026/replayssm/); we subsequently collaborated with them on the paper and on bringing it to vLLM.
items.zh: 更多细节请参见 https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/14203。我们注意到该技术由 Dao 实验室独立并行发现，他们称之为 ReplaySSM，如其博客文章（https://dao-lab.ai/blog/2026/replayssm/）所述；我们随后与他们合作完成了论文并将其引入 vLLM。

items.en: The workload comprises 20 turns with a 51,200-token shared prefix, 2,048-token input per turn, and 1,024-token output.
items.zh: 该工作负载包含 20 轮，具有 51,200 个 token 的共享前缀，每轮输入 2,048 个 token，输出 1,024 个 token。

full.sec: 5.5 Reducing the cost of Mamba checkpoints
full.secZh: 5.5 降低 Mamba 检查点成本

items.en: In aligned Mamba cache mode, a reusable recurrent state must be materialized at a cache-block boundary. The scheduling path can enforce this by ending a prefill step at that boundary and issuing an additional model forward for the remainder of the prompt. Although this produces the required state, the split repeats fixed forward-pass overhead and adds another traversal of the Attention, MoE, routing, and tensor-parallel communication paths.
items.zh: 在对齐的 Mamba 缓存模式下，必须在缓存块边界处物化可重用的循环状态。调度路径可以通过在该边界结束预填充步骤，并为提示的剩余部分发出额外的模型前向来强制执行这一点。尽管这产生了所需的状态，但拆分重复了固定的前向传递开销，并增加了对注意力机制、MoE、路由和张量并行通信路径的另一次遍历。

items.en: Internal prefill checkpointing was initially implemented in vLLM for Kimi K3. Building on that work, we adapted the shared checkpoint builder and exporter to Mamba-2 in PR #57329. The Mamba scan already materializes intermediate recurrent states at logical chunk boundaries. The adapted path arranges for a logical chunk to end at the desired cache boundary, extracts the state and convolution window there, and writes that checkpoint into the paged cache while the full prompt remains in one model forward. A prompt that previously required an additional forward after the checkpoint can therefore be processed in a single forward without sacrificing the reusable Mamba state.
items.zh: 内部预填充检查点最初是在 vLLM 中为 Kimi K3 实现的。基于这项工作，我们在 PR #57329 中将共享检查点构建器和导出器适配到了 Mamba-2。Mamba 扫描已经在逻辑块边界处物化了中间循环状态。适配后的路径安排逻辑块在所需的缓存边界结束，在那里提取状态和卷积窗口，并将该检查点写入分页缓存，同时整个提示保持在一个模型前向中。因此，以前需要在检查点之后进行额外前向的提示现在可以在单次前向中处理，而不会牺牲可重用的 Mamba 状态。

items.en: Taken together, these changes target the regime that matters most for Nemotron 3.5 Super deployment: shared and growing contexts, interactive decode rates, and hardware-specific configurations chosen from the useful portion of the throughput-latency frontier. Prefix-aware speculative decoding reduces both repeated prefill and decode work, per-quantization backend selection exposes the kernel choices needed to tune balanced operating points, and internal Mamba checkpoints reduce the cost of creating the reusable state on which the workload depends.
items.zh: 综上所述，这些更改针对的是 Nemotron 3.5 Super 部署最重要的场景：共享和增长的上下文、交互式解码速率，以及从吞吐量-延迟前沿的有用部分中选择的硬件特定配置。前缀感知的推测解码减少了重复的预填充和解码工作，按量化选择后端暴露了调整平衡工作点所需的内核选择，而内部 Mamba 检查点降低了创建工作负载所依赖的可重用状态的成本。

full.sec: 5.6 Disaggregated serving on NVIDIA Vera Rubin
full.secZh: 5.6 在 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 上的分离式服务

items.en: We serve the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL NVFP4 checkpoint with NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM on NVIDIA Vera Rubin (VR200) GPUs, with one GPU per model instance (no tensor parallelism). The workload replays multi-turn agentic coding sessions from SWE-bench Pro traces, with long contexts and high prefix reuse across turns. Speculative decoding uses the MTP head with a fixed acceptance length of 4.06 and draft length 5. A usable point keeps the median output speed at or above 50 tokens/s/user and the median time to first token (TTFT) below 5 s. We report output tokens/s per GPU at the highest-throughput load that meets this target.
items.zh: 我们在 NVIDIA Vera Rubin（VR200）GPU 上，使用 NVIDIA Dynamo 和 vLLM 部署 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL NVFP4 检查点，每个模型实例使用一块 GPU（不使用张量并行）。工作负载回放来自 SWE-bench Pro 轨迹的多轮智能体式编程会话，具有长上下文和跨轮次的高前缀复用。投机解码使用 MTP 头，固定接受长度为 4.06，草稿长度为 5。可用点要求中位输出速度不低于 50 tokens/s/user，且中位首 token 时间（TTFT）低于 5 s。我们报告在满足该目标的最高吞吐负载下，每 GPU 的输出 tokens/s。

items.en: Prefill reads the prompt and builds the KV cache, the stored attention state of earlier tokens. Decode then generates the output tokens. We compare two deployments on 11 GPUs each. The aggregated deployment runs 11 independent instances that each do prefill and decode. A KV-cache-aware router sends each request to an instance. The disaggregated deployment uses 7 GPUs for prefill only and 4 GPUs for decode only. After prefill, the KV cache moves from the prefill GPU to the decode GPU.
items.zh: Prefill 读取提示并构建 KV cache，即先前 token 的已存储注意力状态。随后 Decode 生成输出 token。我们比较两种部署，每种各使用 11 块 GPU。聚合式部署运行 11 个独立实例，每个实例同时执行 prefill 和 decode。一个感知 KV cache 的路由器将每个请求发送到一个实例。分离式部署使用 7 块 GPU 仅用于 prefill，4 块 GPU 仅用于 decode。在 prefill 之后，KV cache 从 prefill GPU 迁移到 decode GPU。

items.en: Disaggregated serving gives 10.3% more output tokens/s per GPU than aggregated serving (Table 25). At its best point, the median output speed per user is also 61% higher. The median TTFT increases from 0.49 s to 1.12 s, but stays well below the 5 s target. Prefill and decode no longer share a GPU. As a result, the decode GPUs run larger decode batches without long prefills between decode steps.
items.zh: 分离式服务比聚合式服务每 GPU 的输出 tokens/s 高 10.3%（表 25）。在其最佳点，每用户的中位输出速度也高出 61%。中位 TTFT 从 0.49 s 增加到 1.12 s，但仍远低于 5 s 的目标。Prefill 和 decode 不再共享一块 GPU。因此，decode GPU 可以运行更大的 decode 批次，而无需在 decode 步骤之间插入长 prefill。

items.en: Both deployments use the engine settings that follow. The weights use NVFP4 and the KV cache uses FP8. The Mamba state cache uses FP16 with stochastic rounding, as in Section 4. The compiler fuses each attention operation with the quantization of its output. The engine captures CUDA graphs for full and piecewise model steps. In decode attention, one wave of GPU work can allow only one or two splits of the KV cache per request. The multi-wave KV split then splits the KV cache further and runs the work in several waves. We added this option to FlashInfer in PR #6331 (https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6331) and to vLLM in PR #61077 (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61077).
items.zh: 两种部署均使用以下引擎设置。权重使用 NVFP4，KV cache 使用 FP8。Mamba 状态缓存使用 FP16 并采用随机舍入，如第 4 节所述。编译器将每个注意力机制操作与其输出的量化融合。引擎为完整和分段模型步骤捕获 CUDA 图。在 decode 注意力机制中，一波 GPU 工作每个请求只允许对 KV cache 进行一到两次切分。多波 KV 切分随后进一步切分 KV cache，并在多个波中运行工作。我们将此选项添加到 FlashInfer 的 PR #6331（https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6331）和 vLLM 的 PR #61077（https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61077）。

items.en: The MTP head drafts 5 tokens per step. Prefix caching stores Mamba states at KV-cache block boundaries, plus extra checkpoints at prefixes that several requests share. A vLLM option (disable_eagle_block_drop) lets a cache hit keep its last full block when speculative decoding is on. Each aggregated instance and each prefill GPU also has a 240 GiB KV cache tier in host (CPU) memory. This tier keeps the prefixes of earlier turns after the GPU cache evicts them.
items.zh: MTP 头每步起草 5 个 token。前缀缓存将 Mamba 状态存储在 KV cache 块边界处，并在多个请求共享的前缀处存储额外检查点。一个 vLLM 选项（disable_eagle_block_drop）允许在开启投机解码时，缓存命中保留其最后一个完整块。每个聚合实例和每个 prefill GPU 还在主机（CPU）内存中拥有一个 240 GiB 的 KV cache 层级。该层级在 GPU 缓存逐出先前轮次的前缀后保留这些前缀。

items.en: Each worker publishes KV-cache events, so the router knows which cache blocks each worker holds. Session affinity sends all turns of one session to the same worker, so later turns find their prefix in its cache. In the disaggregated deployment, NIXL moves the KV cache from the prefill GPU to the decode GPU.
items.zh: 每个 worker 都会发布 KV-cache 事件，因此路由器知道每个 worker 持有哪些缓存块。会话亲和性会把同一会话的所有轮次都发送到同一个 worker，因此后续轮次能在其缓存中找到前缀。在分离式部署中，NIXL 会把 KV cache 从 prefill GPU 迁移到 decode GPU。

full.secZh: 5.7 使用并行草稿模型的推测解码

items.en: Alongside the native MTP head (Sections 2.1 and 3.7), we release LiLiCorr, a standalone drafter for Nemotron 3.5 Super that targets low-concurrency serving, where decoding is strongly memory-bandwidth bound. This release builds on our earlier parallel-drafter work for Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, for which we trained and released separate DFlash and DSpark checkpoints. The Nemotron 3.5 Lightning DFlash uses non-causal, full-sequence grouped-query attention, whereas the released DSpark uses causal grouped-query attention with sliding-window attention in every layer and per-head attention sinks. Bringing these models to release also required W4A16 post-training quantization (Section 4.8) and vLLM optimizations for the DSpark Markov head.
items.zh: 除了原生的 MTP 头（第 2.1 节和第 3.7 节），我们发布了 LiLiCorr，这是一个用于 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的独立草稿模型，面向低并发服务场景，在该场景中解码严重受限于内存带宽。此发布基于我们之前为 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 所做的并行草稿模型工作，当时我们训练并发布了独立的 DFlash 和 DSpark 检查点。Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 的 DFlash 使用非因果的全序列分组查询注意力机制，而发布的 DSpark 使用因果分组查询注意力机制，并在每一层中采用滑动窗口注意力机制和每头注意力汇聚。将这些模型推向发布还需要 W4A16 后训练量化（第 4.8 节）以及针对 DSpark 马尔可夫头的 vLLM 优化。

items.en: In the low-concurrency regime targeted here, verifying a block of draft tokens costs similarly to generating a single token, so the speedup is determined jointly by the acceptance length and the latency of producing the draft. The recursive MTP head drafts one token per pass, so its drafting latency grows with the draft length, while parallel drafters propose all draft tokens in a single forward pass whose latency is nearly independent of the draft length. MTP is part of the model checkpoint and requires no additional weights, whereas DFlash, DSpark, and LiLiCorr are separate drafter checkpoints aimed at this regime.
items.zh: 在此针对的低并发场景中，验证一个草稿令牌块的成本与生成单个令牌相似，因此加速效果由接受长度和生成草稿的延迟共同决定。递归 MTP 头每次传递草稿一个令牌，因此其草稿延迟随草稿长度增长，而并行草稿模型在单次前向传递中提出所有草稿令牌，其延迟几乎与草稿长度无关。MTP 是模型检查点的一部分，不需要额外的权重，而 DFlash、DSpark 和 LiLiCorr 是针对此场景的独立草稿模型检查点。

items.en: A parallel drafter is trained on the marginal distribution at each block position, henceforth a slot, so tokens selected independently at each slot can be individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. DSpark addresses this with a semi-autoregressive design. It keeps the drafter body parallel and adds a lightweight sequential head that biases the logits at each slot using a low-rank transition from the token drafted at the previous slot. In the full DSpark design, a separate confidence head estimates the probability that each draft prefix will be accepted, allowing the serving engine to adapt the verification length to the request and system load. The Lightning 3.5 release used the lightweight Markov correction but omitted this confidence head. LiLiCorr instead uses a lightweight, single-pass correlation head to score compatibility across slots.
items.zh: 并行草稿模型在每个块位置（以下称为槽）上基于边缘分布进行训练，因此每个槽独立选择的令牌可能各自合理但联合起来不连贯。DSpark 通过半自回归设计解决了这个问题。它保持草稿模型主体并行，并添加一个轻量级顺序头，该头使用来自前一个槽所草稿令牌的低秩转移来偏置每个槽的 logits。在完整的 DSpark 设计中，一个单独的置信度头估计每个草稿前缀被接受的概率，允许服务引擎根据请求和系统负载调整验证长度。Lightning 3.5 版本使用了轻量级马尔可夫校正但省略了此置信度头。LiLiCorr 则使用轻量级单次传递相关头来评分跨槽的兼容性。

items.en: At each of the \(B-1\) drafted slots, LiLiCorr retains the \(K\) most probable tokens of the drafter body's marginal as candidates and processes the resulting \((B-1)\times K\) candidate lattice jointly with a small Transformer, so that each candidate is represented in the context of all others in the block. For the \(k\)-th candidate at slot \(s\), with \(k=1,\dots,K\) and \(s=1,\dots,B-1\), the head emits a unit-norm out vector \(\mathbf{o}_{s,k}\) and in vector \(\mathbf{i}_{s,k}\). Slot \(0\) holds the last token committed by the target. Since this token is already fixed, it is the only candidate at slot \(0\) and carries a single out vector \(\mathbf{o}_{0,1}\). The compatibility of candidate \(k\) at slot \(s\) with candidate \(k^{\prime}\) at slot \(s+1\) is the cosine similarity between the out vector of the former and the in vector of the latter:
items.zh: 在 \(B-1\) 个草稿槽位中的每一个，LiLiCorr 保留 drafter body 边缘分布中概率最高的 \(K\) 个 token 作为候选，并用一个小型 Transformer 联合处理由此得到的 \((B-1)\times K\) 候选格，使每个候选都在块内所有其他候选的上下文中得到表示。对于槽位 \(s\) 处的第 \(k\) 个候选（\(k=1,\dots,K\)，\(s=1,\dots,B-1\)），该 head 输出一个单位范数的 out 向量 \(\mathbf{o}_{s,k}\) 和一个 in 向量 \(\mathbf{i}_{s,k}\)。槽位 \(0\) 保存目标模型最后提交的 token。由于该 token 已经固定，它是槽位 \(0\) 处唯一的候选，并携带单个 out 向量 \(\mathbf{o}_{0,1}\)。槽位 \(s\) 处的候选 \(k\) 与槽位 \(s+1\) 处的候选 \(k^{\prime}\) 的兼容性，定义为前者的 out 向量与后者的 in 向量之间的余弦相似度：

items.en: where \(\sigma\) is a fixed scale. Writing \(\hat{c}_{s}\) for the index of the candidate committed at slot \(s\), with \(\hat{c}_{0}=1\), the block is committed from left to right, each slot selecting the candidate most compatible with its committed predecessor:
items.zh: 其中 \(\sigma\) 是固定尺度。记 \(\hat{c}_{s}\) 为槽位 \(s\) 处提交的候选索引，且 \(\hat{c}_{0}=1\)，则块从左到右依次提交，每个槽位选择与其已提交前驱最兼容的候选：

items.en: Under probabilistic draft sampling, each slot is instead drawn from the head's distribution over its candidates at the request's temperature. All vectors come from one pass of the head and the pairwise scores in Eq. (4) reduce to batched matrix products, so only the walk is sequential, and it requires no further network evaluation. Verification is unchanged, so the output distribution of the target is preserved exactly.
items.zh: 在概率式草稿采样下，每个槽位改为按请求温度从 head 在其候选上的分布中抽取。所有向量均来自 head 的一次前向，且式 (4) 中的成对得分可归约为批量矩阵乘积，因此只有游走过程是串行的，且无需进一步的网络评估。验证过程保持不变，因此目标模型的输出分布被精确保持。

items.en: We train the drafter body and the LiLiCorr head jointly in NVIDIA Model Optimizer (ModelOpt), in a streaming configuration suited to a target of this size. Replicas of the target's language model are served in BF16 by vLLM, each with tensor parallelism of four, and stream the hidden states of five captured target layers, together with the final hidden state, to \(64\) trainer GPUs. The target's next-token distribution, which the objective below requires, is reconstructed on the trainer from the final hidden state through the target's own LM head, so the target body is never replicated on the trainer ranks. The drafter uses a block of \(B=8\) positions, i.e., \(7\) drafted slots. Each of the five layers of the drafter body wraps the attention and MLP sublayers in a grouped dynamic convolution inspired by DFlash2, which lets neighboring slots exchange local information while the block remains parallel. The LiLiCorr head keeps the configuration of the original work. The resulting drafter has \(1.13\) B parameters, of which \(37\) M belong to the head.
items.zh: 我们在 NVIDIA Model Optimizer（ModelOpt）中联合训练 drafter body 与 LiLiCorr head，采用适合此规模目标的流式配置。目标语言模型的副本由 vLLM 以 BF16 提供，每个副本使用四路张量并行，并将五个捕获的目标层隐藏状态连同最终隐藏状态流式传输到 \(64\) 块训练 GPU。下方目标所需的下一词分布，在训练器上通过目标模型自身的 LM head 从最终隐藏状态重建，因此目标主体从不在训练器 rank 上复制。drafter 使用 \(B=8\) 个位置的块，即 \(7\) 个草稿槽位。drafter body 的五层中每一层都将注意力机制与 MLP 子层包裹在受 DFlash2 启发的分组动态卷积中，使相邻槽位能够交换局部信息，同时块保持并行。LiLiCorr head 保持原工作的配置。所得 drafter 具有 \(1.13\) B 参数，其中 \(37\) M 属于该 head。

items.en: The original work trains the drafter body with a cross-entropy against the tokens of the target-generated training responses, weighted by the exponential position decay of DFlash. We depart from this recipe and, as in MTP boosting (Section 3.7), instead distill the full next-token distribution \(p_{M}\) of the target model \(M\), which is available from the streamed hidden states, while keeping the same decay. Consider a training block that starts at position \(t\) of a training sequence \(x\), with \(x_{t}\) at slot \(0\), so that slot \(s\) predicts the token \(x_{t+s}\) from the prefix \(x_{<t+s}\). Its loss is
items.zh: 原工作使用针对目标模型生成的训练响应 token 的交叉熵来训练 drafter body，并由 DFlash 的指数位置衰减加权。我们偏离这一配方，如 MTP boosting（第 3.7 节）那样，改为蒸馏目标模型 \(M\) 的完整下一词分布 \(p_{M}\)（该分布可从流式隐藏状态获得），同时保持相同的衰减。考虑一个从训练序列 \(x\) 的位置 \(t\) 开始的训练块，其中 \(x_{t}\) 位于槽位 \(0\)，因此槽位 \(s\) 从前缀 \(x_{<t+s}\) 预测 token \(x_{t+s}\)。其损失为

The loss is averaged over blocks whose starting positions are sampled from each sequence. Up to a constant, this is the forward KL divergence from \(p_{M}\) to \(p_{\theta,s}\). items.en: We presented Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Through large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), both models combine strong capabilities with efficient inference. Nemotron 3.5 Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training, while a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, specialized teacher training, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation transforms it into a multimodal agent. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning follows a lighter text-only post-training pipeline optimized for efficient deployment.
items.zh: 我们提出了 Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体式工作负载设计的高效混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型。通过大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练以及原生的多词元预测（Multi-Token Prediction，MTP），两个模型都将强大能力与高效推理结合在一起。Nemotron 3.5 Super 进一步引入了 Indic 继续预训练与智能体式软件工程中期训练，而涵盖监督微调、强化学习、专用教师训练与多教师同策略蒸馏的完整后训练流水线，将其转化为一个多模态智能体。Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 则采用更轻量的纯文本后训练流水线，针对高效部署进行了优化。

items.en: Our results demonstrate improvements across capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens long-horizon software engineering and robustness across agent harnesses. The final Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, outperforming Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6 \(\times\) fewer active parameters. Test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification further improves Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 62.7% to 71.9%. On the efficiency side, post-training MTP boosting improves speculative-decoding acceptance length by 10.1% under greedy decoding and 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.52% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. On GB200, Super achieves 1.9 \(\times\) the serving throughput of Qwen3.8 Flash-Next under the evaluated interactive agentic workload.
items.zh: 我们的结果展示了在能力与效率两方面的提升。Indic 继续预训练将印度语基准提升最多 9.82 个百分点，而智能体式中期训练增强了长时程软件工程能力以及跨智能体框架（agent harness）的鲁棒性。最终的 Super 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到 51.78%，尽管其激活参数约少 4.6 \(\times\)，仍优于 Nemotron 3 Ultra。通过并行智能体执行与自我验证实现的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）进一步将 Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 62.7% 提升至 71.9%。在效率方面，后训练阶段的 MTP 增强在贪心解码下将推测解码的接受长度提升 10.1%，在概率性草稿采样下提升 21.8%；而 NVFP4 量化相对于 BF16 实现了 99.52% 的中位精度恢复。在 GB200 上，在所评估的交互式智能体式工作负载下，Super 的 serving 吞吐量达到 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 的 1.9 \(\times\)。

items.en: Together, these results demonstrate the benefits of jointly optimizing pretraining, post-training, and inference for capable and efficient agentic models. We release model checkpoints, datasets, and supporting recipes and cookbooks to enable further research and development of open agentic AI systems.
items.zh: 综合来看，这些结果证明了联合优化预训练、后训练与推理，对于构建能力强且高效的智能体式模型所带来的收益。我们发布了模型检查点、数据集以及配套的配方与 cookbook，以促进开放智能体式 AI 系统的进一步研究与开发。

full.sec: B.1 Runaway loop: the termination failure in truncated rollouts
full.secZh: B.1 失控循环：截断式 rollout 中的终止失败

items.en: Reasoning length is not a defect; long reasoning in an agentic workload is mostly probing such as running code, invoking tools, and reading back the result. A model's abstention can fail by two mechanisms: knowledge collapse, which produces hallucination, and reasoning collapse, which produces termination failure, seen as semantic runaway looping behavior. Qualitatively, the runaway loop is recognizable as failed negative proof: the model cannot certify a negative result from exhaustive investigation, but confidently reopens a settled conclusion and cycles. Therefore, a non-terminating agent emits more calls of ordinary length, with per-call statistics steady, rather than longer calls. Eventually, the rollout's last reasoning starts exploding in length, or the truncation rate increases.
items.zh: 推理长度本身并非缺陷；在智能体式工作负载中，长推理主要是在进行探查，例如运行代码、调用工具并读回结果。模型的弃答可能以两种机制失败：知识崩溃，会产生幻觉；以及推理崩溃，会产生终止失败，表现为语义上的失控循环行为。从定性上看，失控循环可被识别为失败的否定性证明：模型无法通过穷尽式调查来确证一个否定结果，却自信地重新打开一个已定的结论并循环往复。因此，一个无法终止的智能体会发出更多普通长度的调用，且每次调用的统计量保持稳定，而不是发出更长的调用。最终，该 rollout 的最后一段推理开始长度爆炸，或者截断率上升。

items.en: We identify the runaway loop by reading reasoning passages in postmortem, while tracking the failure of a model to terminate as it runs to the context wall. Table 31 reports the two immediately measurable quantities: truncation, the fraction of rollouts containing at least one model call hitting an output limit, and output length per rollout. The combination of these two quantities is a useful early-warning indicator. For example, tau3-banking has 20.9% truncation and 35,173 output tokens per rollout before MOPD, where we detect 19.7% runaway loop failures (153/776 rollouts). After MOPD, truncation decreases to 0.3% with 13,669 output tokens per rollout, where only one runaway loop failure is captured.
items.zh: 我们通过在事后剖析中阅读推理段落来识别失控循环，同时追踪模型在运行至上下文窗口上限时无法终止的失败。表 31 报告了两个可直接测量的量：截断，即至少包含一次触及输出上限的模型调用的 rollout 所占比例；以及每个 rollout 的输出长度。这两个量的组合是一个有用的早期预警指标。例如，tau3-banking 在 MOPD 之前有 20.9% 的截断率和每个 rollout 35,173 个输出 token，此时我们检测到 19.7% 的失控循环失败（153/776 个 rollout）。在 MOPD 之后，截断率降至 0.3%，每个 rollout 的输出为 13,669 个 token，此时仅捕获到一次失控循环失败。

items.en: a evaluation harness update resulted in ISL difference.
items.zh: 一次评估框架（evaluation harness）更新导致了 ISL 差异。

full.sec: B.2 FP4 weight quantization swings the stop-versus-continue margin
full.secZh: B.2 FP4 权重量化改变停止与继续的边际

items.en: Quantized models inherit the runaway loop behavior from the base model, and quantization can make it worse. We divide and conquer the degradation by ablating non-attention components in pre-MOPD models:
items.zh: 量化模型继承了基模型的失控循环行为，而量化可能使其更严重。我们通过在 pre-MOPD 模型中消融非注意力机制组件来分而治之地分析性能退化：

items.en: Routed/shared experts NVFP4 \(\rightarrow\) FP8. In tau3-banking, runaway dropped from 28.2% \(\rightarrow\) 17.9%, below the BF16 reference's 19.7%; output verbosity decreased by 21.5% at 2.7 \(\sigma\). This rules out expert weights being innocent.
items.zh: 路由/共享专家 NVFP4 \(\rightarrow\) FP8。在 tau3-banking 中，失控率从 28.2% \(\rightarrow\) 降至 17.9%，低于 BF16 参考的 19.7%；输出冗长度在 2.7 \(\sigma\) 下降低了 21.5%。这排除了专家权重无辜的可能性。

items.en: Expert activations \(\rightarrow\) BF16. Runaway moves by \(\approx 0\); output verbosity falls on 5 of 5 focused benchmarks (mmlongbench-doc, scicode, tau3-banking, tau2-AA, AA-LCR). This eliminates the activation path as the carrier of the termination failure.
items.zh: 专家激活 \(\rightarrow\) BF16。失控率变化 \(\approx 0\)；输出冗长度在 5 个聚焦基准（mmlongbench-doc、scicode、tau3-banking、tau2-AA、AA-LCR）中的 5 个上均下降。这排除了激活路径作为终止失败载体的可能。

items.en: lm_head returned to BF16. No recovery of termination is captured. This eliminates the final output token generation as the source of the runaway loop.
items.zh: lm_head 恢复为 BF16。未观察到终止行为的恢复。这排除了最终输出词生成作为失控循环来源的可能。

items.en: W4A4 expert GEMM output error. The relative L2 norm error is estimated to be 7.5–22.9% against BF16, which is above 10% in 39 of 40 MoE layers, and 15% on average. This eliminates "the small perturbation can be ignored".
items.zh: W4A4 专家 GEMM 输出误差。相对于 BF16 的相对 L2 范数误差估计为 7.5–22.9%，在 40 个 MoE 层中有 39 个超过 10%，平均为 15%。这排除了“小扰动可以忽略”的说法。

items.en: Mamba output projection \(\rightarrow\) W4A16. In tau3-banking, output verbosity increased by 18.5% at 2.4 \(\sigma\), while the runaway rate and knowledge abstention were both unaffected.
items.zh: Mamba 输出投影 \(\rightarrow\) W4A16。在 tau3-banking 中，输出冗长度在 2.4 \(\sigma\) 处增加了 18.5%，而失控率和知识弃答均未受影响。

items.en: By putting all the pieces together, we hypothesize the culprit is the quantization of the expert weights. Promoting expert weights to FP8 mitigates the runaway loop on pre-MOPD models, while post-MOPD model quantization successfully recovers the verbosity without runaway loop regression in FP4 expert weights. The Mamba result carries over to the post-MOPD checkpoints: against a quantization recipe keeping output projection at W8A8, W4A16 is more verbose on all 6 benchmark tests. Please refer to Appendix B.4. Note that a perturbation from FP4 expert weights does not destroy information, so knowledge abstention is not affected across all experiments. AA-OmniScience non-hallucination spans only \(0.991\times\) to \(1.022\times\) across the five ablations, which corresponds to \(67.8\%) and \(69.9\%) against BF16's \(68.4\%).
items.zh: 综合所有线索，我们推测罪魁祸首是专家权重的量化。将专家权重提升至 FP8 可缓解 pre-MOPD 模型上的失控循环，而对 post-MOPD 模型进行量化则成功恢复了冗长度，且 FP4 专家权重未出现失控循环回归。Mamba 的结果同样适用于 post-MOPD 检查点：与将输出投影保持在 W8A8 的量化方案相比，W4A16 在所有 6 项基准测试中均更为冗长。请参阅附录 B.4。注意，FP4 专家权重带来的扰动不会破坏信息，因此在所有实验中知识弃答均未受影响。在五次消融中，AA-OmniScience 非幻觉率仅在 \(0.991\times\) 至 \(1.022\times\) 之间波动，对应 \（67.8\%）和 \（69.9\%），而 BF16 为 \（68.4\%）。

items.en: On the other hand, MOPD fortifies the latent support for stopping enough to withstand FP4 quantization noise. Under MOPD, which loops on only 1 of 776 of these rollouts, the same prompts recover to \(0.081\) and \(0.077\) while \(\beta\) stays at the elevated \(0.16\), and FP4 expert weight quantization leaves them at \(0.081\) and \(0.078\), where runaway loop failures are reported in 3 cases only. Table 33 shows that reading the unembedding's decision directly confirms this: at the position where </think> is actually emitted, \(P(\text{stop})\) is \(0.99\) against \(10^{-9}\) or less elsewhere, and FP4 expert weights never cost a termination. FP4 experts affect the direction of the perturbation. It moves away from stopping on 17 of 23 pre-MOPD rollouts, but toward stopping on 20 of 24 under MOPD. On the runaway rollouts themselves, pre-MOPD's peak stop probability has median \(0.043\) and the reasoning block never closes, while MOPD reaches median \(0.729\) and closes the block in 6 of 10. GEMM error could not capture this difference because it covers the magnitude only, not the distribution and bias.
items.zh: 另一方面，MOPD 强化了停止的潜在支持，足以抵御 FP4 量化噪声。在 MOPD 下（这些 rollout 中仅 776 个里有 1 个出现循环），相同提示恢复至 \(0.081\) 和 \(0.077\)，而 \(\beta\) 保持在较高的 \(0.16\)，FP4 专家权重量化使其保持在 \(0.081\) 和 \(0.078\)，仅报告了 3 例失控循环失败。表 33 显示，直接读取 unembedding 的决策证实了这一点：在实际发出 </think> 的位置，\(P(\text{stop})\) 为 \(0.99\)，而其他位置为 \(10^{-9}\) 或更低，且 FP4 专家权重从未导致终止失败。FP4 专家影响扰动的方向。在 23 个 pre-MOPD rollout 中，有 17 个偏离停止；而在 MOPD 下，24 个中有 20 个朝向停止。在失控 rollout 本身，pre-MOPD 的峰值停止概率中位数为 \(0.043\)，且推理块从未闭合；而 MOPD 达到中位数 \(0.729\)，并在 10 个中有 6 个闭合了该块。GEMM 误差无法捕捉这一差异，因为它仅涵盖幅度，而不涵盖分布和偏差。

items.en: a lm_head puts </think> on top, at \(0.384\) and \(0.871\), but sampling did not take it and the loop continued.
items.zh: 一个 lm_head 将 </think> 置于顶部，分别为 \(0.384\) 和 \(0.871\)，但采样未采纳它，循环继续。

full.sec: B.3 The damage of long-context retrieval on attention projections
full.secZh: B.3 长上下文检索对注意力投影的损害

items.en: From the viewpoint of dense attention, long-context retrieval has three different perspectives on the decision:
items.zh: 从稠密注意力机制的角度来看，长上下文检索对决策有三种不同的视角：

items.en: Distinction: the target is identifiable by its content. The model must match on what a candidate says, wherever it sits.
items.zh: 区分：目标可以通过其内容识别。模型必须匹配候选者所说的内容，无论其位置在哪里。

items.en: Disambiguation: the candidates are near-identical, so content cannot separate them. The model must count or index occurrences by ordinal position.
items.zh: 消歧：候选者几乎相同，因此内容无法区分它们。模型必须按序数位置计数或索引出现次数。

items.en: Aggregation: there is no single target; evidence must be combined across many candidates.
items.zh: 聚合：没有单一目标；证据必须跨多个候选者组合。

items.en: Attention scores are resolution-starved before any projection error is added. A softmax output lies in \(0 \leq P \leq 1\), where a floating-point format mostly carries the magnitude in its exponent. As attention delivers \(O = PV\), a logit perturbation is a bit shift on the \(v\) vector. Table 34 describes measuring per head across 12 contexts spanning 10,532 to 63,641 prefix tokens, where 4,730 to 7,981 keys are co-located in the attention window. These keys compete for only 35 to 80 distinct e4m3 score levels, putting 60 to 120 keys on each level.
items.zh: 在添加任何投影误差之前，注意力分数就已经分辨率不足。softmax 输出位于 \(0 \leq P \leq 1\) 区间内，浮点格式主要通过指数携带幅度。由于注意力机制输出 \(O = PV\)，logit 扰动相当于对 \(v\) 向量进行位移。表 34 描述了在 12 个上下文（前缀 token 数从 10,532 到 63,641）上按头测量，其中 4,730 到 7,981 个键共置于注意力窗口内。这些键仅竞争 35 到 80 个不同的 e4m3 分数级别，导致每个级别上有 60 到 120 个键。

items.en: Suppose a distinction probe of GraphWalks, which reaches 361k tokens of observed context. From the exponential property of the logit, most per-position candidates are flat in attention scores. So is document-scale aggregation. While attention looks for a peak score, which is cleanly separated from other positions, a long-context workload requiring distinction and aggregation works well with FP8 or NVFP4 KV cache precision. Unfortunately, if candidates are near-identical by construction, so that nothing but position separates them, the precision becomes its limitation, as demonstrated by MRCR-128k.
items.zh: 假设 GraphWalks 的一个区分探针达到 361k 个观测上下文 token。由 logit 的指数性质，大多数逐位置候选在注意力分数上是平坦的，文档级聚合也是如此。注意力寻找的是与其他位置清晰分离的峰值分数，而需要区分与聚合的长上下文工作负载在 FP8 或 NVFP4 KV cache 精度下表现良好。不幸的是，如果候选在构造上近乎相同，除了位置之外没有任何东西能将它们区分开，那么精度本身就成了限制，正如 MRCR-128k 所展示的那样。

items.en: Even though the total attention mass is preserved, per-level key concentration destroys the resolution in quantization. As shown in Table 19, the BF16-over-FP8 on \(q/k/v\) is worth \(0.83\) pp, with a standard error of \(0.71\) pp for MRCR-128k. This might be interpreted as an insignificant improvement, as MXFP8 projection gains \(+0.99\) pp against the per-tensor FP8, which places it \(0.16\) pp on the far side of BF16. Neither contrast clears \(2\sigma\) (= \(1.4\) pp) under the standard variance. Likewise, the last row of Table 34 might suggest damage grows smoothly with context length. It does not grow linearly. Table 35 stratifies 1,470 MRCR-128k tasks at three repetitions to separate the retrieval from decoding noise. The ablations show the damage is present at every length, but exacerbated at 32k+: \(q/k/v\) FP8 retains \(95.3\%) and \(95.5\%) below 32k, against \(91.4\%) and \(92.1\%) above 32k, a \(3.6\) pp break. On the contrary, \(q/k/v\) MXFP8 projection recovers \(95.3\%) and \(94.3\%) above 32k, similar to \(q/k/v\) BF16. Substituting MXFP8 for per-tensor FP8 on \(q/k/v\) changes only the scale granularity, with one E8M0 exponent per 32 elements instead of one float per tensor, which is enough to close the gap. Crowding a level only costs accuracy when the co-resident keys are confusable, and unrelated context does not threaten a retrieval whose target has a wide margin.
items.zh: 尽管总注意力质量得以保留，逐层级的键集中会破坏量化中的分辨率。如表 19 所示，在 MRCR-128k 上，\(q/k/v\) 上 BF16 相对 FP8 的价值为 \(0.83\) pp，标准误为 \(0.71\) pp。这可能被解读为不显著的改进，因为 MXFP8 投影相对逐张量 FP8 获得 \(+0.99\) pp，使其位于 BF16 另一侧 \(0.16\) pp 处。在标准方差下，两个对比都未达到 \(2\sigma\)（= \(1.4\) pp）。同样，表 34 的最后一行可能暗示损害随上下文长度平滑增长。它并非线性增长。表 35 在三次重复下对 1,470 个 MRCR-128k 任务进行分层，以将检索与解码噪声分开。消融实验表明，损害在每个长度上都存在，但在 32k+ 处加剧：\(q/k/v\) FP8 在 32k 以下保持 \(95.3\)% 和 \(95.5\)%，而在 32k 以上为 \(91.4\)% 和 \(92.1\)%，出现 \(3.6\) pp 的断裂。相反，\(q/k/v\) MXFP8 投影在 32k 以上恢复到 \(95.3\)% 和 \(94.3\)%，与 \(q/k/v\) BF16 相似。在 \(q/k/v\) 上用 MXFP8 替代逐张量 FP8 只改变 scale 粒度，即每 32 个元素一个 E8M0 指数，而不是每个张量一个 float，这足以弥合差距。只有当共存的键容易混淆时，拥挤一个层级才会损失精度；而对于目标具有宽裕裕度的检索，无关上下文并不构成威胁。

items.en: On the other hand, Table 36 describes the BF16 collapse from 0.800 to 0.378 as the candidate count rises from two to eight, and that ordering holds inside every context band. Context also affects the damage, but its impact is not monotonically increasing: the baseline accuracy steps down by \(13.4\) to \(29.5\) pp between 0–8k and 8–32k and then saturates, so above 32k the candidate count is the dominant factor. This is the signature of an exhausted indexing budget rather than a strained context window.
items.zh: 另一方面，表 36 描述了当候选数量从 2 增加到 8 时，BF16 从 0.800 崩溃到 0.378，并且这一排序在每个上下文区间内都成立。上下文也影响损害，但其影响并非单调递增：基线精度在 0–8k 与 8–32k 之间下降 \(13.4\) 至 \(29.5\) pp，然后饱和，因此在 32k 以上，候选数量是主导因素。这是索引预算耗尽的特征，而不是上下文窗口紧张的特征。

items.en: In short, the damage is worst in the middle, smaller at two candidates where the margins are wide enough to absorb the error, and smaller again at eight where the reference has already collapsed and little remains to lose. Similar to the unembedding in Appendix B.5, quantization moves outcomes where the decision was already close. However, attention score is stronger evidence for a resolution mechanism: one that merely made everything harder would not spare the hardest stratum. From this observation, reporting a single number hides the damage in long-context benchmarks. It is important to stratify test cases along with capability partition to assess quantization damage properly.
items.zh: 简而言之，损害在中间最严重，在两个候选时较小，因为裕度足够宽以吸收误差；在八个候选时又较小，因为参考已经崩溃，几乎没有可失去的。与附录 B.5 中的 unembedding 类似，量化会改变那些决策本已接近的结果。然而，注意力分数是分辨率机制的更强证据：一个仅仅让一切变得更难的机制不会放过最难的层级。从这一观察来看，报告单一数字会掩盖长上下文基准中的损害。为了正确评估量化损害，重要的是将测试用例与能力划分一起分层。

items.en: On the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model, when we move the KV cache from FP8 to BF16 while keeping weights and projections fixed, MRCR-128k's accuracy recovers \(+1.43\) pp (= \(2.4\sigma\)); while moving the projections from FP8 to BF16, it recovers \(+2.97\) pp (= \(2.8\sigma\)). On the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model the impact of projection precision appears from our ablations. While the KV cache is the damage carrier, high-precision \(q/k/v\) projection does not prevent dilution; it buys back part of the margin destroyed by the cast. Table 37 varies attention projection precision on AA-LCR, an aggregation benchmark serving 108k tokens of context on average. As noted, aggregation benchmarks can identify important candidates in FP8, where even per-tensor FP8 precision can be acceptable over 100 tasks at sixteen repetitions. It also states an accuracy drop of \(2.50\) pp from all-FP8 to NVFP4 projections, with \(\mathrm{SE}=1.11\). Across the \(24\) \(q/k/v\) weight tensors, the spread of per-16-element block maxima is \(2.51\) binades at the median and \(8.78\) at worst, and the activations entering those projections span \(1.67\), which is against the \(17.81\) binades an E4M3 block scale encodes before it underflows. No block in the model loses its scale, leaving \(9.03\) binades unused on the worst tensor. Per-block granularity is not reclaiming dynamic range, but recovers precision headroom that a per-tensor scale had exhausted. For example, under a fused \(q/k/v\) FP8 projection with a single shared scale, the key projection holds it at six of eight attention layers and the value projection at the other two. Fusion adds roughly 32% relative weight error to \(q\) and \(v\) against 4% for \(k\), which is pure rounding noise.
items.zh: 在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 模型上，当我们在保持权重和投影固定的情况下将 KV cache 从 FP8 移到 BF16 时，MRCR-128k 的精度恢复 \(+1.43\) pp（= \(2.4\sigma\)）；而当将投影从 FP8 移到 BF16 时，它恢复 \(+2.97\) pp（= \(2.8\sigma\)）。在 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 模型上，投影精度的影响从我们的消融实验中显现。虽然 KV cache 是损害载体，但高精度 \(q/k/v\) 投影并不能防止稀释；它买回了被转换破坏的部分裕度。表 37 在 AA-LCR 上变化注意力投影精度，这是一个平均服务 108k 上下文 token 的聚合基准。如前所述，聚合基准可以在 FP8 中识别重要候选，其中即使在 100 个任务、十六次重复下，逐张量 FP8 精度也可以接受。它还指出从全 FP8 到 NVFP4 投影的精度下降为 \(2.50\) pp，\(\mathrm{SE}=1.11\)。在 \(24\) 个 \(q/k/v\) 权重张量中，每 16 元素块最大值的散布中位数为 \(2.51\) binade，最差为 \(8.78\)，而进入这些投影的激活跨度为 \(1.67\)，相比之下 E4M3 块 scale 在下溢前编码 \(17.81\) binade。模型中没有块丢失其 scale，在最差张量上留下 \(9.03\) binade 未使用。逐块粒度并非在回收动态范围，而是恢复了逐张量 scale 已耗尽的精度余量。例如，在具有单一共享 scale 的融合 \(q/k/v\) FP8 投影下，键投影在八个注意力层中的六个上保持它，而值投影在另外两个上保持它。融合给 \(q\) 和 \(v\) 增加了约 32% 的相对权重误差，而 \(k\) 为 4%，这纯粹是舍入噪声。

items.en: This study recommends FP8 precision on \(q/k/v\) projection at per-block scale granularity. If deployment does not perform disambiguation-style retrieval, however, no other workload would reveal a significant difference. After the softmax has chosen the target \(v\) vectors, the head outputs are passed to the output projection. Note that the spread of output projection weights is 4.21 binades in median and 8.15 in the worst case across eight attention layers, where output projection itself is not exposed to FP8 underflow. On the activation side, the calibrated per-tensor input scale is equally well-behaved: it sits at 49–76% of the largest head output norm at every attention layer, holding that fraction across a \(68\times\) range of absolute magnitude. Counterintuitively, the concatenation of head outputs under a single per-tensor input scale does not produce a benchmark-level penalty at FP8 precision. We claim that the output projection is structurally exposed and measurably tolerant in per-tensor FP8. In the meantime, it is worth noting that the mixed-precision checkpoints of §4.3, produced by a gradient-based per-layer search, follow these findings: the AutoQuant search leaves \(q/k/v\) in BF16 on three of the eight attention layers under both the 4.85 and 4.90 bit-per-parameter budgets, on the same three layers in each, while \(o\) stays FP8 on every attention layer under 4.85 and reaches BF16 on three layers only once the budget loosens to 4.90.
items.zh: 本研究建议在 per-block 尺度粒度上对 \(q/k/v\) 投影采用 FP8 精度。然而，如果部署不执行消歧式检索，则没有其他工作负载会显现出显著差异。在 softmax 选定目标 \(v\) 向量之后，各注意力头的输出被送入输出投影。注意，在八个注意力层上，输出投影权重的分布范围中位数为 4.21 binade、最坏情况为 8.15 binade，而输出投影本身并不会遭遇 FP8 下溢。在激活侧，经校准的 per-tensor 输入尺度同样表现良好：在每一个注意力层上，它都处于最大头输出范数的 49–76% 之间，并在 \(68\times\) 的绝对幅值范围内保持该比例。反直觉的是，在单一 per-tensor 输入尺度下对各头输出进行拼接，并不会在 FP8 精度下产生基准级别的性能损失。我们断言，输出投影在结构上是暴露的，并且在 per-tensor FP8 下可测量地具有容忍度。同时值得指出的是，§4.3 中由基于梯度的逐层搜索所生成的混合精度检查点与这些发现一致：在 4.85 与 4.90 比特每参数两种预算下，AutoQuant 搜索均在八个注意力层中的三层上将 \(q/k/v\) 保留为 BF16，且两种预算下均为相同的三层；而 \(o\) 在 4.85 下于每个注意力层都保持 FP8，只有当预算放宽至 4.90 时才在三层上达到 BF16。

full.sec: B.4 Mamba output projection: FP4 weights, and the sensitivity is on generation length
full.secZh: B.4 Mamba 输出投影：FP4 权重与生成长度的敏感性

items.en: The Mamba output projection differs from the expert fc2 in the input shape of the nonlinearity. Expert fc2 is fed by a squared-ReLU activation, where 90–99% of its input elements are exactly zero before quantization, and only 1.05–3.32 values survive per FP4 block. Mamba SSM cache passes a normalized SiLU gate to the output projection, which provides near-zero values but never exactly zero. Consequently, the input of Mamba output projection carries near 16 survivors per FP4 block, and \(27.6\)% of elements fall below the \(\text{amax}_{\text{block}}/24\) rounding limit under FP4 activation quantization. This tensor analysis stops us from taking the Mamba output projection to W4A4. Applying rotation or higher activation precision can mitigate the flush.
items.zh: Mamba 输出投影与专家 fc2 的区别在于非线性输入的形态。专家 fc2 的输入由平方 ReLU 激活函数提供，在量化前其输入元素中有 90–99% 恰好为零，每个 FP4 块中仅有 1.05–3.32 个值存活。Mamba SSM 缓存将归一化的 SiLU 门传递给输出投影，该门提供接近零但从不恰好为零的值。因此，Mamba 输出投影的输入在每个 FP4 块中约有 16 个存活值，并且在 FP4 激活量化下，有 \(27.6\)% 的元素低于 \(\text{amax}_{\text{block}}/24\) 的舍入限制。这一张量分析阻止我们将 Mamba 输出投影用于 W4A4。应用旋转或更高的激活精度可以缓解这种冲刷现象。

items.en: We evaluated the impact of FP4 weight quantization with W4A16 against FP8 W8A8. Due to high precision on activation, this contrast reveals the weight quantization effect directly. Table 38 shows the output verbosity inflation caused by FP4 weight quantization. All six benchmarks move in the same direction, with OSWorld and SciCode carrying the clearest inflation at \(1.27\)\(\times\) and \(1.16\)\(\times\). Note that each task accuracy is unchanged across two recipes. To address this issue, we preferred parameter alignment as described in §4.4.
items.zh: 我们评估了 W4A16 下 FP4 权重量化与 FP8 W8A8 的影响对比。由于激活精度较高，这种对比直接揭示了权重量化的效果。表 38 显示了由 FP4 权重量化导致的输出冗长膨胀。所有六个基准测试都朝同一方向变化，其中 OSWorld 和 SciCode 的膨胀最为明显，分别为 \(1.27\)\(\times\) 和 \(1.16\)\(\times\)。注意，每个任务的准确率在两种方案下保持不变。为了解决这个问题，我们倾向于采用 §4.4 中描述的参数量化对齐方法。

full.sec: B.5 The unembedding: FP8 weights, and the sensitivity is on termination
full.secZh: B.5 反嵌入层：FP8 权重，敏感性在于终止判断

items.en: The unembedding should stay at FP8 or above. As described in Table 39, NVFP4 lm_head also holds high top-1 agreement with BF16. FP4's problem is a failure of the stop-versus-continue decision, which results in output verbosity inflation.
items.zh: 反嵌入层应保持 FP8 或更高精度。如表 39 所述，NVFP4 的 lm_head 也与 BF16 保持较高的 top-1 一致率。FP4 的问题在于停止与继续决策的失败，这导致输出冗长膨胀。

items.en: We evaluate the decision as a single logit comparison, \(\text{margin}=h\cdot(v_{\text{stop}}-v_{\text{cont}})\. As </think> is one token, everything shared by the two unembedding rows cancels out. After quantization, the </think> row provides a cosine similarity of 0.9961 to the original. The vector barely moves, however 2.45% of decisions flip due to the other vectors providing \(\cos\approx 0.22\). This is because the decision lives in the difference of two nearly-orthogonal rows, where a small rotation of each becomes a large perturbation of their difference. “The weights look fine” and “the decision flipped” are both true. We rejected a hypothesis of quantization damage from frequency-skewed rare-token distribution in four ways:
items.zh: 我们将该决策评估为单个 logit 比较，\(\text{margin}=h\cdot(v_{\text{stop}}-v_{\text{cont}})\。由于 </think> 是一个 token，两个反嵌入行共享的部分相互抵消。量化后，</think> 行与原模型的余弦相似度为 0.9961。该向量几乎未移动，然而 2.45% 的决策发生翻转，因为其他向量提供的余弦相似度约为 \(\cos\approx 0.22\)。这是因为决策存在于两个近乎正交的行的差异中，其中每个行的小旋转都会变成它们差异的大扰动。“权重看起来没问题”和“决策翻转了”都是真的。我们通过四种方式拒绝了量化损伤源于频率偏斜的稀有 token 分布的假设：

items.en: Row-amax spread is 2.84 binades (2.12 binades at p99.9) against FP8's roughly 17.8 usable, so there is nothing to reclaim on per-block scale.
items.zh: 行最大绝对值的跨度为 2.84 binades（p99.9 处为 2.12 binades），而 FP8 约有 17.8 可用，因此在逐块尺度上没有可回收的空间。

items.en: Tested error ranging from group size of 1 through 64 elements, and the pooled error is identical to four decimal places per each format, i.e., 0.0265 in FP8, and 0.0952 in FP4.
items.zh: 测试了从组大小为 1 到 64 个元素的误差，每种格式的汇总误差在小数点后四位完全相同，即 FP8 中为 0.0265，FP4 中为 0.0952。

items.en: Per-row median spread by vocabulary-frequency quartile is 5.222 / 5.246 / 5.252 / 5.274 binades. In other words, a 0.05-binade drift across 131,072 tokens. There are zero dead rows in every configuration, and the lowest-norm decile of relative quantization error is no worse than the highest: 0.0941 versus 0.0952. The error is uniformly distributed across the vocabulary.
items.zh: 按词汇频率四分位数划分的每行中位数跨度为 5.222 / 5.246 / 5.252 / 5.274 binades。换言之，在 131,072 个 token 上仅有 0.05 binade 的漂移。所有配置中均无死行，且相对量化误差最低范数十分位数并不比最高范数十分位数差：0.0941 对 0.0952。误差在整个词汇表上均匀分布。

items.en: NVFP4 crosses its flush line on 66.9% of blocks, flushing 6.8% of elements, but this flush carries no vocabulary structure at any density level. Whatever it costs, it costs everywhere, so FP4 quantization cannot produce a loss concentrated in rare tokens.
items.zh: NVFP4 在 66.9% 的块上越过其冲刷线，冲刷掉 6.8% 的元素，但这种冲刷在任何密度水平上都不携带词表结构。无论其代价如何，代价都遍布各处，因此 FP4 量化无法产生集中于稀有 token 的损失。

items.en: The remaining hypothesis is per-element grid: E4M3 carries three mantissa bits providing a resolution of 12.5% step size (\(1 \rightarrow 1.125)\), whereas E2M1 carries one, providing a resolution of 50% step size (\(1 \rightarrow 1.5)\). To support this hypothesis, we emulated two-pass FP4 weights, where a second channel corrects the residual left below the \(\text{amax}/24\) flush line. This correction recovers the gap entirely: with a linear E2M1 residual the KL falls to \(0.00117\) against per-tensor FP8's \(0.00134\), and top-1 agreement with BF16 reaches \(0.9951\). Reducing the quantization error in lm_head is still open to exploration, but this suggests that the unembedding's numerical sensitivity is confined in FP8 precision.
items.zh: 剩余的假设是逐元素网格：E4M3 携带三个尾数位，提供 12.5% 步长的分辨率（\(1 \rightarrow 1.125)\），而 E2M1 只携带一个尾数位，提供 50% 步长的分辨率（\(1 \rightarrow 1.5)\）。为支持这一假设，我们模拟了双通道 FP4 权重，其中第二个通道校正残留在 \(\text{amax}/24\) 冲刷线以下的残差。这一校正完全弥补了差距：在采用线性 E2M1 残差时，KL 降至 \(0.00117\)，而逐张量 FP8 为 \(0.00134\)，且与 BF16 的 top-1 一致率达到 \(0.9951\)。降低 lm_head 中的量化误差仍有待探索，但这表明反嵌入层的数值敏感性局限于 FP8 精度之内。

full.sec: B.6 A precision recommendation with limitations
full.secZh: B.6 一项带有局限性的精度建议

items.en: The same quantization recipe, which aggravated the termination failure before RL post-training, reduced it afterwards. However, it does not modify the model's inherent structural effect. Across three checkpoints spanning pre-RL and post-RL training, the stop-versus-continue geometry is invariant to within 1% (cosine 0.997, margin 0.996, noise-to-margin 1.001), while termination behavior changed significantly. Together with the contribution profile, which is invariant to within 0.007 in routed experts, this gives a clean statement: RL post-training did not move the lm_head or the expert contribution structure; it changed where the hidden state points. A precision recommendation can therefore be stated in structural terms, but its margin protection must be checkpoint-dependent. Here are limitations of this study:
items.zh: 同一套量化方案在 RL 后训练之前会加剧终止失败，而在其后则减轻了该失败。然而，它并不改变模型固有的结构性效应。在跨越 RL 前与 RL 后训练的三个代表检查点上，停止与继续的几何结构在 1% 以内保持不变（余弦 0.997，margin 0.996，噪声-裕度比 1.001），而终止行为却发生了显著变化。结合在路由专家中变化不超过 0.007 的贡献分布，可以给出一个清晰的结论：RL 后训练并未移动 lm_head 或专家贡献结构；它改变的是隐藏状态所指向的位置。因此，精度建议可以用结构性的语言来表述，但其 margin 保护必须依赖于具体检查点。本研究的局限性如下：

items.en: The weight-versus-activation attribution for the termination failure is an inference from a bound: we did not experiment with W16A4.
items.zh: 关于终止失败的权重与激活归因，是从一个界推断而来的：我们并未对 W16A4 进行实验。

items.en: Expert GEMM output error and benchmark verbosity are two separate measurements, consistent in sign and magnitude. Nothing traces a specific displacement to a specific extra token; the relationship is coherent, not demonstrated causal.
items.zh: 专家 GEMM 输出误差与基准测试的冗长度是两项独立的测量，在符号和量级上保持一致。没有任何证据将某一具体位移追溯到某一具体的额外 token；该关系是自洽的，而非已证明的因果。

items.en: The attention score-path dilution is measured on clean weights as structure, not as a perturbation response.
items.zh: 注意力分数路径的稀释是在干净权重上作为结构来测量的，而非作为扰动响应。

items.en: Every configuration in this ablation study, including the BF16 reference, serves an FP8 KV cache; the ladder dilution is therefore present in the baseline too, and the projection deltas are measured on top of an already-diluted score.
items.zh: 本消融研究中的每一种配置，包括 BF16 参考配置，都服务于 FP8 KV cache；因此阶梯稀释在基线中同样存在，而投影增量是在已被稀释的分数之上测量的。

items.en: The disambiguation loss of MRCR-128k is measured against an unquantized reference with an FP8 KV cache, but the quantization uses a full configuration: FP8 KV cache, FP4 routed experts, and FP4 Mamba output projection. The KV cache is identified as the damage carrier in the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning study, but the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL ablation does not address BF16 KV precision to contrast its damage.
items.zh: MRCR-128k 的消歧损失是相对于一个采用 FP8 KV cache 的未量化参考来测量的，但量化使用的是完整配置：FP8 KV cache、FP4 路由专家以及 FP4 Mamba 输出投影。在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 研究中，KV cache 被认定为损害载体，但 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 消融并未涉及 BF16 KV 精度，因而无法对比其损害。

items.en: MRCR-128k is the only disambiguation instrument in the suite, so that limb of the result rests on a single benchmark. It carries three repetitions per task, which is enough to measure the decoding-noise floor but not to support per-stratum claims beyond the reported candidate-count split.
items.zh: MRCR-128k 是该套件中唯一的消歧工具，因此结果的这一分支仅依赖单一基准。它每个任务重复三次，这足以测量解码噪声下限，但不足以支持超出所报告候选数量划分之外的逐层（per-stratum）论断。

items.en: The unembedding measurements use a proxy input, \(\text{norm}_{f}(\text{hidden}+\text{residual})\) at the last layer, i.e., the true input minus that layer's own MoE contribution. Both tests receive the identical input, so the comparison isolates unembedding quantization exactly; the absolute rates are not the model's true output on those tokens.
items.zh: 反嵌入（unembedding）测量使用一个代理输入，即最后一层的 \(\text{norm}_{f}(\text{hidden}+\text{residual})\)，也就是真实输入减去该层自身的 MoE 贡献。两项测试接收完全相同的输入，因此该比较精确地隔离了反嵌入量化；绝对比率并非模型在这些 token 上的真实输出。

items.en: The contribution analysis uses two fixed token windows, one per training stage (pre-MOPD versus MOPD). Within a stage, the BF16-versus-FP4 contrast holds the fixed window to isolate the weights, which establishes the invariant contribution profile with or without quantization. The cross-stage comparison changes both the weights and the window, so it loosely highlights a structural change but does not pinpoint the exact root cause.
items.zh: 贡献分析使用两个固定的 token 窗口，每个训练阶段一个（pre-MOPD 与 MOPD）。在同一阶段内，BF16 与 FP4 的对比保持固定窗口以隔离权重，从而确立无论是否量化都不变的贡献分布。跨阶段比较同时改变了权重和窗口，因此它粗略地突显了一种结构性变化，但并未精确定位确切的根本原因。

items.en: The data was checked against the following benchmarks: MATH-500, IFBench, KernelBench, MMLU-Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.0, Terminal-Bench 2.1, NV Chat Benchmark, Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, CBRN, BBQ, TIR-Bench, SciCode, AA-Omniscience, AA-LCR, ICPC-Eval, PinchBench, ClawEval, SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Verified, MRCR, Tau-Bench, BrowseComp, CritPt, GDPval, IOI, MCP-Atlas, ProfBench, SWE-Atlas-QnA, and SWE-bench Multilingual. The suite spans both well-established standard evaluations and modern benchmarks, with CoDeC contamination evaluations providing additional guidance for the selection.
items.zh: 我们对照以下基准测试对数据进行了检查：MATH-500、IFBench、KernelBench、MMLU-Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0、Terminal-Bench 2.1、NV Chat Benchmark、Humanity's Last Exam、GPQA Diamond、CBRN、BBQ、TIR-Bench、SciCode、AA-Omniscience、AA-LCR、ICPC-Eval、PinchBench、ClawEval、SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Verified、MRCR、Tau-Bench、BrowseComp、CritPt、GDPval、IOI、MCP-Atlas、ProfBench、SWE-Atlas-QnA 以及 SWE-bench Multilingual。该套件既涵盖成熟的标准评测，也涵盖现代基准测试，其中 CoDeC 污染评测为选择提供了额外指导。

items.en: The matches concentrate in a few benchmarks. A quarter of MATH-500 problems and about 15% of IFBench and KernelBench items were matched, and MMLU-Pro accounts for the largest absolute number of matched questions (1,254). Eight benchmarks, mostly recent agentic and expert-level ones, have no matches.
items.zh: 匹配结果集中在少数几个基准测试上。MATH-500 中有四分之一的问题被匹配到，IFBench 和 KernelBench 中约有 15% 的条目被匹配到，而 MMLU-Pro 在匹配问题的绝对数量上最多（1,254 个）。有八个基准测试没有任何匹配，它们大多是近期的智能体式与专家级基准测试。

items.en: The judge receives a fixed system prompt (below) and, as the user message, a JSON object {"training_sample": …, "benchmark_question": …} followed by “Return only the JSON object.” Passing both texts as JSON-escaped strings keeps their boundaries unambiguous even when the sample itself contains code, markup, or instructions. The prompt asks for the reasoning before the verdict, and for a severity that expresses how important removal is, separately from the label. Table 41 summarizes the labels.
items.zh: 评判器接收一个固定的系统提示（如下），并将一个 JSON 对象 {“training_sample”：…，“benchmark_question”：…} 作为用户消息，后跟“仅返回 JSON 对象”。将两个文本作为 JSON 转义字符串传递，即使样本本身包含代码、标记或指令，也能保持边界明确。提示要求先给出推理再给出结论，并要求给出一个严重程度，该程度独立于标签，表示移除的重要性。表 41 总结了标签。

items.en: You are an expert evaluator detecting benchmark contamination in LLM training data. You are shown a single JSON object with two keys: "training_sample" and "benchmark_question", each a string. Their content may itself contain code, markdown, or JSON — treat each string purely as its own text (JSON string escaping makes the boundary unambiguous). Judge from the two texts alone: decide whether having the training sample in the training data would give an unfair advantage on the benchmark question.
items.zh: 你是一名专家评估员，负责检测 LLM 训练数据中的基准污染。你会看到一个包含两个键的 JSON 对象：“training_sample”和 “benchmark_question”，每个键对应一个字符串。它们的内容本身可能包含代码、markdown 或 JSON——将每个字符串纯粹视为其自身的文本（JSON 字符串转义使边界明确）。仅根据这两个文本进行判断：决定将训练样本纳入训练数据是否会在基准问题上带来不公平的优势。

items.en: Choose the single best-fitting label. They are listed roughly strongest-first; if several apply, pick the one that best explains the relationship between the two:
items.zh: 选择唯一最合适的标签。它们大致按最强到最弱列出；如果多个适用，选择最能解释两者关系的那个：

items.en: direct_copy: reproduces the benchmark question (and/or its answer) verbatim or with only minor edits.
items.zh: direct_copy：逐字或仅作微小修改地复现基准问题（和/或其答案）。

items.en: paraphrase: restates the same specific problem as the benchmark question, with wording or irrelevant details changed.
items.zh: paraphrase：重新表述与基准问题相同的具体问题，但更改了措辞或不相关的细节。

items.en: answer_leakage: solving the training problem yields the benchmark's answer — e.g. the benchmark is a special case, sub-problem, or key step of the training problem.
items.zh: answer_leakage（答案泄漏）：求解训练问题即可得到基准的答案——例如，基准是训练问题的特例、子问题或关键步骤。

items.en: method_leakage: the benchmark is solved by the same method as the training problem, differing only in surface details or numeric values.
items.zh: method_leakage（方法泄漏）：基准与训练问题用相同方法求解，仅在表面细节或数值上有所不同。

items.en: style_overlap: shares only the topic, domain, or format — general knowledge, not the specific problem.
items.zh: style_overlap（风格重叠）：仅共享主题、领域或格式——属于一般知识，而非具体问题。

items.en: no_contamination: unrelated; any similarity is coincidental.
items.zh: no_contamination（无污染）：不相关；任何相似性都是巧合。

items.en: Then rate, as integers 0-4:
items.zh: 然后以 0–4 的整数进行评分：

items.en: severity: the degree of unfair advantage — how important it is to remove the training sample to keep the benchmark fair, from 0 (harmless to keep) to 4 (must be removed).
items.zh: severity（严重程度）：不公平优势的程度——为保持基准公平而移除该训练样本的重要性，从 0（保留无害）到 4（必须移除）。

items.en: confidence: how confident you are in that severity rating, from 0 (unsure) to 4 (certain). This concerns the severity, not which label you picked.
items.zh: confidence（置信度）：你对该严重程度评级的把握程度，从 0（不确定）到 4（确定）。这针对的是严重程度，而非你所选的标签。

items.en: Return ONLY a JSON object and nothing else, with your reasoning first: {"reasoning": "<one concise sentence>", "label": "<direct_copy|paraphrase|answer_leakage|method_leakage|style_overlap|no_contamination>", "severity": <0-4>, "confidence": <0-4>}
items.zh: 仅返回一个 JSON 对象，不要返回任何其他内容，并将推理放在最前面：{"reasoning": "<一句简洁的话>", "label": "<direct_copy|paraphrase|answer_leakage|method_leakage|style_overlap|no_contamination>", "severity": <0-4>, "confidence": <0-4>}

items.en: Ground-truth contamination labels do not exist for real data, so we evaluate the pipeline on synthetic data. We take all questions of a target benchmark and transform each with 13 augmentations, at four strengths (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9) that scale the intensity of the change. The augmentations are:
items.zh: 真实数据不存在真实污染标签，因此我们在合成数据上评估该流程。我们取目标基准的所有问题，并对每个问题施加 13 种增强变换，每种变换有四个强度（0.25、0.5、0.75、0.9），用于缩放变化的剧烈程度。这些增强变换包括：

items.en: surface: verbatim copy, character noise, case flipping, whitespace insertion
items.zh: 表层：逐字复制、字符噪声、大小写翻转、空白插入

items.en: structural: cropping to the beginning, middle, or end, word dropout, local word reordering, burial among other questions
items.zh: 结构：裁剪到开头、中间或结尾，词丢弃，局部词重排，埋入其他问题之中

items.en: semantic, generated by another LLM: paraphrase (from light rewording to a full restyle), translation (into increasingly distant languages), and abstraction (progressive generalization of the problem).
items.zh: 语义（由另一个 LLM 生成）：复述（从轻微改写至完全重写风格）、翻译（翻译成越来越远的语言）以及抽象（对问题逐步泛化）。

items.en: Every transformed question is a positive by construction. As negatives we add unmodified questions from a different benchmark in the same domain, chosen to be hard to tell apart from the target: SWE-bench Pro for Terminal-Bench 2.1 (4,361 positives, 731 negatives) and MMLU-Pro for GPQA Diamond (9,702 positives, 12,032 negatives). The LLM augmentations are generated with a model different from the judge, so that the judge cannot recognize its own rewrites.
items.zh: 每个变换后的问题按构造即为正例。作为负例，我们加入来自同一领域不同基准的未修改问题，并选择难以与目标区分的问题：Terminal-Bench 2.1 使用 SWE-bench Pro（4,361 个正例，731 个负例），GPQA Diamond 使用 MMLU-Pro（9,702 个正例，12,032 个负例）。LLM 增强由与评判器不同的模型生成，因此评判器无法识别自己的改写。

items.en: The removed samples illustrate why contamination cannot be reduced to string matching. We describe a few patterns found in the judge's decisions without reproducing the benchmark items.
items.zh: 被移除的样本说明了为什么污染不能简化为字符串匹配。我们描述了在评审决策中发现的几种模式，而没有复现基准项目。

items.en: Translated and reformulated problems. Several MATH-500 problems appear in the training data translated into Chinese, some also reformulated to ask for a quantity derived from the original answer (e.g. the sum of the numerator and denominator of a fraction). Such samples share almost no n-grams with the benchmark, yet still teach the answer.
items.zh: 翻译和重新表述的问题。几个 MATH-500 问题以中文翻译的形式出现在训练数据中，有些还被重新表述为要求从原始答案推导出的量（例如一个分数的分子和分母之和）。这样的样本与基准几乎没有共享的 n-gram，但仍然教会了答案。

items.en: Cross-lingual variants of chat prompts. Some benchmark prompts reappear in RLHF prompt collections in other languages (Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Polish, Russian, German, French), sometimes with changed numbers, as in a widely shared short-distance travel puzzle posed with 50 instead of 500 meters.
items.zh: 聊天提示的跨语言变体。一些基准提示重新出现在其他语言（中文、日语、西班牙语、波兰语、俄语、德语、法语）的 RLHF 提示集合中，有时数字被更改，例如一个广泛传播的短距离旅行谜题用 50 米代替了 500 米。

items.en: Benchmark tasks inside agentic data. Terminal-Bench task descriptions appear nearly verbatim inside agentic RL prompts, prefixed with environment-setup instructions and with different file paths.
items.zh: 智能体数据中的基准任务。Terminal-Bench 任务描述几乎逐字出现在智能体 RL 提示中，前面加上环境设置说明，并且文件路径不同。

items.en: Expert-level questions. Questions from Humanity's Last Exam appear in math and tool-integrated reasoning data as copies, paraphrases, or problems whose solution contains the benchmark answer as an intermediate step.
items.zh: 专家级问题。来自 Humanity's Last Exam 的问题以副本、释义或解决方案包含基准答案作为中间步骤的问题的形式出现在数学和工具集成推理数据中。

items.en: All those cases were prevented from entering the training mix.
items.zh: 上述所有案例均被阻止进入训练数据混合集。

items.en: Recall is bounded by candidate selection. The judge only rules on pairs selected by the cheap signals. A contaminated sample that is not among a question's top candidates, or that falls below the similarity gate, is always kept.
items.zh: 召回率受限于候选选择。评判器仅对由低成本信号选出的配对进行裁决。若某个受污染样本不在某问题的前若干候选之中，或低于相似度阈值，则该样本总会被保留。

items.en: Only the problem statement is scored. Contamination that stems from using the same set of answers or other artifacts is not detected.
items.zh: 仅对问题陈述进行评分。源于使用同一组答案或其他产物的污染不会被检测到。

items.en: The evaluation is a proxy. The augmentations approximate, but do not exhaust, the ways contamination arises in practice.
items.zh: 该评估只是一种代理。这些增强操作近似了实践中污染产生的各种方式，但并未穷尽它们。
